value.value: No need to worry about the Spriggan Team. Our goal is to eliminate them. Let's go!

value.name: caption
value.value: They're the best Wing Divers. We're saved!

value.name: caption
value.value: So these ones don't spit acid.

value.name: caption
value.value: A very suitable opponent. Let's crush them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn monsters. Don't dirty our ocean.

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn monsters. Don't dirty our ocean.

value.name: caption
value.value: You did a good job holding out. Leave the rest to us.

value.name: caption
value.value: Great job. Amazing skills back there.

value.name: caption
value.value: The ocean is home to many creatures. Don't pollute it.

value.name: caption
value.value: In Europe, huge flying crafts were spotted. The first like them ever observed.

value.name: caption
value.value: Huge flying crafts were sighted. The first like them ever observed.

value.name: caption
value.value: Ships we don't have data on... Must be a new enemy strategy. What scale are we talking?

value.name: caption
value.value: Looking back at the attacks so far, the attack right after the battle was the first attack. A year later was the pod attack with the aliens in space suits. What we're seeing now is the third attack.

value.name: caption
value.value: So if monsters released from the group of Teleportation Ships was the first attack... That makes this the second attack.

value.name: caption
value.value: That many? I don't think we can withstand that.

value.name: caption
value.value: Currently collecting data on enemy ships.

value.name: caption
value.value: Our aerial forces attacked the evolved enemy ships. We failed. The ships are protected by special armor, just like the Teleportation Ships.

value.name: caption
value.value: I knew it. We've gotta attack from the ground and just be prepared to die.

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemy ground forces detected. They're coming down from the evolved ships.

value.name: caption
value.value: Ground units. It is more Aliens?

value.name: caption
value.value: No, the enemies are robots. Cyborgs or Androids, to be more specific. You could say they're living machines.

value.name: caption
value.value: Machine soldiers. They're a terrifying force.

value.name: caption
value.value: Evolved enemy ships detected. A big group of them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemy reinforcements? Our situation just got a lot worse.

value.name: caption
value.value: The evolved enemy ships are releasing what appear to be landing vessels in the sky over the city.

value.name: caption
value.value: We don't have any data on the types of aliens inside the landing vessels.

value.name: caption
value.value: There's a new type of alien?!

value.name: caption
value.value: Evolved alien ships detected over the ocean. A large group of them.

value.name: caption
value.value: So they've got reinforcements. I wonder how big their force really is.

value.name: caption
value.value: The evolved enemy ships stopped over the ocean. What are they doing there?

value.name: caption
value.value: They seem to be releasing something, many of which have already gone into the ocean.

value.name: caption
value.value: Evolved enemy ships detected. A lot of them.

value.name: caption
value.value: More reinforcements? They've got far more resources than we imagined.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have no data on the aliens that the evolved enemy ships are dropping out on the ground.

value.name: caption
value.value: Wait, the aliens aren't touching the ground. They're floating in the air.

value.name: caption
value.value: Did you hear that? Aliens that can fly.

value.name: caption
value.value: I didn't think they'd have Wing Divers, too.

value.name: caption
value.value: So they're gonna come at us from the sky?

value.name: caption
value.value: I have an important question about the flying aliens. They don't seem to be using any equipment for flying.

value.name: caption
value.value: Then how do they fly? Wings? Riding the wind like birds?

value.name: caption
value.value: They don't have wings. They shouldn't be able to fly. According to our science, at least.

value.name: caption
value.value: But reports say they really are flying.

value.name: caption
value.value: They have powers humanity hasn't discovered yet. Maybe that's how we should think about it. Some sort of energy that lets you fly without wings or propellers. Not "science" per se, but things like anti-gravity and psychokinesis...

value.name: caption
value.value: It's the opinion of our researchers, but I don't believe in psychokinesis, either. No organism can possibly have powers like that.

value.name: caption
value.value: So they're advanced lifeforms that can use psychokinesis? That's too crazy to be true. They must be using devices.

value.name: caption
value.value: They seem to be inflicting terror. Some soldiers lost the will to fight when faced against them. Others even had panic attacks.

value.name: caption
value.value: I can imagine. They are terrifying. You can't stay sane when you see one of those on the battlefield. Some people even call them evil gods.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have to be prepared for major losses. And even then there's no guarantee we can win.

value.name: caption
value.value: I can imagine. They're terrifying. You can't stay sane when you see one of those on the battlefield. Some call them evil gods.

value.name: caption
value.value: The area of the ocean where Scylla can live seems to be expanding. A submarine came in contact with a Scylla and took major damage. Submarine carriers will need to restrict future activity.

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn Primers. Who knew they could attack in the water, too! Now our submarine carriers aren't safe.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're increasing their numbers in the ocean, too. Isn't there something we can do to stop them?

value.name: caption
value.value: So we just have to stand here looking dumb...

value.name: caption
value.value: The flying aliens' attacks are fiercer than anything I've seen before. If this continues, humanity's final day won't be far away.

value.name: caption
value.value: Soldiers are panicking and in no condition to fight.

value.name: caption
value.value: That alien is terrifying people. Some really believe it's the legendary Kraken.

value.name: caption
value.value: Fear makes you delusional like that. But we've gotta fight every foe, no matter what it is. It's the only way.

value.name: caption
value.value: That alien fills people with terror. Some call it a demon.

value.name: caption
value.value: The alien invasion is happening faster than ever before. If the damage continues at this rate, humanity's time will be over before long.

value.name: caption
value.value: Aliens flying in the sky. It's like a cartoon.

value.name: caption
value.value: Some people say that alien's a god.

value.name: caption
value.value: Fear makes you delusional like that. But we've gotta fight every foe, no matter what it is. It's the only way.

value.name: caption
value.value: That's one of their evolved ships. It's humongous.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's like a flying fortress. I heard there's a whole fleet of them.

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't believe the Primers had so many forces in reserve...

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemy humanoid soldiers encountered! We're under attack!

value.name: caption
value.value: I'll assist units engaged with the enemy!

value.name: caption
value.value: Humanoid robots... Must be a new anti-infantry weapon.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy ship is sending down humanoid weapons.

value.name: caption
value.value: All personnel, this is headquarters. Enemy ships are releasing Android soldiers. Some units have already been attacked.

value.name: caption
value.value: Halt attacks on enemy ships. Focus on the Androids.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'll bombard them. You take shelter.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's possible to destroy them somehow. We'd be fine if there weren't so many.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm heading out. I'll destroy those Androids.

value.name: caption
value.value: Support from the air is coming. Watch out.

value.name: caption
value.value: Attack from the enemy ship! They got our helicopter!

value.name: caption
value.value: Attacks from the sky don't work. Ground units, help us out.

value.name: caption
value.value: A3 here. Encountered humanoid fighters. Currently engaged in combat.

value.name: caption
value.value: Roger that, A3. Hold the line at all costs. Don't let the enemy advance.

value.name: caption
value.value: A3 engaged in combat. Back me up.

value.name: caption
value.value: Our allies are in danger. Let's join up.

value.name: caption
value.value: A9 here. We're under attack! The enemy forces are huge!

value.name: caption
value.value: Engaged in combat with humanoid fighters. Backup requested.

value.name: caption
value.value: A9 engaged in combat. Give me some help here.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy ship is sending down humanoid weapons.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's like they're alive! Are they really machines?

value.name: caption
value.value: Look! They're bleeding! They ARE alive!

value.name: caption
value.value: Living machines! They combined nature and machine into one!

value.name: caption
value.value: Stay away from me, you fake human monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: I don't care if you attack me, I'll still come for you!

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't come any closer! Go away!

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy ship keeps releasing Androids.

value.name: caption
value.value: They keep releasing more of them. I lost count.

value.name: caption
value.value: There's too many of them. They must be trying to overwhelm our land forces.

value.name: caption
value.value: So these are the Android soldiers.

value.name: caption
value.value: The western area is destroyed. The Androids are trampling everything in the city.

value.name: caption
value.value: Mechanized alien creatures... Or robots made of organic parts. I'll bet they mass-produced these to take over the Earth by sheer number.

value.name: caption
value.value: Stay away! You better not come one step closer!

value.name: caption
value.value: Those things look like robots but they're alive! They're bleeding!

value.name: caption
value.value: Look how many there are! We have to get outta here!

value.name: caption
value.value: Yesterday Giant Androids with heavy weaponry were detected. Stay on guard.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's gigantic! A Giant Android with heavy weapons!

value.name: caption
value.value: Giant Androids. They're here, too, then.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Giant Androids have heavy weaponry. Keep a distance when fighting them.

value.name: caption
value.value: The evolved enemy ships are releasing Androids everywhere. These soldiers are fearless. It's a steady invasion by numbers, our hardest foe yet.

value.name: caption
value.value: Can't we do something...? The Androids will overrun the planet. It's only a matter of time.

value.name: caption
value.value: They pull out one new weapon after another, don't they?

value.name: caption
value.value: We're pros at taking down drones! Not one will escape us!

value.name: caption
value.value: We don't know what abilities the enemy drones possess. However, since they've been sent here, we can assume they are more powerful. Be especially careful.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'll show them what an anti-materiel rifle can do.

value.name: caption
value.value: This rifle can shoot through armor coating. Nothing's better for fighting drones.

value.name: caption
value.value: We're facing evolved enemies! Don't slip up!

value.name: caption
value.value: Take them down before they get close!

value.name: caption
value.value: The drones have multiple laser cannons on them!

value.name: caption
value.value: Their armor is thick! They won't come down easy!

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn! These Androids are made to predict our attacks. The enemy keeps refining their weapons.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Primers are aware of the threat of our ground forces. They wanna eliminate us with these Androids.

value.name: caption
value.value: So they analyzed our tactics and then introduced new weapons to counter? How is that even possible?

value.name: caption
value.value: Drones with heavy armor and weapons. Like tanks of the skies.

value.name: caption
value.value: We got intel from teams who faced the drones. After many losses on both sides, we've found their weak point.

value.name: caption
value.value: The orb in the central part distributes power through the body. Shoot that central orb.

value.name: caption
value.value: We know the enemy's weak point. Aim for the circle at the center.

value.name: caption
value.value: There's an orb in the middle portion. Attack that central point.

value.name: caption
value.value: Look for their weak points. The floating mechanism, the sensor. There must be some parts not covered in armor.

value.name: caption
value.value: Find the weak point. There must be a part where the armor is thin.

value.name: caption
value.value: That's an evolved ship?! It's so big!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's too hard to destroy the enemy ship. Bring down the drones.

value.name: caption
value.value: Oh, shit! That ship is armed!

value.name: caption
value.value: Forget their ship. Destroy the drones.

value.name: caption
value.value: Let's call these Type 3 Drones from now on.

value.name: caption
value.value: Heavily armed drones. We know their weak point but we're still taking damage. These things are bad news.

value.name: caption
value.value: Many outpost bases have been destroyed in the past few days. They know exactly where our bases are, so they're sending in grenadiers to blow them up.

value.name: caption
value.value: These Androids are equipped with grenades.

value.name: caption
value.value: KG6 here. We can handle this.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have a KG6 Kepler. The drones are nothing.

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemy elites have dropped in a nearby area.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're heavily armed. Exercise due caution.

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemies are coming out of the ships!

value.name: caption
value.value: They're fully protected! Clad in armor, head to toe!

value.name: caption
value.value: They're covered in armor! Where do we even aim?!

value.name: caption
value.value: These enemies have new gear. This is going to be tough.

value.name: caption
value.value: The armor's protecting their bodies. Focus on their heads.

value.name: caption
value.value: Aim for their heads! That should take them out!

value.name: caption
value.value: Expect landing ships. Exterminate every alien they drop.

value.name: caption
value.value: Their armor's near impenetrable. Aim for their heads.

value.name: caption
value.value: Heavily armed aliens are dropping in!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's a platoon of heavily armored aliens!

value.name: caption
value.value: That armor is formidable. Go for their heads to take them out.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are just a few heavily armored aliens. Destroy them all to turn the tide of battle.

value.name: caption
value.value: Mission complete. Let's get these soldiers medals.

value.name: caption
value.value: A new kind of enemy ship is passing in your airspace.

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn. We've no means of stopping them. All we can do is wait for them to pass by.

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemy airships identified at your location.

value.name: caption
value.value: There's no need to attack the enemy's new ship. Let it pass through.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy ship is doing something. A part of the ship is coming off.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's huge! I've never seen an Anchor like that before!

value.name: caption
value.value: The ship dropped a Teleport Anchor. It's flooding the area with Androids.

value.name: caption
value.value: This looks bad! If more Androids keep coming, they'll outnumber us!

value.name: caption
value.value: You mean we'll be the ones getting kicked out?!

value.name: caption
value.value: Attack the anchor. Stop them from sending anything else through.

value.name: caption
value.value: If that thing is indeed a Teleportation Anchor, the usual methods should take it out.

value.name: caption
value.value: We are still investigating this anchor's data. We don't know what it's capable of.

value.name: caption
value.value: We may assume the tip is the teleporter. Attack the glowing mechanism.

value.name: caption
value.value: The upper tip is its weak spot. Attack the part that's lit up.

value.name: caption
value.value: The upper part is wrapped in a light screen. It might be a defensive shield.

value.name: caption
value.value: Dammit! It must be to protect its weak spot.

value.name: caption
value.value: The light screen appears to have a dome shape, like an upturned glass. You may be able to attack it from right below it.

value.name: caption
value.value: Plant yourself right below that thing and shoot from under the light screen.

value.name: caption
value.value: The lower part should have no shield so it can let down what it teleports. It's risky but we need you to attack it from below.

value.name: caption
value.value: Holy moly, this thing's got weapons!

value.name: caption
value.value: How are we supposed to get close now?!

value.name: caption
value.value: A shield that covers its weak spot. Weapons to ward off approaching infantry.

value.name: caption
value.value: These aren't coincidences. They're conscious improvements. The Primers are improving their weaponry to better fight humanity.

value.name: caption
value.value: Impossible. How could they do it in this short a time?

value.name: caption
value.value: It can't be a coincidence. They underestimated us at first. But they're improving now that they've been counterattacked. They're devising new pesticides.

value.name: caption
value.value: Primers aren't fighting humanity. They're looking for more effective ways to exterminate us.

value.name: caption
value.value: The anchors are detaching from the ships!

value.name: caption
value.value: Androids are coming out of the anchors!

value.name: caption
value.value: We've got Androids--a whole slew of them!

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemy ships are passing through at high altitude.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy ship passing overhead has uncoupled its hull. It's descending to the surface.

value.name: caption
value.value: Attack the anchor. Keep any more Androids from coming through.

value.name: caption
value.value: All anchors have been destroyed. Eliminate any remaining threats.

value.name: caption
value.value: We were able to gather some priceless data thanks to you.

value.name: caption
value.value: Hereafter, we will refer to these Evolved Teleportation Anchors as Tail Anchors.

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't believe it. To go above and beyond the enemy's plans...

value.name: caption
value.value: Whatever the Primers throw at us, we're going to handle it with every last ounce of ingenuity we have.

value.name: caption
value.value: All tanks, forward! Close in on the anchor!

value.name: caption
value.value: Advance! Get right up to the anchors!

value.name: caption
value.value: The tanks can't aim at the anchor's weak point. We'll have to rely on the foot soldiers.

value.name: caption
value.value: Changing course! Heading near the anchors!

value.name: caption
value.value: Charge! Kick them to the curb!

value.name: caption
value.value: These Androids have drones for protection. Proceed with caution.

value.name: caption
value.value: We'll take 'em all out. Heading in.

value.name: caption
value.value: They say you're the cream of the crop. Show me what you've got.

value.name: caption
value.value: An unusual phenomenon has been recurring in this area.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have reports that aliens are falling from the sky with no teleportation devices in sight.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're literally coming out of nowhere!

value.name: caption
value.value: Attack the aliens, but be careful. There's something off about these ones.

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't see a single teleporter out here.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's the first time Aliens have been teleported. And without any confirmed teleporters to speak of.

value.name: caption
value.value: Until now, we thought there needed to be a teleporter on the receiving side but...this situation just threw that out the window.

value.name: caption
value.value: All of the teleporters we've identified so far were receivers. Exits, to put it another way. You'd go in through an entrance somewhere to emerge at a receiving teleporter. However, the enemy may have means of teleportation without receivers.

value.name: caption
value.value: If they have a device that can simply send objects to a remote location, how are we supposed to combat that?

value.name: caption
value.value: That is only one possibility. Besides, there's something...odd about these aliens.

value.name: caption
value.value: Watch! They're coming out of thin air!

value.name: caption
value.value: And again. What is going on?

value.name: caption
value.value: I knew it. This isn't normal.

value.name: caption
value.value: Through the video, we've confirmed multiple scars on the aliens' bodies. Their weapons also seem to be malfunctioning or damaged.

value.name: caption
value.value: They've always had brand new gear up until now. But these aliens' weapons...

value.name: caption
value.value: They look like wounded, tired, old soldiers.

value.name: caption
value.value: They look like wounded, tired, old soldiers.

value.name: caption
value.value: Why would they send ones like these? Some kind of experiment, perhaps?

value.name: caption
value.value: Maybe the Primers are running out of soldiers. Could be.

value.name: caption
value.value: But they're still our enemies. We're in no position to feel sorry for them. Wipe them out.

value.name: caption
value.value: The aliens that appeared in the vicinity have begun to make a run for it.

value.name: caption
value.value: But it seems they were only teleported to this neighborhood. Follow them and look into their objective.

value.name: caption
value.value: The aliens have occupied this town. We're taking it back.

value.name: caption
value.value: They haven't noticed our approach. Infiltrate the town and deal with them one by one.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長157-1

value.name: caption
value.value: This town is home to healing hot springs. Who knew even aliens would visit them?

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長157-1

value.name: caption
value.value: This town is home to healing hot springs. Who knew even aliens would visit them?

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長157-1

value.name: caption
value.value: This is my hometown. Help me get it back from these invaders.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Aliens' actions aren't driven by strategy. We don't know the why of it but...we believe these Aliens have been removed from the Primers' plans.

value.name: caption
value.value: Do you mean to say they're deserters?

value.name: caption
value.value: It's possible. We haven't confirmed any other aliens teleported since that time. We may assume this group is acting independently and in self-defense.

value.name: caption
value.value: So did they run away here? Or was it a teleportation accident?

value.name: caption
value.value: In any case, there's no coexisting with these individuals. Take them out.

value.name: caption
value.value: Huge wave of aliens coming from the mountain peaks!

value.name: caption
value.value: Aliens approaching! They're coming from the mountains!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is more than we can handle!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長157-1

value.name: caption
value.value: We're in deep trouble! Look how many there are!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士157-1

value.name: caption
value.value: This is a veritable army. You're something else.

value.name: caption
value.value: Aliens coming from the mountains in great numbers!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長157-1

value.name: caption
value.value: They're not using their numbers well, just trying to overwhelm us. It's a rabble with no leader. Clear them out like a shooting gallery.

value.name: caption
value.value: It seems all of the aliens that were teleported had gathered here.

value.name: caption
value.value: Is this all of them? Clear them out.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長157-1

value.name: caption
value.value: If you're not here to sightsee, then get the hell out.

value.name: caption
value.value: What a disorderly bunch. Maybe they just gathered here to try and survive.

value.name: caption
value.value: Given time, they would've scrounged up a leader and become a fearsome army. We were able to nip that in the bud.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長157-1

value.name: caption
value.value: I almost feel sorry for them. They couldn't call this town home either.

value.name: caption
value.value: This place is swarming with drones.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are red ones mixed in among the swarm. Stay focused.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are red ones mixed in among the swarm. Stay focused.

value.name: caption
value.value: Red Drones have high combat capabilities. Be careful out there.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're in search mode. Attacking them should switch any nearby units to combat mode.

value.name: caption
value.value: It won't be easy fighting a ton of them at once. Exercise discretion as you bring them down.

value.name: caption
value.value: I've taken down 20 drones. Time to add some red ones to the count.

value.name: caption
value.value: It went into combat mode! Get ready!

value.name: caption
value.value: The colors changed! It's gonna attack!

value.name: caption
value.value: Aw, crap! That laser goes right through armor!

value.name: caption
value.value: If these things catch up to the civilians who escaped, they're doomed! We gotta get rid of them here and now! Hold your ground!

value.name: caption
value.value: Oh no! The fighting's already begun.

value.name: caption
value.value: Let's do some drone hunting, then!

value.name: caption
value.value: You know what to do with drones, I presume.

value.name: caption
value.value: Sorry we're late. Let's team up.

value.name: caption
value.value: Who the heck is that?! They're some sort of drone destroyer!

value.name: caption
value.value: Who cares as long as we win? Follow their lead!

value.name: caption
value.value: Those things are cold, calculating killing machines. We're lucky we survived.

value.name: caption
value.value: We owe you, kid. You're pretty darn good.

value.name: caption
value.value: A marvelous display. This victory is a ray of hope for those of us contending with drones.

value.name: caption
value.value: The tanks will lead the way. Follow them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Team A, you're going too far ahead. You've strayed too far from Team B.

value.name: caption
value.value: If you see any Androids, fill 'em with holes!

value.name: caption
value.value: We have Giant Androids, confirmed. Watch yourselves.

value.name: caption
value.value: Are those the new type of enemy ship?

value.name: caption
value.value: That's a sizeable fleet. Is this the 2nd troop of the Earth invasion forces?

value.name: caption
value.value: Can't believe they have a force of this magnitude after all this time.

value.name: caption
value.value: They got all the way here, huh?

value.name: caption
value.value: The tanks will act as shields.

value.name: caption
value.value: These tanks should withstand Giant Android attacks, though not for too long.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's dangerous going that deep into the front line. Move back and reconvene with the rear guard.

value.name: caption
value.value: Relocating as soon as we clear out this mob.

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't worry. We'll get back on our feet. No matter how bad the situation gets.

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.name: caption
value.value: It's like an eye! So we just gotta shoot that?!

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.name: caption
value.value: That eye-like part is its weakness. Aim for its eye.

value.name: caption

value.name: caption
value.value: Good, we've destroyed the Giant Android.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's walking! That base is walking!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's good to know you're here. Let's go.

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.name: caption
value.value: We won't be able to push through! They'll wipe us out!

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.value: This is a relief for us too.

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.name: caption
value.value: Operation success. We prevented an attack and saved countless lives. You did well.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're going to burn us alive!

value.name: caption
value.value: They've been modified to attack humans specifically!

value.name: caption
value.value: These robots practically skim the ground when they fly!

value.name: caption
value.value: These robots practically skim the ground when they fly!

value.name: caption

value.name: caption

value.name: caption
value.value: This is how they optimize for efficiency?! They just can't wait to kill us!

value.name: caption

value.name: name

value.name: caption

value.name: caption
value.value: We will call these robots Excavators.

value.name: caption
value.value: It appears they have breached the inner area of Land 7. These Excavators were likely created to attack underground facilities and bunkers.

value.name: caption
value.value: Unbelievable. They're taking out our safe zones one by one. They were clearly extremely well-prepared.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's a large army of enemy robots.

value.name: caption
value.value: The robots are beginning to gather.

value.name: caption
value.value: If it's a fight they want, they got it. Here come the robots.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長86-1

value.name: caption
value.value: They're grouping up. They mean to wipe out any and all who oppose them.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy's movements suggest that they may have predicted our attack...

value.name: caption
value.value: That's not all! It's built with slanted surfaces that deflect bullets.

value.name: caption
value.value: The round armor completely covers the robot. It has no weak points like tires or sensors, and even its weaponry is defended.

value.name: caption
value.value: The smooth, rounded armor around this weapon is perfect for deflecting gunfire. Put simply, we believe it was developed to combat infantry.

value.name: caption
value.value: In order to attack, the armor must open up for a moment. It's risky, but we can destroy it by shooting inside this opening.

value.name: caption
value.value: The robot was destroyed that easily?!

value.name: caption
value.value: When it attacks, the armor opens up. We can take them down by shooting them there.

value.name: caption
value.value: A weapon specialized in one-on-one combat...

value.name: caption
value.value: It's a horrific weapon, but you fight back with unpredictable tactics. You're a true soldier.

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't lose focus. If you get hit with that acid, it's bad news.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have a good view here. We can take out monsters before they get close.

value.name: caption
value.value: A submarine has disappeared off this coast. There are also missing civilian vessels.

value.name: caption
value.value: You're saying that's related to this monster?

value.name: caption
value.value: Not necessarily, but if you notice anything irregular, report back.

value.name: caption
value.value: There must be more nearby. Wipe them out.

value.name: caption

value.name: caption
value.value: We are not prepared to intercept. I advise we let them pass and not attack.

value.name: caption
value.value: Sirens flying in low. Do not attack.

value.name: caption

value.name: caption
value.value: It appears that something is chasing the Siren!

value.name: caption
value.value: Chased? Were they not just traveling across the ocean?

value.name: caption
value.value: We do have reports of a battle in the area with marine life. It could be this marine life in pursuit.

value.name: caption

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't see ahead. We can't fight like this.

value.value: The fog's getting thick. This is terrible.

value.value: Look! There's something in the air!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's a Siren! The Sirens are here!

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn! It's such a perfect opportunity too.

value.name: caption
value.value: Are they flying this low to hunt for prey?

value.name: caption
value.value: Something's coming from the ocean. Back away from the coast.

value.name: caption
value.value: Something came out of the ocean!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's huge! Is it a whale?

value.name: caption
value.value: It's walking! I don't think that's a whale!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's a Dark Monster! A Dark Monster from the ocean!

value.name: caption
value.value: You've gotta be joking. A Dark Monster from the ocean?

value.name: caption
value.value: It's like some sort of humanoid fish!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is bad. We'll get dragged out to sea.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's a merman! We're under attack from a merman!

value.name: caption
value.value: Marine life is flooding out of the water onto the beach in the surrounding areas.

value.name: caption
value.value: Dark Monsters? There's only fish in the water. Take a look.

value.name: caption
value.value: Hey! Don't get close to the water!

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm the son of a fisherman. The ocean's... Ahhh!

value.name: caption
value.value: That's a merman?! Run! Flee to higher ground!

value.name: caption
value.value: A giant sea creature has come ashore. Stay alert.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're coming from the ocean. Get away from the water and crush each and every sea creature that comes ashore.

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't worry. Your bullets will work.

value.name: caption
value.value: I see no data indicating that bullets...

value.name: caption
value.value: They must have been right behind the Sirens.

value.name: caption
value.value: We can assume they were chasing, or rather, were led by the Sirens here. Either way, it's possible that they work together in some fashion.

value.name: caption
value.value: Hey, something just moved! There's something in the ocean!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's a merman! They drag people into the ocean and drown them. Don't go near the water!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's just a big fish! Nothing to be scared of!

value.name: caption
value.value: The water! There's something in the water!

value.name: caption
value.value: If it can move around on land as well...this is a major threat.

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't fight it underwater, though. We need to face it on land.

value.name: caption
value.value: We're going to exterminate these monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: Keep your cool! We proceed with caution!

value.name: caption
value.value: One Six here. Headed there now. The water's not too cold, is it?

value.name: caption
value.value: One Six here. We've just arrived. What's the situation?

value.name: caption
value.value: How's anyone supposed to swim with all this fog? Can't see a thing.

value.value: How's anyone supposed to swim with all this fog? Can't see a thing.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's a merman! A merman is attacking!

value.name: caption
value.value: Our comrades are already fighting it! Let's go give them a hand!

value.name: caption
value.value: Stop! If you hurt a merman, you'll suffer their curse!

value.name: caption
value.value: An enemy from the deep sea. What a disaster.

value.name: caption
value.value: This fog is keeping visibility low. Stay alert.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're definitely in the city. Stay sharp.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are Dark Monsters in this fog. The fairy tales have come true.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Mermen have infiltrated this far inland.

value.name: caption
value.value: So they can live on land and in water? That's horrifying.

value.name: caption
value.value: Mermen, fishmen, whatever they are... Let's make them regret ever coming ashore!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's fast! It's going to slam us!

value.name: caption
value.value: No way that was the last one. Don't let your guard down.

value.name: caption
value.value: Fighting them is pointless. No matter how many we kill, they just keep coming ashore.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's over. We're going to get eaten.

value.name: caption
value.value: Is the EDF just a bunch of cowards? Hell no! We don't get eaten! We do the eating!

value.name: caption
value.value: We have confirmed that the enemy's evolved ship was dropping sea creatures. We believe they did this to infect the seas and minimize the area where humans can safely operate.

value.name: caption
value.value: We certainly didn't see this one coming.

value.name: caption
value.value: I guess this means humans can't live on top of the ocean. Our dreams of floating cities are over.

value.name: caption
value.value: Our submarine fleets and carriers have played an important role in our operations thus far, but this will limit their usefulness going forward.

value.name: caption
value.value: We believed that these Primers from outer space would be unprepared for underwater operations. We underestimated them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Frequent sightings of sea creatures are being reported from all regions. The largest number of reports is from the West Coast. The sea creatures may have a base somewhere in the North Pacific.

value.name: caption
value.value: If they're multiplying in the ocean, they could reach unmanageable numbers. Humanity would lose the oceans.

value.name: caption
value.value: We will call these sea creatures Scylla from now on.

value.name: caption
value.value: The name of a mythical beast, huh? Don't give those things such an exaggerated title. It'll only scare the soldiers.

value.name: caption
value.value: The mythical creature, huh? Fine. It's just that serious of a threat.

value.name: caption
value.value: The sea creatures seem to have mobilized all at once. They are starting to come ashore across the globe.

value.name: caption
value.value: We've gathered a regiment of reinforcements. Hold out until we get there.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are actually creatures like this in the deep sea?!

value.name: caption
value.value: Forget the ship and destroy that anchor.

value.name: caption

value.name: name

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't use our flight capabilities. It's a bad matchup, but let's show them we can do it.

value.name: name

value.name: caption

value.name: caption
value.value: Approach was a success. We're right under them!

value.name: caption
value.value: Why are the evolved ships shaped like that?

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't tell the front from the back.

value.name: caption
value.value: Detecting enemy movement within the halted fleet.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy ship set an anchor loose.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's an evolved Teleportation Anchor! The teleporter is activating!

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemies will be sent through! We can't wait for our main forces any longer!

value.name: caption
value.value: Get close to the anchor's base! Attack the tip from directly below it!

value.name: caption
value.value: Eliminate any monster that stands in your way!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's an evolved Anchor. You up for the job?

value.name: caption
value.value: The glowing bit at the top of the anchor is its weak spot.

value.name: caption
value.value: The top is protected by an umbrella-shaped shield. Shoot it from directly underneath.

value.name: caption
value.value: Something's attacking! It looks like a tail!

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy ship dropped an anchor!

value.name: caption
value.value: The next wave is here! Snap 'em in half!

value.name: caption
value.value: Drop as many as you like! You drop one, we destroy one!

value.name: caption
value.value: There are so many enemy ships, yet they only drop one anchor at a time.

value.name: caption
value.value: How odd. Why are they being so cautious?

value.name: caption
value.value: Dammit. Where is our main force?!

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't handle this all by ourselves!

value.name: caption
value.value: Yes, we can! And we must!

value.name: caption
value.value: So long as that teleportation device is intact, this area is basically their territory! Stop it!

value.name: caption
value.value: We've got a warning message from the Siren Surveillance Corps. Confirming now.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is an emergency. The Siren is expected to pass through your area.

value.name: caption
value.value: So the enemy is being so passive due to the Siren.

value.name: caption
value.value: You see that? It's our recon team!

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy ship dropped an anchor!

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemy ships on the move. They appear to be leaving.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Siren has entered the operation area.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Siren's coming. Attack and chase it away.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're afraid their ships will be damaged by the Siren's rampage. They'll drop anchors and leave.

value.name: caption
value.value: They left in a hurry. I guess even Primers can't control the Siren.

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't just leave the anchor. But we don't have enough manpower to fight the Siren, either. Where is the main force?

value.name: caption
value.value: Destroy the anchor. Stop the enemy from sending backup.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Siren is running amok. Our intel didn't say anything about this.

value.name: caption
value.value: It doesn't matter. Just reduce it to ashes.

value.name: caption
value.value: For a recon team, you sure can fight.

value.name: caption
value.value: You've shown some real guts today.

value.name: caption
value.value: You're all welcome to join my squad any day.

value.name: caption
value.value: You again? I'll be sure to headhunt you later.

value.name: caption
value.value: Join my squad. I need soldiers like you.

value.name: caption
value.value: The storm has passed. The Siren appeared and interfered with the enemy's operations. Call it a lucky break.

value.name: caption
value.value: No need to chase it. Just let it go.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Siren still had plenty of strength left over. Our forces are no match for it.

value.name: caption
value.value: But even the Siren isn't immortal.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have visual confirmation of it sleeping for over 24 hours. Usually after it sustains injuries.

value.name: caption
value.value: That means it must sleep to heal its wounds.

value.name: caption
value.value: That's right. The Siren sleeps for up to several days. It may not always be a deep slumber, but according to our data, the longest it's slept is 46 hours.

value.name: caption
value.value: So our attacks were effective. That gives us a means to fight it.

value.name: caption
value.value: If we time it right, we could attack it while it's sleeping.

value.name: caption
value.value: Look! Scylla! There are Scylla all around.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Scylla are gathering around the Siren. They must be here to protect it.

value.name: caption
value.value: Begin operation. Eliminate the Scylla and the Siren.

value.name: caption
value.value: Won't the Siren wake up if it hears gunfire?

value.name: caption
value.value: No. The Siren will continue its slumber to heal. Don't worry about waking it and eliminate the Scylla.

value.name: caption
value.value: It seems the Siren and Scylla have a symbiotic relationship. Our recent surveys suggest the Scylla increase in number when the Siren sleeps.

value.name: caption
value.value: As it is defenseless while sleeping, the Siren probably calls for the Scylla. There are similar symbioses within Earth's ecosystem.

value.name: caption
value.value: So it is relying on another lifeform for protection.

value.name: caption
value.value: Finish off the Scylla. They'll only get in our way.

value.name: caption
value.value: Ugh, this mist. I can't see a thing.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are Androids and drones as well.

value.name: caption
value.value: Use the mist to get close and seal the deal.

value.name: caption
value.value: We should be able to approach under the cover of this mist. Get close and finish the job.

value.name: caption
value.value: Eliminate any nearby enemy. The demolition team will take care of the big one.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Siren will not regain consciousness until its wounds are healed. So go ahead. Get trigger happy.

value.name: caption
value.value: Are they here to protect the Siren?

value.name: caption
value.value: It appears the Primers are aware of the Siren's weakness. They know it's defenseless.

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemy unit incoming. Forget the Siren and engage them.

value.name: caption
value.value: We can deal with the Siren later. Take care of the enemy unit.

value.name: caption
value.value: Wing Diver, engage the enemy unit.

value.name: caption
value.value: Roger that. We'll clean out everything around the Siren.

value.name: caption
value.value: One last push. Nearby enemies are almost all taken care of.

value.name: caption
value.value: Demo team, make your approach. Finish off any nearby enemies.

value.name: caption
value.value: Movement detected. The Siren is waking up!

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn it. Did we run out of time?

value.name: caption
value.value: The Siren's awake. Get away from it at once.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Siren hasn't fully recovered. You can still take it down.

value.name: caption
value.value: Team B, commence attack. Take down the Siren.

value.name: caption
value.value: It would be difficult to defeat the Siren with our current forces. Leave it alone, but eliminate any other enemies.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Siren is on the move.

value.name: caption
value.value: Do not pursue the Siren. The objective is now to eliminate enemies in the area.

value.name: caption
value.value: Clean up the enemy unit. Make them pay for interfering with our operation.

value.name: caption
value.value: It escaped this time, but the thing's not invincible. It has to rest to heal its wounds. Now that we know that, we just have to wait for the perfect opportunity.

value.name: caption
value.value: We're engaged in battle, but losing the fight!

value.name: caption
value.value: Tank leader here. We're raring to go.

value.name: caption
value.value: The tanks have arrived. Fall back to their position.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長92-1

value.name: caption
value.value: Fall back and draw the enemy within our tanks' range.

value.name: caption
value.value: Leave the close-range enemies to the infantry!

value.name: caption
value.value: A second wave of enemies is closing in!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's a third wave of enemies!

value.name: caption
value.value: Grenadiers! They've got grenades on them!

value.name: caption
value.value: They're trying to blow up our tanks. Infantry, engage the grenadiers and make sure they don't get close.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're trying to blow up our tanks. Infantry, engage the grenadiers and make sure they don't get close.

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn it, they counter us perfectly!

value.name: caption
value.value: They know how to use their weapons! They won't make it easy for us!

value.name: caption
value.value: They're quick! I can't get a lock on them!

value.name: caption
value.value: Tanks won't be fast enough to handle enemies that fast. Take them out with rifles.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're right there. Any closer and it'd put us in harm's way.

value.name: caption
value.value: It just seems that way because they're so big. But they're still quite far away.

value.name: caption
value.value: Wow. They are too damn big.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Siren enters slumber when it loses strength. EMC can use their beams to put it to bed for a long time.

value.name: caption
value.value: Intelligence. The head of Advanced Technologies Lab requests a halt to the operation.

value.name: caption
value.value: Modifying Buster for maximum output. Locking on.

value.name: caption
value.value: All of its energy will be released at once. We only have one shot at this, so it has to hit. Make sure the target stays still.

value.name: caption
value.value: To guarantee a hit, the target has to stay still for eight seconds. Stop the Siren at all costs.

value.name: caption
value.value: The EMC's simultaneous attacks will stop the Siren in its tracks. Get ready!

value.name: caption
value.value: We're at our limit. I'm requesting that Buster shot.

value.name: caption
value.value: No, we cannot fire until the Siren has stopped moving. You need to stop it first.

value.name: caption
value.value: We're exhausted. Please, take the shot.

value.name: caption
value.value: We've only got one chance at this. Stop its movement.

value.name: caption
value.value: We cannot hit a moving target. Stop its movement.

value.name: caption
value.value: What is this fog?! What's going on?

value.name: caption
value.value: So they came as expected. We'll make them sorry.

value.name: caption
value.value: We expected Scylla to show up. Eliminate them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Its strength is weakening. Continue assault operations.

value.name: caption
value.value: Its strength has nearly run out. Just a bit more.

value.name: caption
value.value: Objective clear. We've stopped the Siren's activity.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Siren has halted all activity.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's fallen over, but that thing's far from dead. We need that finishing blow.

value.name: caption
value.value: Surface units. We owe you a great debt for your service.

value.name: caption
value.value: The target is up in flames! We got it!

value.name: caption
value.value: Phew, that's hot! The Buster's heat is scorching!

value.name: caption
value.value: What intense heat. It's like we're in an actual fire.

value.name: caption
value.value: Look! It's not dead! It's burning but still alive!

value.name: caption
value.value: The target is still moving. How is this possible?

value.name: caption
value.value: Surface unit, what's going on down there?

value.name: caption
value.value: The heat source is moving. Surface unit, what's happening? Is everything alright?

value.name: caption
value.value: This heat isn't from the Buster, it's coming from the Siren itself.

value.name: caption
value.value: The surrounding temperature is rising. It must be the Siren's body temperature.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Siren's skin is really hot. How can it live like this?

value.name: caption
value.value: A lifeform with a burning body. A scene straight out of hell.

value.name: caption
value.value: That thing is a threat to humanity. We have to extinguish that flame.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Siren is continually releasing its energy. If this continues...

value.name: caption
value.value: The lab believes the Siren changed its own body at the brink of death to survive. This puts an overbearing strain on its body, but this is its ultimate strategy for survival.

value.name: caption
value.value: So it can give up years of its life to escape death? Just how long does this thing have left?

value.name: caption
value.value: Nobody knows. It could be days. It could be years.

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't quite calculate its lifespan. And waiting for it to die naturally is not the best course of action for us.

value.name: caption
value.value: We need more data. Continue assault operations.

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't believe what I'm seeing here.

value.name: caption
value.value: What on Earth is that thing?!

value.name: caption
value.value: Things are never boring when you're around, Chief.

value.name: caption
value.value: Is that our prey? It's much bigger than the reports.

value.name: caption
value.value: Is that our prey? It's much bigger than the reports.

value.name: caption
value.value: They said it was weakened by the EMC's attack, but it doesn't appear to be.

value.name: caption
value.value: That means it has suffered a wound grave enough to warrant this last-ditch behavior.

value.name: caption
value.value: That thing just changed its appearance. It must need time to rest--as do we. We should leave the chase to the air force.

value.name: caption
value.value: We already have fighter planes tracking the Siren.

value.name: caption
value.value: Erginus and Archelus are terrifying creatures, but their sphere of activity is limited. They do not threaten the entire Earth. However, the Siren is quick, burning everything in its path. It is a global menace.

value.name: caption
value.value: We should change its name from Siren to Glaukos. It is the highest level threat on this planet.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Glaukos is now changing course. It is heading for this location.

value.name: caption
value.value: It can't be! That Glaukos must be attracted to the scent of blood.

value.name: caption
value.value: Perhaps our railgun could take out the Glaukos...

value.name: caption
value.value: So they're here. How's the railgun looking?

value.name: caption
value.value: Well, it was intercepted by a drone unit.

value.name: caption
value.value: It was an ambush. As if they knew where the railgun would be going.

value.name: caption
value.value: This thing is gigantic! And it's airborne!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's completely ablaze. How can it fly while it's on fire?!

value.name: caption
value.value: It sure has been a while since the battlefield's been this chaotic. Takes me back to the days of civil war.

value.name: caption
value.value: It sure has been a while since the battlefield's been this chaotic. Takes me back to the days of civil war.

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn! That Glaukos is too powerful! We won't defeat it if we're not prepared.

value.name: caption
value.value: Just great. Glaukos above and aliens on the ground.

value.name: caption
value.value: We'll be wiped out at this rate. We'll have to retreat.

value.name: caption
value.value: The railgun unit is still engaging the drones.

value.name: caption
value.value: I hate to say it, but this is our loss. Begin retreat orders.

value.name: caption
value.value: Did we make it in time?

value.name: caption
value.value: Deploy in front of the infantry. Act as their shields!

value.name: caption
value.value: We've got Scylla right in front of us!

value.name: caption
value.value: Fire! Don't let them touch down!

value.name: caption
value.value: Wherever the Glaukos goes, Scylla will follow. What a fearsome creature. It's a flying maritime disaster.

value.name: caption
value.value: Knowing their ecological relationship helped us predict the appearance of Scylla. If we can tighten our defenses in advance, we can stop them from coming ashore.

value.name: caption
value.value: The railgun is en route here.

value.name: caption
value.value: Stay sharp! Mist is covering the area!

value.name: caption
value.value: Scylla release water from within their bodies to create mist. It's not to hide from stronger foes, but rather used to help them hunt down their prey.

value.name: caption
value.value: So aiming becomes that much more difficult. They're a natural counter to soldiers with guns.

value.name: caption
value.value: Use the radar effectively. You should be able to ascertain major locations.

value.name: caption
value.value: The railgun is about to arrive.

value.name: caption
value.value: Did it get here in one piece?

value.name: caption
value.value: They're here. Kick those Scylla back where they came from.

value.name: caption
value.value: The railgun is unscathed. Why is that?

value.name: caption
value.value: The Primers have predicted our actions with incredible accuracy. But it appears even they have their limits.

value.name: caption
value.value: If they have some sort of scanning device, then there must be a limit to its effective range.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have to figure out why and how they are getting all this information on us.

value.name: caption
value.value: A Scylla army is pushing in!

value.name: caption
value.value: They keep coming no matter how many we take down. Are they multiplying in the sea?

value.name: caption
value.value: Then that means the deep sea is full of Scylla!

value.name: caption
value.value: The sea is a lost cause. Protect the land!

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy is amassing their forces here. If we don't stop the teleportation, things will become truly dire.

value.name: caption
value.value: Are we really fighting with these numbers? Are we just suicide corps?

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy has their guard down. We can take them.

value.name: caption
value.value: A tank driver seems to have deserted.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Bravo. Sorry I'm late.

value.name: caption
value.value: Let's go! Don't let our comrades die!

value.name: caption
value.value: What a fight. Let me help.

value.name: caption
value.value: This area is in the path of the Glaukos' course of movement.

value.name: caption
value.value: This area is in the path of the Siren's course of movement.

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't let it get past unscathed. Take it down.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's a new type of gun. It's for personal use, but it is said to have 15% of an EMC's output.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's a new type of gun. It's for personal use, but it is said to have 5% of an EMC's output.

value.name: caption
value.value: We're now working on mass-producing them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Is there any way to defeat it?

value.name: caption
value.value: We're looking for effective methods of attack, but the Advanced Technologies Lab has proposed looking into the use of Chiren Charges.

value.name: caption
value.value: Either the residents have taken shelter...or they've all been killed.

value.name: caption
value.value: Come on. We're destroying these Excavators!

value.name: caption
value.value: The Excavators are targeting humans. Do you know what that means?

value.name: caption
value.value: International treaties ban the creation of killer robots! Didn't anyone teach you that?!

value.name: caption
value.value: International treaties ban the creation of killer robots! Didn't anyone teach you that?!

value.name: caption
value.value: You should at least do your homework if you're going to come to Earth.

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like we'll have to punish you by firing squad.

value.name: caption
value.value: These look like new Excavator models. Be careful out there.

value.name: caption
value.value: Look at those Excavators! They're different from our data!

value.name: caption
value.value: High Grade Excavators are capable of extremely high output. Their electromagnetic armor is what makes them appear red. They're faster and more deadly than regular units.

value.name: caption
value.value: If they're constructed in a similar way, their armor should open just as they attack. Wait for that moment.

value.name: caption
value.value: Ranger 6 has been taken out of action.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長162-1

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like there's a unit in combat now. Providing cover.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長162-1

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長162-1

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm impressed you managed to hold out.

value.name: caption
value.value: Wing Diver has been taken out of action.

value.name: caption
value.value: Getting rid of Excavators is a Fencer's job!

value.name: caption
value.value: The whole damn mountain is our enemy.

value.name: caption
value.value: Our mission is to destroy the teleportation device. Time to take out that anchor.

value.name: caption
value.value: Man, this mission is rough. Let's get this done.

value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長99-1

value.name: caption
value.value: The monster known as Archelus has appeared from within the earth.

value.name: caption
value.value: The monster known as Archelus is moving toward the operation area.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Glaukos is approaching the area.

value.name: caption
value.value: Archelus and Glaukos?! What the hell is going on?!

value.name: caption
value.value: Is this gonna be a monster-on-monster fight?!

value.name: caption
value.value: Whoa, they're really gonna go at it!

value.name: caption
value.value: It took down Archelus like it was nothing!

value.name: caption
value.value: I don't understand. Monsters aren't supposed to fight other monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: Well, just look at the Glaukos. It doesn't seem to be acting normal.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Blazer's output is 15% of an EMC. But this creature defies all reason.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Blazer's output is 5% of an EMC. But this creature defies all reason.

value.name: caption
value.value: How could a Blazer not be effective?

value.name: caption
value.value: The Glaukos is now on the move.

value.name: caption
value.value: So it's just going to take down Archelus and stroll off?

value.name: caption
value.value: Continue the operation. Eliminate the monster.

value.name: caption
value.value: It just took out the undefeatable Archelus? It's not just more physically impressive--the Glaukos is absurdly powerful in general.

value.name: caption
value.value: With its sudden growth, the Glaukos may have more power than it can handle. Which would mean...it's in an unstable state.

value.name: caption
value.value: Use of Chiren Charges has been authorized. They're currently being loaded into the sub carrier.

value.name: caption
value.value: Guard Team has encountered the enemy. Now in combat.

value.name: caption
value.value: The sub carrier has been damaged in the battle with Scylla and is immobile until repairs are complete. Provide the Guard Team with cover and defend the sub carrier.

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't believe it. The enemy arrived just as the Guard Team did. They're going to intercept the sub carrier first. So they were able to detect it...?

value.name: caption
value.value: Sub carriers are a real pain in the ass for the Primers, but they can't lay a finger on them while they're in the ocean. I'm sure they're dancing with joy now that they've seen one just floating there defenseless.

value.name: caption
value.value: So it's the perfect target for them, huh? Even the Mothership decided to show up.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're ready to take on the sub carrier, Scylla and all.

value.name: caption
value.value: Sub carrier Pandora will be sunk by Mothership No. 8. This is fate.

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't! Our launchers are down!

value.name: caption
value.value: The Kepler is nearly destroyed too. We're the only ones left.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm at least taking one more teleportation ship down with me.

value.name: caption
value.value: This battle's getting real messy out here!

value.name: caption
value.value: This battle's getting real messy out here!

value.name: caption
value.value: Dammit! Most of the escort unit has been taken out!

value.name: caption
value.value: We're getting under the teleportation ships!

value.name: caption
value.value: The weak point of a teleportation ship is right underneath it!

value.name: caption
value.value: The Mothership has just stopped in this area. We can attack it from the surface now. Damage it and send it flying home.

value.name: caption
value.value: Let's start by taking down these teleportation ships.

value.name: caption
value.value: There it is. And now Mothership No. 8 will sink the sub carrier Pandora. It was a terrible blow to humanity. But it's time to change our destiny. Attack No. 8!

value.name: caption
value.value: That's why I sent this unit. I'm counting on you.

value.name: caption
value.value: There it is. And now Mothership No. 6 will sink the sub carrier Siren. It was a terrible blow to humanity. But it's time to change our destiny. Attack No. 6!

value.name: caption
value.value: The outcome of this war will change if the sub carrier survives. You have to change history.

value.name: caption
value.value: Time to intercept some drones. Let's go.

value.name: caption
value.value: We got too close to the sea!

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't be afraid! Take them head on!

value.name: caption
value.value: Mermen-schmermen! They're in the way of our operation! Get rid of 'em!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's a whole army of mermen!

value.name: caption
value.value: They're showing up one after another!

value.name: caption
value.value: Did the Mothership call them here...? It must have docked here in order to bring them to the surface.

value.name: caption
value.value: The sub carrier Pandora is anchored just off the coast. The Mothership is above, while the Scylla are coming after it from the ocean. Even the Pandora can't survive this.

value.name: caption
value.value: The sub carrier Siren is anchored just off the coast. The Mothership is above, while the Scylla are coming after it from the ocean. Even the Siren can't survive this.

value.name: caption
value.value: We'll whittle down the enemy's forces, but we can only do so much.

value.name: caption
value.value: Pandora unable to move due to system malfunction.

value.name: caption
value.value: Siren unable to move due to system malfunction.

value.name: caption
value.value: Who could have imagined that the aliens would bring anti-sub carrier equipment? How were they so prepared?!

value.name: caption
value.value: Drones! The Mothership is releasing drones!

value.name: caption
value.value: Hold on, how are there this many?!

value.name: caption
value.value: Aim for its cannon. According to our information, that's its weakness.

value.name: caption
value.value: If you want to hit its cannon, you'll have to attack from the ground. The time has come at last.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Mothership is protected by a shield. There's only one way to damage it. You have to destroy it just as it deploys its cannon.

value.name: caption
value.value: If our information is accurate, you should be able to take it down. We're counting on you.

value.name: caption
value.value: What incredible force. The energy stored up in its cannon should get blown right back into the Mothership if its gun is destroyed. Our only choice is to counterattack from below, even if that means we risk getting hit.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Mothership seems to have been damaged.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Mothership looks like it's taking major damage!

value.name: caption
value.value: We've finally done it. Humanity has destroyed an enemy Mothership.

value.name: caption
value.value: The teleportation ship is dropping monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: Aliens! They won't go down easily!

value.name: caption
value.value: We're surrounded by mist. Be careful.

value.name: caption
value.value: Dammit! I can't see with all this mist!

value.name: caption
value.value: The mist is starting to get thicker!

value.name: caption
value.value: This damn mist is too thick!

value.name: caption
value.value: The mist is starting to thin out!

value.name: caption
value.value: Okay, the mist has cleared a bit. Now's our chance.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Mothership looks like it's taking major damage!

value.name: caption
value.value: The Mothership has started to ascend!

value.name: caption
value.value: That ship should be useless now. A decisive win for us.

value.name: caption
value.value: It seems the sub carrier repairs are complete.

value.name: name
value.value: 潜水母艦パンドラ艦長

value.name: caption
value.value: Repairs complete. We're grateful for the protection provided by the ground forces.

value.name: name
value.value: 潜水母艦パンドラ艦長

value.name: caption
value.value: Repairs complete. We're grateful for the protection provided by the ground forces.

value.name: name
value.value: 潜水母艦パンドラ艦長

value.name: caption
value.value: Get away from the ocean. The sub carrier's about to move.

value.name: name
value.value: 潜水母艦パンドラ乗務員

value.name: caption
value.value: The operation is complete. We've achieved a major victory here.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Glaukos remains in a state of dormancy.

value.name: caption
value.value: So the Glaukos goes dormant, too. We can't let our guard down, though. Get to your positions immediately.

value.name: caption
value.value: Get in the EMC. We'll provide support.

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't mess it up, these things cost a hundred million each.

value.name: caption
value.value: Wish they would use that kind of money to treat us a little better instead...

value.name: caption
value.value: There's an EMC ready for you. Use it.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'll give you cover. Look, this is the Blazer.

value.name: caption
value.value: Even I can be useful so long as I have a Blazer. Can't afford to lose you, after all.

value.name: caption
value.value: The head of the Advanced Technologies Lab is accompanying us on this operation.

value.name: caption
value.value: He's more than welcome to observe. We're up against a ridiculous enemy, so we can't even imagine what might happen. The more brains we have, the better.

value.name: caption
value.value: Actually, he seems to have armed himself and is headed to the battlefield.

value.name: caption
value.value: Scratch that. He's armed and accompanying the Storm Team.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Glaukos isn't immortal. Hurt it, and it'll expend energy in order to heal its wounds. Using its strength means it'll need to rest. Launch an all-out attack to exhaust it, then we'll blow it to bits with Chiren Charges once it stops.

value.name: caption
value.value: Get the Glaukos to stop moving.

value.name: caption
value.value: A direct hit will wear the Glaukos down. Fire--and keep on firing.

value.name: caption
value.value: Get the Glaukos to stop moving.

value.name: caption
value.value: We'll use the Chiren Charges loaded onto Pandora to annihilate the Glaukos.

value.name: caption
value.value: The sub carrier is about to surface.

value.name: caption
value.value: We really managed to make three of those things?

value.name: caption
value.value: They're humanity's final stronghold. Seems like they thought the deep sea would be the safest place of all when the aliens invaded.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're humanity's final stronghold. Seems like they thought the deep sea would be the safest place of all when the aliens invaded.

value.name: caption
value.value: But now even the seas are dangerous.

value.name: caption
value.value: I heard all of humanity's knowledge and resources have been put into those things. Even genetic records and plant seeds. A literal Noah's Ark.

value.name: caption
value.value: Surfacing Pandora right in front of the Glaukos is absurd! Even if they're doing it to make sure the Chiren Charges hit their mark...

value.name: caption
value.value: Pandora should have sunk already from the start, but you changed its fate. Now, though, it's floating there defenseless. Perhaps history has the ability to restore itself--to restore the timeline. If it does, our destiny will stay the same...and Pandora will sink.

value.name: caption
value.value: Then again, you could look at it in another way. Pandora not sinking has given us this opportunity to defeat the Glaukos.

value.name: caption
value.value: Perhaps this battle is the fork in the road. Either we lose Pandora and history returns to how it was...or history changes, and we're victorious thanks to Pandora's power.

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn you, Glaukos. Summoning Scylla to defend yourself?

value.name: caption
value.value: Flyers confirmed! A huge pack of them!

value.name: caption
value.value: Shit! There's a bunch of monsters here, too!

value.name: caption
value.value: We have to deal with monsters and aliens? The Primers must be trying to protect the Glaukos.

value.name: caption
value.value: Attack unit has nearly been wiped out.

value.name: caption
value.value: We put Pandora in danger only for this to happen.

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't let you die. I've negotiated with the Counsellor, and reinforcements are coming your way.

value.name: caption
value.value: The unit's almost there. I'm counting on you.

value.name: caption
value.value: The highest possible operational code? This operation has been issued by headquarters.

value.name: caption
value.value: We're taking too many losses. We're nearly wiped out.

value.name: caption
value.value: So this is what the Glaukos is capable of...

value.name: caption
value.value: I refuse to let you die.

value.name: caption
value.value: A hundred million down the drain. That's coming out of our paychecks!

value.name: caption
value.value: Seems we've lost an EMC. But don't worry. Another has been deployed.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm sending one final unit. Don't worry about the cost. All that's important here is victory.

value.name: caption
value.value: Are you telling me that headquarters predicted this would happen?!

value.name: caption
value.value: The Glaukos' movements are starting to slow.

value.value: The Glaukos has started to move again.

value.name: caption
value.value: Not even the Chiren Charges worked...?

value.name: caption
value.value: The Glaukos' body surface temperature is rapidly dropping.

value.name: caption
value.value: Does that mean our attacks are working?

value.name: caption
value.value: Ground units, continue assault. Stop the Glaukos once more.

value.value: Chiren Charges. Fire every last one!

value.value: The Glaukos' body surface temperature has dropped to pre-Buster attack levels.

value.name: caption
value.value: It must have exhausted all its absorbed energy. Now's our chance.

value.name: caption
value.value: All teams, head in. We can take this thing out if we act now.

value.name: caption

value.name: caption
value.value: We should be able to use the Barga's attacks to damage the Glaukos.

value.name: caption
value.value: We did it. At last, we destroyed this terrifying foe.

value.name: caption
value.value: Pandora didn't sink, and the Glaukos was defeated. In other words...we proved that history can be changed.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're coming down from all over. The situation's worse than we thought.

value.value: Converge at Point B and regroup.

value.value: They're on top of the buildings! Aliens!

value.name: caption
value.value: Trying to turn the tables on us, huh? Not today!

value.value: The enemy force is bigger than expected. I can't believe they still had this many left.
