value.value: Get back to work. That is all.

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't bring anything with me. Memorize it. You have to memorize it...

value.name: caption
value.value: You listening? I...screwed it up yet again. No matter how many times I do this over, I can never change a thing. I at least wanted to save my family...

value.name: caption
value.value: Major? I'd like to propose an operation. I've sent you the files just now.

value.name: caption
value.value: That's outside of your authority. No outside interference is allowed when it comes to the Strategic Intelligence Division.

value.name: caption
value.value: Not only does the enemy know our every strategy, they're working to turn the tables on us. We need to turn them right back around.

value.name: caption
value.value: I know how the enemy will advance. I've entered everything I've been able to remember. Just look at the data I sent you.

value.name: caption
value.value: You seem tired. You need to get some rest.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's hard to believe what I'm seeing in this data, but...

value.name: caption
value.value: Connect me to headquarters. I'm talking to the Counsellor.

value.name: caption
value.value: Counsellor, I have some important information. This is big enough that it could affect the entire situation that we face.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Major's briefed me. Let's meet in person and talk.

value.name: caption
value.value: Th-thank you! It's time for all of humanity to put its minds together. Please, gather every talented scientist you can.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm not getting any scientists. We're going to move the world, which means getting the people in it who have real power.

value.name: caption
value.value: Destroying the time machine while it was in operation has caused time to be rewound, and we're the only ones with our memories intact.

value.name: caption
value.value: I think it was nothing more than a chance malfunction. It won't be happening a second time, but we can recreate the first time if we're in the same place at the same moment. The same chance malfunction will take place, because that's how it's set up to happen.

value.name: caption
value.value: Sorry. I must have explained this time and time again.

value.name: caption
value.value: It worked. We've gone back in time, and we still have our memories.

value.name: caption
value.value: We're mostly on the same timeline as before, but there seem to be slight differences. Be careful.

value.name: caption
value.value: Let's meet at the usual spot. Don't die on me.

value.name: caption
value.value: The situation gets worse the more that history is changed. This is the result of our enemies constantly altering history, but we can't even figure out how they're changing it.

value.name: caption
value.value: We damaged the time machine while it was in operation that day, and it exploding resulted in an unexpected situation. Time was rewound by four years, and only we had retained our memories. It's hard to believe, but...our minds transcended the barriers of time.

value.name: caption
value.value: The accident must have been a miracle brought about by countless coincidences. It's the kind of thing that shouldn't happen a second time, but we know how to make it happen once more. Or rather...it hasn't happened yet, but it's going to. The accident takes place two weeks from now, and in that moment on that day, we're going to cause it by attacking the machine.

value.name: caption
value.value: I guess you're tired of hearing this explanation...but I still have to give it. I feel so anxious. Will we really be able to recreate it...?

value.name: caption
value.value: The accident takes place a week from now. In that moment on that day, we'll attack the time machine, the same accident will occur, and time will be rewound. Time won't proceed any further so long as we keep doing this. We'll have essentially trapped the Primer in a cage of time. It doesn't matter how strong they are, the day they're victorious will never come so long as time doesn't move forward.

value.name: caption
value.value: That said, they continue to revise history. It seems they keep on changing the situation just as we keep returning to the past. At some point, it's going to get so bad that there's nothing we can do about it. Time won't rewind if we die before the day of the accident, and when that happens, humanity is done for.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Primer must not expect us to be going back in time. There's no way for them to know about this place, either. In fact, the accident hasn't even happened yet because we've gone back. Not even the Primer will be able to know about an accident that hasn't taken place. We're the only ones aware of the fact that the time machine will be destroyed today.

value.name: caption
value.value: It worked. I still have my memories.

value.name: caption
value.value: ...It would've been easier on me if I'd lost them, though.

value.name: caption
value.value: Thank you for being there for me. Now I can know for sure that this isn't all a delusion. I would've thought that I was going crazy if I was the only one.

value.name: caption
value.value: We've rewound time again and again. We've relived tragic moments again and again...seen more slaughter than any man ought to. I've had enough of this. I don't think my heart or my mind can take it much longer.

value.name: caption
value.value: But even so... It may be the case that humanity can only survive within this rewound time at this point. No matter how many times they're killed, I suppose it's better than disappearing for good.

value.name: caption
value.value: That said, I can't keep doing this. I've seen my wife die so many times now.

value.name: caption
value.value: I know. The EDF can't show vulnerability to its enemies, right?

value.name: caption
value.value: These tragic memories keep piling up, one after the next, but I still push on. We're hitting them where it hurts. Isn't that right?

value.name: caption
value.value: A large Primer fleet has appeared nearby. This many ships out of nowhere... It's only a guess, but this might be the unit they're using in order to change history. We've finally found the moment where the timeline gets altered.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy fleet is spreading out across the world. It doesn't have to be many at all. We only have to take down a few of them to throw a wrench into their plans.

value.name: caption
value.value: An enemy fleet? There's nothing about this unit in the reports. What's going on...?

value.name: caption
value.value: It's a massive fleet. Why did they pick this area...?

value.name: caption
value.value: Jackpot. Our wild gamble has actually paid off. This is the spot the enemies are after.

value.name: caption
value.value: That fleet was sent in order to alter history. We can prevent it from being changed if we can destroy them.

value.name: caption
value.value: The fleet intends to win the battle here, then proceed to the next battlefield in order to change history. This is where we take them down. Don't let a single one escape.

value.name: caption
value.value: Humanity's survival depends on this battle. Please, we're counting on you.

value.name: caption
value.value: Where did this fleet come from? I never got any information about this.

value.name: caption
value.value: This looks bad. Part of the fleet is heading this way.

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemy fleet has entered the operational area. Enemy landing from above expected.

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemy ships are coming. Keep your eyes on the sky.

value.name: caption
value.value: It seems like the enemy ships want to attack this area. The air force won't make it in time. You'll have to take them down from the ground.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is part of the fleet used to alter history. If they win here, they'll go on to change the outcome of many other battlefields. Destroying them now will throw a wrench in their plans. This is a vital moment in the war.

value.name: caption
value.value: You're here. We couldn't be any luckier than this. No... After repeating the same moments again and again, we've at last earned this coincidence.

value.name: caption
value.value: I thought the enemy would go after this place. Guess I was right.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is the fleet used to alter history. Destroy them and we can halt the enemy's plans. We're counting on you.

value.name: caption
value.value: Someone managed to destroy the new enemy ships!

value.name: caption
value.value: Someone knows the enemy's weakness! We can win this!

value.name: caption
value.value: Can't have you dying out there. I'm with you!

value.name: caption
value.value: Someone took down an enemy ship? But we don't even have any information on them...

value.name: caption
value.value: Somebody knows the enemy's weakness...? Why...?

value.name: caption
value.value: This matches up with what the head of the Advanced Technologies Lab said.

value.name: caption
value.value: This matches up with what the head of the Advanced Technologies Lab said.

value.name: caption
value.value: If his information is true...it could change the entire landscape of this war.

value.name: caption
value.value: You need to keep them safe. You can't let them die.

value.name: caption
value.value: Team X copies. We'll provide protection.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm looking for God... Where...where have you gone, God...?

value.name: caption
value.value: The Space Egg... Where has it gone...?

value.name: caption
value.value:
You have to listen to me.

There are...people who are looking for God.

That said, this god is an alien one... More like a king or an emperor, really, and there are some who believe in him. They even say that this god rides upon an egg-shaped spacecraft.

I think they believe in him because they want to believe.
They want to believe that humanity can win if we can just destroy the egg-shaped ship.
Believe it hard enough, and he'll give you hope to keep on living.

It doesn't matter if there's no evidence. They believe anyway...

value.name: caption
value.value: We won. We really won... I can't believe it. They overpowered us by so much...

value.name: caption
value.value: Fierce battles continue to be fought across the globe. This is but one of them. Even so...this victory is a massive one.

value.name: caption
value.value: We won... This victory is a major one.

value.name: caption
value.value: That went better than I could ever expect.

value.name: caption
value.value: You're making me realize that we still have hope.

value.name: caption
value.value: We were in a hopeless situation. Everyone had given up. But I...

value.name: caption
value.value: If it really comes down to it, I'm prepared to fight too. Right there by your side.

value.name: caption
value.value: You're always able to survive... And I mean that in a good way.

value.name: caption
value.value: You're always able to survive... And I mean that in a good way.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is such an absurd result... What do I even write in my report?

value.name: caption
value.value: This is such an absurd result... What do I even write in my report?

value.name: caption
value.value: I think this goes without saying now, but it seems my theory was correct.

value.name: caption
value.value: I wonder how many times I've heard this news report by now.

value.name: caption
value.value: I've even memorized the speech at this point.

value.name: caption
value.value: I was moved the first time I heard it, but it just gets embarrassing after this many times.

value.name: caption
value.value: She's going to die in a drone attack after the report.

value.name: caption
value.value: I contacted her and said to run. She should be safe.

value.name: caption
value.value: I've memorized the sports almanac. I could earn a fortune...but I know it'll be pointless.

value.name: caption
value.value: Did you know that person has amazing luck too? We played cards but I was way out of my depth.

value.name: caption
value.value: You can always count on Storm 1.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're not just tough, their advice has saved a lot of people. It's like they know what's going to happen. Guess it's what you'd call a veteran's intuition.

value.name: caption
value.value: I advised them to work on building up their forces as much as possible before the situation gets worse.

value.name: caption
value.value: I can never remember acronyms. EMC? What's that stand for again?

value.name: caption
value.value: I want to say it stands for "electrical macer cannon"?

value.name: caption
value.value: This is the same history as our own. Nothing has changed.

value.name: caption
value.value: Everyone was convinced that the Primer had come from space, but that's not it. They came from the future. It's why they suddenly appeared above orbit, breaking the barriers of time.

value.name: caption
value.value: It really is just like the history that we know. The Primer should be altering the timeline. But when did it happen, and how?

value.name: caption
value.value: History hasn't changed. I guess this means there's no way to figure out when the timeline was altered, or how.

value.name: caption
value.value: A giant spacecraft-like object was discovered under the surface of the moon. An eleventh Mothership. It's likely their command module. We've found our enemy's weakness at last. We can win this battle if only we could destroy it, but humanity doesn't have the power to do that right now.

value.name: caption
value.value: We've discovered the enemy's command module, but all we can do is look at it. Humanity is so powerless.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Primer are able to freely move throughout time. In that case, they should easily be able to accomplish their goals by either going after humanity during primitive times, or at least by attacking humanity before the EDF is formed. So why are they so fixated on this era? What's the reason?

value.name: caption
value.value: So the time has come at last.

value.name: caption
value.value: This really is the final operation. We're throwing all the forces we have left into stopping the Mothership.

value.name: caption
value.value: A simultaneous worldwide attack. But it's obvious how much weaker we are than them. It'll be a hopeless battle.

value.name: caption
value.value: There's meaning in simply acting here and now! We have to win, no matter the price we pay.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is the Professor speaking. Can you hear me? The operation has begun around the world. An all-out attack. You might even call it reckless. You'll really need to be ready for what comes next, but this is still worth doing. Please. You have to survive.

value.name: caption
value.value: Do we really need a diversion this big?

value.name: caption
value.value: We're doing anything we can to raise our chances of success even a bit. Humanity's fate is riding on this operation.

value.name: caption
value.value: If the info is true, that is.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy is being distracted around the world. I know this will work.

value.name: caption
value.value: Omega here, speaking to the whole world. We are victorious.

value.name: caption
value.value: Nuclear strike on the moon's surface successful. While it wasn't a direct hit, we should have done some pretty serious damage to No. 11.

value.name: caption
value.value: The diversion has paid off. It seems like the enemy wasn't expecting us to attack here. No. 11 was defenseless.

value.name: caption
value.value: So it went exactly as he planned, huh.

value.name: caption
value.value: We fired a Bulge Laser salvo at the moon's surface. While not completely destroyed, we should have done some serious damage to No. 11.

value.name: caption
value.value: There's no way for us to know how the Primer have changed history, but we can hypothesize. They must have intervened somewhere in the past few days.

value.name: caption
value.value: The only logical conclusion is that there are limits to how they can change history. Can they only interfere in a few years of history starting from the time that the Ring appears? Do they need the Ring to act as a front-line base in order to do it?

value.name: caption
value.value: You have to listen to me. There's research on the Primer being carried out around the world, and I found something very interesting in the data I've been sent.

value.name: caption
value.value: After looking into the genes of the monsters, we've learned that they're a partial match for creatures from Earth. Which is to say that these monsters are Earth-based creatures. I dare say that they...came from the distant future.

value.name: caption
value.value: If the monsters really are from Earth...that would require a hundred thousand years of evolution. This is only a theory, but human civilization won't survive for a hundred thousand years. Earth...belongs to the monsters then.

value.name: caption
value.value: Humanity has long fallen a hundred thousand years in the future. Likely caused by environmental pollution or nuclear war. A number of seeds were able to survive in that contaminated environment, and after many cycles of evolution and selection, the monsters won out in the end. It's a complete shock. Humanity will fall within the next hundred thousand years even without the Primer attacking.

value.name: caption
value.value: Genetic investigation has made clear that it's not just the monsters. Even the aliens we encountered at the beginning have the same hallmarks in their DNA. In other words, the green aliens are also creatures from a distant future Earth. A new form of intelligent life, born in a planet of monsters. That, or they may be what humanity mutates into in the future.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Primer descended upon a future Earth to capture the monsters and aliens. If we go with this theory...that means the Primer came from a hundred thousand years in the future. I'd thought their time machine could only change history on a level of ten or so years, but in reality, it's what they use for transportation. The Primer were born far in the future, when humanity has already fallen. They're travelers who have gone back in time by a dizzying number of years.

value.name: caption
value.value: A journey spanning a hundred thousand years. That can't be easy for anything, even the Primer. Why go to all this trouble to attack humanity? What exactly could it be...?

value.name: caption
value.value: There has to be a reason for why the Primer are doing this. Humanity is nothing more than a fallen ancient civilization from their perspective. There's just such a massive gap in time between the age when humans lived and when the Primer live. We're separated by even hundreds of thousands of years, so how could we pose a threat to one another? Why travel back this far in time just to attack us? If they want to control the Earth, then they're free to do as they want with it in the future, when there's no humanity. So then why...?

value.name: caption
value.value: There are people who believe that there's great meaning in the reason why the Primer want to eliminate humanity.

value.name: caption
value.value: Perhaps Earthlings are just that terrifying to them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Just think about it. Eight billion people packed on this tiny planet. And on top of that, we have more than enough weapons to wipe out everyone on it multiple times over. The aliens must see that as bizarre.

value.name: caption
value.value: In comparison to the bloody way we fight, they manipulate time in an attempt to win while generating the fewest casualties possible. What a refined way of waging war.

value.name: caption
value.value: Do you really think so? These..."time tactics" they use may be something they only came to after a long and blood-soaked history. We don't know a thing about the Primer, after all.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is only a guess, but if the Primer are capable of changing history, it's only a few years of the past, starting from the day the Ring arrives. There have to be rules to the way they change history, so that they avoid creating a time paradox. There must also be a meaning to them choosing this point in time. Surely there's some historical significance here... Some incident that sets off a chain of events. Changing history any earlier than that would cause a time paradox.

value.name: caption
value.value: Listen to me. Why do the Primer attack humanity? What point is there in wiping mankind out? After many discussions among researchers from around the world, we reached a conclusion. That said, it's still only a hypothesis, but...I think that we've found the truth.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Primer are a civilization flourishing hundreds of thousands of years from now. They must have descended on Earth, a planet belonging to monsters, and discovered traces of human civilization. Their interest piqued, the Primer went back in time and observed humanity not long after it was born. It must have captivated them. The Primer even appeared before mankind, and we revered them as gods, mythologizing them.

value.name: caption
value.value: But that's when the Primer realized. Humanity must not learn of their existence. And so they cut off contact with mankind and hid, but an accident occurred. A Primer ship crash-landed in India a few millennia ago, and it all started from there.

value.name: caption
value.value: Their wrecked ship was discovered about twenty years ago, and humanity learned of the Primer. That would have been something the Primer couldn't overlook. I say that because...

value.name: caption
value.value: ...We couldn't be allowed to learn of their existence. Once we had, their only option was to destroy humanity.

value.name: caption
value.value: And they had to because otherwise...they'd be wiped out. By humans.

value.name: caption
value.value: I always wondered why the Primer chose this point in time. If something during this age had set off a chain of events, and they couldn't change history at any time before it. That something has to have been humanity discovering the crashed time-traveling ship. The event that led to the birth of the EDF, of course. But what's important is that it's when humanity realized that the Primer exist. They can't interfere in our history before that, or else they'd cause a time paradox.

value.name: caption
value.value: Those things are attacking the city.

value.name: caption
value.value: People here are all civilians. We can't just let those monsters attack them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Attack the monsters and stop the disaster from spreading!

value.name: caption
value.value: The tanks will support the infantry.

value.name: caption
value.value: Sergeant, perfect timing! Please support us. There's no time to waste. We must minimize the casualties.

value.name: caption
value.value: I see. We will join the fight.

value.name: caption
value.value: Sergeant, move with tanks. They can block off the acid from the monsters. Once the monsters get close, move with the tanks.

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn! There's no time for rest.

value.name: caption
value.value: All we can do is fight. Protect the civilians!

value.name: caption
value.value: Destroy the pylons before they ruin the city.

value.name: caption
value.value: The city will be doomed if we don't destroy the pylons!

value.name: caption
value.value: Which freaking country made these weapons?

value.name: caption
value.value: How could anyone create those horrible things? I'll find out who's behind all this horrible stuff and teach the guy a lesson!

value.name: caption
value.value: If only they were created by man...

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like it's not safe here, either.

value.name: caption
value.value: I promise I will take you to a safe place this time after we deal with the pylons.

value.name: caption
value.value: Sergeant, thank you for your support.

value.name: caption
value.value: Please tell me, when will we start a counterattack?

value.name: caption
value.value: Sergeant, the enemy is much stronger than you can imagine. The whole world is being attacked right now. We already have our hands full with managing the situation.

value.name: caption
value.value: Not even the EDF can withstand them... Looks like this attack was well-planned.

value.name: caption
value.value: All available units, attack the monsters now! Wipe them out ASAP!

value.name: name
value.value: 民間女性アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: Here is a follow-up report on the flying objects. They seem to be dropping monsters in various different places. The flying objects are extremely dangerous, so we urge you to keep a safe distance if you come across one.

value.name: name
value.value: 民間男性アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: So far, the identity of the flying objects remains unclear as governments worldwide deny involvement. And it hasn't been confirmed whether other organizations are involved. Although the government promised to clarify the situation, the current state is in chaos for authorities in question so the situation remains obscure. ***? The volume of the voice is lowering, and eventually the voice fades out.***

value.name: caption
value.value: This is the Strategic Intelligence Division. We will support you in the combat.

value.name: caption
value.value: Based on the falling trajectories of the pylons, we have determined the location of the gigantic ship.

value.name: caption
value.value: So that's the ship that deploys those pylons.

value.name: caption
value.value: It is flying above the combat area now. It may deploy pylons. Please be on high alert to the sky.

value.name: caption
value.value: Crap! Who the hell is behind all this?

value.name: caption
value.value: Destroy the pylons before they cause more damage!

value.name: caption
value.value: Aim at the upper part of the pylons.

value.name: caption
value.value: Help us! Monsters! There're monsters outside my home!

value.name: caption
value.value: I saw monsters! My friend was eaten! Please send someone over!

value.name: caption
value.value: Hello? My brother said he saw a monster. It's the size of an elephant. Huh? No? Why? Why don't you believe me?

value.name: caption
value.value: Time to wake up. This is such a wild dream. There are no such things as monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: Watch the sky. Pylons are crashing down.

value.name: caption
value.value: Destroy the pylons. Attack the top part.

value.name: caption
value.value: The helicopter squad will arrive soon. Ground troops, hold your ground before they are here.

value.name: name
value.value: パイロット1（ヘリ　ホーク１）

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Eagle 1. We are being attacked by UFOs.

value.name: name
value.value: パイロット1（ヘリ　ホーク１）

value.name: caption
value.value: There are so many. They outnumber us tenfold!

value.name: name
value.value: パイロット1（ヘリ　ホーク１）

value.name: caption
value.value: Abort attack and leave the combat area.

value.name: name
value.value: パイロット1（ヘリ　ホーク１）

value.name: caption
value.value: It's hopeless. They took us all out.

value.name: name
value.value: パイロット1（ヘリ　ホーク１）

value.name: caption
value.value: We are hit! Prepare for crash landing! Hold tight!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is the Strategic Intelligence Division. The gigantic ship is descending. It might be heading to the combat area.

value.name: caption
value.value: The estimated time of arrival is... Wait, it can't be! It is already near ground level.

value.name: caption
value.value: I need information. What are we fighting against?

value.name: caption
value.value: Huh!? Sergeant!! This is not good!

value.name: caption
value.value: It is as large as the city!

value.name: caption
value.value: Flying saucers! Flying saucers are coming out!

value.name: caption
value.value: It is not a terrorist attack--it's an alien invasion!

value.name: caption
value.value: There aren't any safe places anymore. Not on Earth at least.

value.name: caption
value.value: Is it a new weapon made by another country?

value.name: caption
value.value: Human beings can't create something that huge!

value.name: caption
value.value: Are you suggesting that it was created by aliens?

value.name: caption
value.value: They're too fast! And there are too many!!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is HQ. The flying saucers are dangerous. Permission to attack granted.

value.name: caption
value.value: Look! The flying saucers were shot down!

value.name: caption
value.value: T-There are too many of them!

value.name: caption
value.value: Flying saucers are attacking humans. Civilians are in danger, so shoot down as many of them as possible.

value.name: caption
value.value: We analyzed their pattern of action. We think that these weapons are autonomous battle drones, and I am afraid their targets are... humans.

value.name: caption
value.value: If we let them run rampage, it will result in unimaginable casualties. We must shoot them all down.

value.name: caption
value.value: Goddamn terrorists. I promise I will make you pay.

value.name: caption
value.value: There should be laws against the use of battle drones.

value.name: caption
value.value: Which freaking country sent those things?

value.name: caption
value.value: Face the reality. It's an alien invasion.

value.name: name
value.value: 民間女性アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: So far, no substantial information about the flying objects could be obtained. Governments of all countries are still denying any sort of involvement. However, there are only a limited number of forces that can perform such a large-scale attack. In order to find out the truth, the suspected parties should be closely monitored; investigations ought to be pursued and appropriate enforcement actions taken. But currently all measures are being hindered by the current situation.

value.name: caption
value.value: What do you mean by 'hostile forces'? Please tell me which force specifically.

value.name: caption
value.value: What is the Air Force doing?

value.name: caption
value.value: Ordinary terrorists can't possibly create such weapons. The enemy seems to be a powerful country.

value.name: caption
value.value: The gigantic mothership is moving! Looks like it's activating some kind of device!

value.name: caption
value.value: Did you hear that? She says casualties are not important.

value.name: caption
value.value: Look! It's a cannon, isn't it?

value.name: caption
value.value: What the hell is that device?

value.name: caption
value.value: Wait a minute. I don't like the look of it.

value.name: caption
value.value: No doubt, those things are aliens!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is not just a world war--it is a space war!

value.name: caption
value.value: Yeah. When can I wake up from this nightmare? I will wake up in my bed, right?

value.name: caption
value.value: There are just way too many!

value.name: caption
value.value: At this rate, we will all die!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長1

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Wing Diver. We have arrived on the scene.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長1

value.name: caption
value.value: All members are equipped with equipment D.

value.name: caption
value.value: Very well. Attack the flying saucers.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Hummer. We're in position.

value.name: caption
value.value: Very well. The anti-material rifles should be able to shoot down those drones.

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員2（アームズ１）

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員2（アームズ１）

value.name: caption
value.value: Show them the power of Powered Exoskeletons!

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't spare any drones, or they will attack civilians. Destroy them all!

value.name: caption
value.value: The drones will hunt us down sooner or later. If we want to live, we must fight back!

value.name: caption
value.value: Leave the gigantic ship to the Air Force. Ground troops, shoot down the drones.

value.name: caption
value.value: A great number of drones were dispatched from the gigantic ship. There are thousands of them.

value.name: caption
value.value: The drones split into teams of hundreds. Citizens are in great danger now.

value.name: caption
value.value: Crap! I don't know who they are, but are they really going to start a war?

value.name: caption
value.value: Sergeant, take the civilians to a safe place.

value.name: caption
value.value: Hordes of flying drones incoming. Everyone, find your cover. The enemies are drones. You won't be attacked if they don't find you. Hide now.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Dolphin. We are hiding in buildings, but there are flying saucers all around us.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Rabbit. We are surrounded by flying saucers and can't move.

value.name: caption
value.value: We should go save our men.

value.name: caption
value.value: Sergeant, do you hear me? We have info about the flying saucers.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is the Strategic Intelligence Division. Flying saucers are unmanned drones, meaning that we can still defeat them, even if they outnumber us.

value.name: caption
value.value: The color of the drone is the key. A blue drone is in alert mode and is presumed to be harmless. So the drones that glow in blue are not dangerous.

value.name: caption
value.value: But under certain circumstances, the drones will turn red. Red Color Drones are in Combat Mode. They are killing machines that can trace and kill their targets.

value.name: caption
value.value: The drones in this area are all in alert mode. Don't fight all drones at once. Lure a few of them each time, and then destroy them one by one.

value.name: caption
value.value: Use this method well and you can win.

value.name: caption
value.value: Blue means alert mode. Red means combat mode.

value.name: caption
value.value: They are machines anyway. Once we know its mechanics, we can deal with them.

value.name: caption
value.value: After some detailed analysis, we have figured out the conditions in which the alert mode switches to combat mode. There are three conditions:

value.name: caption
value.value: First, humans reach closest point of approach distance.

value.name: caption
value.value: Third, when a drone is hit, nearby drones will turn into combat mode. That means, the drone that was hit will inform the drones around it about the enemy.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Dolphin. We have no way to run. We will go out of the buildings and strike back.

value.name: caption
value.value: Aren't the Rescue Teams here yet?

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Rabbit team. We will fight till the end. Charge!

value.name: caption
value.value: There is no time to waste now. Sergeant, support the Dolphin team and the Rabbit team right away.

value.name: caption
value.value: I don't know who our enemies are, but there is no doubt that they are powerful. And they plan to kill us all and destroy everything.

value.name: caption
value.value: I really don't want to fight them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Save our men and get out of here now!

value.name: caption
value.value: Defeat those things and get out of here now.

value.name: caption
value.value: Thank god, it's the reinforcement! But what is a civilian doing here?

value.name: caption
value.value: Thank you so much! But what is a civilian doing here?

value.name: caption
value.value: Well done, Sergeant. Destroy the rest of the drones.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is the Chief Commander of the EDF. We are currently at war with the hostile force. Unfortunately, we suffered a preemptive strike and lost many bases. In addition, our enemy has been launching indiscriminate attacks on our cities by dropping monsters. As I am speaking, the casualties are increasing. Everyone, we have no choice but to fight.

value.name: caption
value.value: We did an amazing job. If we can analyze the data, we might be able to change the tide.

value.name: caption
value.value: Civilian, you are pretty good. This time I will definitely take you to a safe place.

value.name: caption
value.value: It is our duty to protect citizens after all.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have approached the mothership successfully.

value.name: caption
value.value: Attacking the mothership right from below might work.

value.name: caption
value.value: Flying saucers are coming out from the mothership!

value.name: caption
value.value: The flying saucers are only unmanned drones, so we should be able to shoot them down with infantry weapons. All units, start anti-aircraft attacks.

value.name: caption
value.value: Flying saucers are coming out from the mothership!

value.name: caption
value.value: The mothership seems to have immeasurable power. We can't let it cause more casualties.

value.name: caption
value.value: All units, retreat. We have to regroup!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's not just unsafe. This is worse than before.

value.name: caption
value.value: The civilians are in greater danger than we are.

value.name: caption
value.value: Sergeant, please give us a hand, destroy the monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: This monster can shoot out threads!

value.name: caption
value.value: Beware of the thread! Once you get tangled, you can't move!

value.name: caption
value.value: I don't think we can get it done!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Ranger 3. We are fighting thread-shooting monsters. Two of us got injured.

value.name: caption
value.value: The monsters are too strong! Let's back off!

value.name: caption
value.value: If you don't get tangled, there's nothing to fear. What!?

value.name: caption
value.value: There are monsters dead ahead of us. Just my luck.

value.name: caption
value.value: No, you are wrong. Monsters are everywhere in the world, not just here.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is the Strategic Intelligence Division. The black monsters we encountered before will be called 'α' from now on. The ones that shoot threads will be called 'β'.

value.name: caption
value.value: Although the species β monsters are slow, they can unleash threads with acid, so they are very dangerous.

value.name: caption
value.value: Large flying saucers are appearing everywhere. They keep dropping monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: We know. The monsters are everywhere.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy seems to drop the monsters intensively in this area.

value.name: caption
value.value: We confirmed that the enemy already dropped monsters in this area before. Maybe they want to use this place as a monster colony. Please stay alert.

value.name: caption
value.value: Everyone, look! It's a large flying saucer!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's too difficult to destroy the large flying saucer. But at least you should wipe out the monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: Attention, everyone. This is the Chief Commander. We were ambushed by the enemy and suffered great loss. The ravages of war have spread all over the world, and are even getting more serious. It is unfortunate that we were heavily stricken by the enemy at our first battle, but we are not lost yet. The most urgent matter at hand, is that our people are still in danger. We must pull ourselves together, and start our counterattack. The EDF shall rise again. And the time is now.

value.name: caption
value.value: Keep shooting! Take down the monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: Did they try to ambush us?

value.name: caption
value.value: Are these the monsters that were dropped before? Are they all lurking underground?

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't leave them like this. Destroy them all.

value.name: caption
value.value: You are already a good soldier. Just sign up and join us. The EDF could use someone like you.

value.name: caption
value.value: We welcome you with open arms!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is the best job ever... as long as there are no monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: Have you made up your mind to become a soldier?

value.name: caption
value.value: You don't need to worry about your life after retirement.

value.name: caption
value.value: Though you will be disappointed by the amount of the death gratuity.

value.name: caption
value.value: Civilian, this time I will definitely take you to a safe place.

value.name: caption
value.value: If there is really such a place.

value.name: caption
value.value: Pylons are being dropped. Stay alert.

value.name: caption
value.value: Sergeant! Pylons are being dropped from the sky!!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's the monsters that shoot threads!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's species β and they are coming!

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't leave the pylon like that. Destroy it before it causes more casualties!

value.name: caption
value.value: If we don't destroy the pylons, the monsters will take over the city!

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy's plan is to fill the city with monsters, but we won't let that happen. Destroy the pylons and stop the enemy's plan!

value.name: name
value.value: 民間女性アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: Earlier today, EDF made a shocking announcement. According to EDF, the flying objects all around the world are spaceships of an extraterrestrial civilization. EDF also made the radar records public. The data showed the moment when numerous flying objects showed up on the Earth's orbit. The data record was so shocking that everyone at the press conference, including journalists, were speechless. Now journalists from all around the world are crowding at EDF Headquarters, and it's chaotic on the scene.

value.name: name
value.value: 民間男性アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: Now there are numerous people crowding at the EDF Headquarters and it's chaotic on the scene. Not only the press, but many citizens have gathered here. There are people questioning the announcement, asking about EDF's plans, or seeking protection. We can hear requests turning into yelling everywhere.

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't believe we are fighting aliens!

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm totally fine with it. I saw the flying saucers with my own eyes so I have to accept it.

value.name: caption
value.value: Civilian, I promise I'll take you to a safe place.

value.name: caption
value.value: Sergeant, assign troops to protect the civilians. Take them to safety.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'll take you to a safe place this time for sure.

value.name: caption
value.value: We all can get a rest once we get there.

value.name: caption
value.value: First I will have a nice meal, and...

value.name: caption
value.value: Shush! I think I heard something!

value.name: caption
value.value: This place isn't safe! It is more dangerous than before!

value.name: caption
value.value: There are more than we can manage!

value.name: caption
value.value: Its skin is so tough! The bullets just bounced off!

value.name: caption
value.value: They are tougher than the black monsters. This is hopeless!

value.name: caption
value.value: They're tough but there's no acid! We can win!

value.name: caption
value.value: These things don't spit acid, so don't give up!

value.name: caption
value.value: The weapons of the red monsters are their fang! Shoot them dead before they get closer!

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't give up even if you get bitten! Just shoot the monsters dead!

value.name: caption
value.value: Shoot the monsters dead even if you get bitten!

value.name: caption
value.value: We have each other's back! Save me if I get caught!

value.name: name
value.value: 民間男性アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: The EDF Headquarters are on lockdown after declaring emergency. Protesters who are against this decision are confronting the police.

value.name: caption
value.value: Attention everyone. This is the Chief Commander. I have an important announcement to make. The identity of the hostile forces... is presumed to be an extraterrestrial civilization.

value.name: caption
value.value: I understand how you feel. Some may find it unbelievable while others may think I'm mad. I wish that is the case but unfortunately it's all real. This is an official statement. We have made contact with an extraterrestrial civilization, and the Earth is being invaded by it.

value.name: name
value.value: 国営放送アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: This is an emergency newsflash. EDF just made a major announcement. Spaceships were discovered, and presumed to be owned by extraterrestrials. The spaceships have arrived on the Earth's orbit, and the EDF has started battling with aliens in some regions.

value.name: name
value.value: 国営放送アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: Many of you must be surprised but this is a formal broadcast. This is not a promotion for a film or a TV show, nor a prank. We are currently at war with extraterrestrials. However don't panic and stay calm. Currently there is no countermeasure for this situation. Please stay tuned for updates. If evacuation is required in your area, there will be evacuation alarms.

value.name: caption
value.value: Attention everyone. This is the Chief Commander. The enemy is coming from the sky. There is nowhere safe on Earth. The Earth is turning into a battlefield now. I hope all of you are prepared and ready to stand on the frontline.

value.name: caption
value.value: There're no more comforting words I can say, I think you've already figured it out yourself...

value.name: caption
value.value: C'mon. We all get it in a situation like this.

value.name: caption
value.value: Leave the large flying saucers to the Air Force. Defeat the monsters on the ground.

value.name: caption
value.value: A troop of large flying saucers is about to fly over this area. Exterminate the monsters being deployed.

value.name: caption
value.value: The air force will shoot down the flying saucers. They will start the attack soon.

value.name: caption
value.value: The air force is attacking. All infantry, back off.

value.name: caption
value.value: Back off! Or we will get caught in the air raid!

value.name: caption
value.value: Hell no! I don't want to die by friendly fire!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Sky Bat. Commence attack.

value.name: caption
value.value: You think you can beat us with those weapons?

value.name: caption
value.value: They didn't dodge because there's no need.

value.name: caption
value.value: We must stop the monsters here! Don't let them enter the city!

value.name: caption
value.value: Large flying saucers are dropping monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: A large troop of flying saucers is coming from above. Beware!

value.name: caption
value.value: The air force is about to strike. Back off!

value.name: caption
value.value: Our targets are huge. You can't miss.

value.name: caption
value.value: What is the secret behind that golden armor?

value.name: caption
value.value: Is there nothing we can do about those aliens?

value.name: caption
value.value: If our attacks don't work, we can't put up a fight. If we can't retaliate, we are just sitting ducks.

value.name: caption
value.value: If we can't find a way to penetrate the golden armor, mankind is lost.

value.name: caption
value.value: The flying saucers have passed! Our operation failed!

value.name: caption
value.value: At least take down the monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: We have to bring our A game just to kill the monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: If we can't shoot down the large flying saucers, the monsters will keep multiplying.

value.name: caption
value.value: Guess we have to put our lives at risk for this one.

value.name: caption
value.value: Attacks on the large flying saucers was ineffective? There's no way mankind can win!

value.name: caption
value.value: Goddamn aliens! Think they can do as they please!

value.name: name
value.value: 国営放送アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: This is a war situation report. Although the EDF caused tremendous damage to the aliens, the battle is still continuing. We have the upper hand. Please do not be influenced by rumors. Stay calm, and don't panic.  There will be evacuation alarms in areas where evacuation is required. In order to act rapidly in case of evacuation, please start preparing your basic necessities, and be ready.

value.name: name
value.value: 民間女性アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: The visitors from outer space have been dubbed 'Primers' by EDF. Since we are at war, negotiation attempts have ended. The EDF has been criticized for its lack of effort in keeping the door to dialogue with the visitors open. It may  not be the best policy to give up on peace talks at the initial stage. Shouldn't we continue to seek dialogue with Primers?

value.name: caption
value.value: Attention, everyone. This is the Chief Commander. About 10 days ago, we found out that countless unidentified flying objects appeared on the Earth's orbit without any signs.

value.name: caption
value.value: These flying objects all flew to Earth at the same time and started dropping monsters. Their targets were all major cities around the world, and air force bases. We must rise and fight for our survival.

value.name: caption
value.value: Obviously the flying saucers are dropping monsters that are larger than their own mass. They are probably equipped with the same teleportation device used by the pylons.

value.name: caption
value.value: Does this technology teleport objects? That's amazing!

value.name: caption
value.value: We will call the enemy's transporting technology 'teleportation' from now on.

value.name: caption
value.value: If you want to go home, then we have to take it back from those aliens.

value.name: caption
value.value: Have all the enemies gathered here?

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like the situation is the same everywhere.

value.name: caption
value.value: How big is the alien army?

value.name: caption
value.value: The large flying saucers are dropping monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: Try to take out the monsters and protect the citizens!

value.name: caption
value.value: Why are aliens doing this to us?

value.name: caption
value.value: What are the aliens trying to do to us?

value.name: caption
value.value: Kill us all! That's for sure!

value.name: caption
value.value: There are too many of them. If they all start deploying monsters, we won't be able to kill them all!

value.name: caption
value.value: So there's no way to take down those large flying saucers?

value.name: caption
value.value: What the hell is the air force doing?

value.name: caption
value.value: There's no end to this. If we don't come up with someting fast, it'll become a monster carnival!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's impossible to kill them all!

value.name: caption
value.value: The large flying saucers that deploy monsters will be called 'teleportation ships' from now on.

value.name: caption
value.value: Isn't there a way to shoot down the teleportation ships?

value.name: caption
value.value: No one has had any success. The hull of the teleportation ship seems to be protected by some kind of barrier. We can't even make a scratch.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's only a matter of time till we run out of gas. We must find a way to breakthrough.

value.name: caption
value.value: The air force is preparaing a new type of aircraft now.

value.name: caption
value.value: A new type? Does that mean there's a way to destroy the teleportation ships?

value.name: caption
value.value: Perhaps. But it will take some time.

value.name: caption
value.value: So that means it'll be to our disadvantage for the next 2 months.

value.name: caption
value.value: All we can do now is defeat the monsters and prevent more damage.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's the end of the world.

value.name: caption
value.value: At this rate, mankind will soon be extinct.

value.name: caption
value.value: I don't think we can hold them off long enough for the air force to destroy the flying saucers...

value.name: caption
value.value: Is the whole world like this now?

value.name: caption
value.value: The end of the world is coming. Can't believe it is really happening.

value.name: caption
value.value: Pull it together. We will be okay after we defeat the monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are far more monsters than we can handle. At this rate, it's only a matter of time till our society collapses.

value.name: caption
value.value: The monsters are outside! Do something!

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters! Monsters are running in the street!

value.name: caption
value.value: Someone just saw monsters! Where should we evacuate?

value.name: name
value.value: 国営放送アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: This is a war situation report. Looking at the big picture, we have the upper hand. Although aliens keep dropping monsters, the EDF has exterminated more than half of them, suppressing the threat from enemy successfully. Furthermore, the EDF has announced the development of a new weapon which will be able to turn the tides of war. The new weapon will be completed in 2 months, and will be deployed in all areas in 4 months. It will be able to destroy large flying saucers, so it will give us a chance to defeat the alien armada.

value.name: caption
value.value: Civilian, you are stronger and braver than anyone else. You know what to do, right?

value.name: caption
value.value: When the whole world turns in to a battlefield, all we can do is fight.

value.name: caption
value.value: I trust you have my back.

value.name: caption
value.value: You look like you mean business.

value.name: caption
value.value: Hey, newbie. Does the army ration suit your palate?

value.name: caption
value.value: After five months of war, the situation has only gotten worse!

value.name: caption
value.value: That's because we put all our hopes on the air force!

value.name: caption
value.value: How are the new types doing?

value.name: caption
value.value: Isn't there a way to shoot down the teleportation ships?

value.name: caption
value.value: There's only one successful case so far, and that was with the use of tactical nuclear weapons.

value.name: caption
value.value: But we do not recommend this. We won't be able to salvage the teleportation ships if we use nukes.

value.name: caption
value.value: Attention everyone, this is the Chief Commander. The alien attack is still under way. The entire Earth has become a battlefield, and people everywhere are in harm's way. Our attack against the alien spaceship remains ineffective, and there is nothing we can do for now. But EDF always prevails, and until we can launch a full-fledged counter strike, I hope the ground units can keep exterminating the monsters and protect our citizens. This is a tough war, but I expect all of us to fight bravely. Do not forget we have defenseless citizens depending on us. We are not only on the front line, we are also the last line of defense.

value.name: name
value.value: 国営放送アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: This is a war situation report. In order to stop the enemy from dropping monsters, EDF launched attacks against the large flying saucers, and damaged them successfully. The war situation is getting better. In addition, EDF is developing a new type of aircraft, which will be able to destroy the enemy's shield. The development will be completed soon.

value.name: caption
value.value: As long as the teleportation ships exist, the war situation won't change.

value.name: caption
value.value: They keep coming, one after the other! The fight will never end!

value.name: caption
value.value: Now that the attacks by the new types failed, the only thing we can do is keep killing  monsters...

value.name: caption
value.value: We have lost 20% of the total population in the past 5 months. Soon the human race will be facing extinction.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Outpost 48. Calling for backup. We can't hold them off any longer.

value.name: caption
value.value: We lost half of our men! We have to retreat!

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemies are almost at the gate now!

value.name: caption
value.value: We can still make it! Run for your lives!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Outpost 26. Flying saucers are swarming in. Request for backup.

value.name: caption
value.value: Leave it to us! We are going to destroy the teleportation ships from the ground!

value.name: caption
value.value: Sergeant, is there a chance of winning?

value.name: caption
value.value: A hatch opens up when the monsters are being dropped. We can shoot right into the open hatch from the ground.

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't believe we are going under the transportation ships!

value.name: caption
value.value: We have been fighting monsters for the past five months. We have reached out limit. If we don't win today, mankind will lose!

value.name: caption
value.value: Got it. It's all or nothing!

value.name: caption
value.value: We are getting a medal of honor for this if this works out!

value.name: caption
value.value: If we can shoot down this teleportation ship, we will finally see a ray of hope in this war. Good luck.

value.name: caption
value.value: The aliens plan to exterminate us with monsters, but I am going to put an end to it!

value.name: caption
value.value: Let's finish what the air force failed to do.

value.name: caption
value.value: If we can shoot down the large flying saucers, the aliens' plan will fail. And it will be our victory.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Fencer. We will cover the attack team. Leave the monsters to us.

value.name: caption
value.value: If the air force can't get the job done, we'll have to do it ourselves!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長2

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Wing Diver. Heading in to cover the attack team.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長2

value.name: caption
value.value: This small-scale operation is going to be THE turning point that will turn the tide.

value.name: caption
value.value: There is a red light inside the hatch.

value.name: caption
value.value: The red light might be the teleportation device.

value.name: caption
value.value: Attack the shining part once the hatch opens.

value.name: caption
value.value: Now we can say goodbye to the monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: Usually there are monsters patrolling under the teleportation ships, so the enemies didn't expect that we could break through their defense and approach from the ground.

value.name: caption
value.value: Amazing job. Well done. This vital information will bring us closer to victory. I am sending it to the whole world now.

value.name: caption
value.value: What a stunning display! We have obtained valuable data.

value.name: caption
value.value: Well done, newbie. Keep up the good work!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長3

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士1

value.name: caption
value.value: It seems that evacuation hasn't completed yet!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長3

value.name: caption
value.value: This is a residential area! If we don't exterminate the monsters immediately, there will be casualties!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長3

value.name: caption
value.value: Newbie! Time to show your courage!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士2

value.name: caption
value.value: These are species α monsters. They're no match for us.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士2

value.name: caption
value.value: The monsters have been confirmed to be species β, they are tricky monsters that can shoot threads.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士3

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長3

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長3

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士1

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長3

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長3

value.name: caption
value.value: For a new recruit, you handle yourself pretty good.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長3

value.name: caption
value.value: OK, let's go! Exterminate all monsters!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士2

value.name: caption
value.value: Those civilians are trying to escape!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長3

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士1

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長3

value.name: caption
value.value: We wiped out most of the monsters. Only a few remain.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士3

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士1

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士2

value.name: caption
value.value: Seems like they dug holes and are hiding underground.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士3

value.name: caption
value.value: Can't believe they are hiding down there!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長3

value.name: caption
value.value: Did they just came from underground?

value.name: caption
value.value: Did the monsters dig an underground tunnel?

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士1

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters are coming to the ground!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長3

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士1

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like I was saved by the newbie.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士2

value.name: caption
value.value: You're amazing! Do you want to join our team officially?

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士3

value.name: caption
value.value: Incredible. Are you really a newbie?

value.name: caption
value.value: The debris of the teleportation ship has been recovered. Maybe we can learn how to destroy the golden armor.

value.name: caption
value.value: We've received reports about two teleportation ships being shot down in New York, and three in London. We are gradually seizing the initiative of the war.

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't underestimate the enemy. We only jeopardized their plan A. I am sure they will start the next wave of attack.

value.name: caption
value.value: We thought about that, too, but we should have some time before the enemy start plan B. All we can do now is try to weaken their combat strength.

value.name: caption
value.value: Then let's do it. We will win this battle as well.

value.name: caption
value.value: Attention, everyone. This is the Chief Commander. We discovered an overwhelming gigantic ship among the flying objects. The pylons crashing from the skies are also launched by this ship. This type of ship is now designated as 'Mothership'. Taking down the mothership will be our ultimate goal.

value.name: caption
value.value: He is talking about that massive thing, right?

value.name: caption
value.value: So, if we destroy that thing, the aliens will be doomed.

value.name: caption
value.value: Now that we found the enemy's mothership, all we have to do is shoot it down. I like our chances.

value.name: caption
value.value: Furthermore, we've identified a total of 10 Motherships. They are scattered around the world and are continuously launching pylons. We must take down all 10 of them.

value.name: caption
value.value: I don't think the air force is capable of taking down 10 of them...

value.name: caption
value.value: A mothership has appeared in Europe. It silently hovers over the city.

value.name: caption
value.value: It must be on to something...

value.name: caption
value.value: We think this is a good opportunity. We are planning an operation to attack the mothership.

value.name: caption
value.value: Air raid has already failed, but if we approach the mothership from the ground, it is possible to do some damage.

value.name: caption
value.value: Yeah, and it's No. 9. The 9th one out of 10.

value.name: caption
value.value: Ground units, attack the monsters. The air force will handle the mothership.

value.name: caption
value.value: AFVs, move out. Infantry, move with the AFVs.

value.name: caption
value.value: That's a ship? It's as big as a city!

value.name: caption
value.value: Their technology is on a completely different level.

value.name: caption
value.value: I say what we lack in technology, we make up in bravery!

value.name: caption
value.value: Head straight to the central plaza.

value.name: caption
value.value: Infantry, stay close to the AFVs. The cover fire will help us to move up.

value.name: caption
value.value: It scares the hell out of me that this gigantic thing is above my head .

value.name: caption
value.value: There's no way we can survive if it crashes down.

value.name: caption
value.value: The air force must have failed. Or else it wouldn't be our turn.

value.name: caption
value.value: What the hell is the Mothership trying to do?

value.name: caption
value.value: Anyway, just take out the monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: Oh, no! I just saw aliens! I can't believe they are real!

value.name: caption
value.value: What the hell? We've been fighting those outer space monsters all this time and it just came to you?

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm not talking about monsters, I'm talking about humanoid aliens!

value.name: caption
value.value: We have a report of sighting of humanoid aliens.

value.name: caption
value.value: You mean aliens that look like humans?

value.name: caption
value.value: One head. Two eyes. With hands and feet. Bipedal.

value.name: caption
value.value: Almost identical to humans. This is unbelievable.

value.name: caption
value.value: You think you can come and go as you please?!

value.name: caption
value.value: The air force will pursue it.

value.name: caption
value.value: Something is approaching! It's... alien flying ships!

value.name: caption
value.value: Something is descending from the flying ship!

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't believe it! They're aliens!

value.name: caption
value.value: Aliens are descending from the flying ship!

value.name: caption
value.value: So that is the enemy's landing ship...

value.name: caption
value.value: That alien is a soldier! The alien infantry is here!

value.name: caption
value.value: They're coming! We will get killed if we don't strike back!

value.name: caption
value.value: Aliens have finally landed on Earth!

value.name: caption
value.value: Are they aliens? They look just like humans!

value.name: caption
value.value: Permission to engage the aliens granted. Ground units, commence attack on those aliens.

value.name: caption
value.value: They look just like humans. The resemblance is unbelievable!

value.name: caption
value.value: They have mouth too! They look like they are talking!

value.name: caption
value.value: So they have their own language just like humans?

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Delta team. We are engaging an alien infantry unit.

value.name: caption
value.value: More aliens are landing on the ground!

value.name: caption
value.value: Hold your ground! No way we're handing over the city!

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemies are hiding in the shadows of buildings!

value.name: caption
value.value: Show them what the EDF infantry is made of!

value.name: caption
value.value: T-The enemies are attacking us from the side.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Delta team. The enemy is trying to out maneuver us! They are trained military soldiers!

value.name: caption
value.value: They're soldiers! Someone is giving them orders!

value.name: caption
value.value: I've never killed anyone. I can't do this!

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't believe it! Their wounds are healing!

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like the aliens can regenerate their bodies too!

value.name: caption
value.value: They can recover fast even during injury, keep shooting till they are dead!

value.name: caption
value.value: All aliens on the ground have been exterminated.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are more in the air!

value.name: caption
value.value: There are way too many enemies. Retreat!

value.name: caption
value.value: Ground units, attack the monsters. The air force will handle the mothership.

value.name: caption
value.value: AFVs, move out. Infantry, move with the AFVs.

value.name: caption
value.value: Do not fear! Shoot down the flying saucers!

value.name: caption
value.value: Air force strike to the mothership, countdown 5 minutes.

value.name: caption
value.value: Something is approaching! It's... alien flying ships!

value.name: caption
value.value: Something is descending from the flying ship!

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't believe it! They're aliens!

value.name: caption
value.value: Aliens are descending from the flying ship!

value.name: caption
value.value: So that is the enemy's landing ship...

value.name: caption
value.value: That alien is a soldier! The alien infantry is here!

value.name: caption
value.value: They're coming! We will be killed if we don't fight back!

value.name: caption
value.value: Aliens have finally landed on Earth!

value.name: caption
value.value: Are they aliens? They are just like humans!

value.name: caption
value.value: Permission to engage with aliens granted. Ground units, engage the aliens.

value.name: caption
value.value: Describe what the aliens look like.

value.name: caption
value.value: Just like us. They have limbs, a head and two eyes.

value.name: caption
value.value: They look just like us. The resemblance is unbelievable!

value.name: caption
value.value: They have mouth too! Looks like they are talking!

value.name: caption
value.value: So they have their own language, just like us...

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Gamma team. We are engaging an alien infantry unit.

value.name: caption
value.value: More aliens are landing on the ground!

value.name: caption
value.value: Hold your ground! No way we're handing over the city!

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemies are hiding in the shadows of buildings!

value.name: caption
value.value: Show them what the EDF infantry is made of!

value.name: caption
value.value: T-The enemies are attacking from the sides!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Team Gamma. The enemy is trying to out maneuver us! They are trained military soldiers!

value.name: caption
value.value: All aliens on the ground have been exterminated.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are more in the air!

value.name: caption
value.value: Something is landing! Look like robots!

value.name: caption
value.value: They are different from the ones before!

value.name: caption
value.value: First aliens, and now a robot army?

value.name: caption
value.value: The robots are taking over the city!

value.name: caption
value.value: No way we're losing the ground battle. Hold the frontline! Earth belongs to US!

value.name: caption
value.value: Unlike the ones before, these aren't humanoids!

value.name: caption
value.value: They don't look like humans at all!

value.name: caption
value.value: What? Aliens with a different appearance compared to humans...

value.name: caption
value.value: I won't allow any unlawful occupation! Even if you are aliens!

value.name: caption
value.value: These guys are trained! They are alien special forces!

value.name: caption
value.value: These soldiers are big but agile!

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemies are coming from the right side!

value.name: caption
value.value: They are coming from the left!

value.name: caption
value.value: Back off! Or we will be annihilated.

value.name: caption
value.value: From behind! They are flanking from behind!

value.name: caption
value.value: I saw their faces. They have two eyes on their face. Like humans, they see things with their eyes, and we can use this against them. I don't think they are able to attack something they can't see, so when they attack us, we just hide in the shadows of buildings.

value.name: caption
value.value: But it's dangerous to keep hiding in the same place. The enemy will keep aiming at the same location where the targets vanished, thinking that the targets will show up at that place again. That means, the enemy usually pays special attention to the place their targets are last seen. So once you hide yourself, move to different places right away, and you will be able to flank the enemy from behind. Get it?

value.name: caption
value.value: We are smaller in terms of size, so it should be hard for the enemy to see us. As long as we don't attack them, they won't notice even if we get close. So try to get closer to the enemy to attack them. All we need is courage.

value.name: caption
value.value: But they have ears too. They can hear our footsteps and the sounds created by our equipment, so if we are too close, they will still notice us.

value.name: caption
value.value: When engaging aliens, we will have a better advantage in buildings and other locations that will provide cover. If we're attacked we can hide and move to the enemy's blind spot for a counter attack.

value.name: caption
value.value: Class dismissed. Let's get down to business.

value.name: caption
value.value: Well, my class seems to be helpful. You are a good student.

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't forget what I just taught you.

value.name: caption
value.value: Hold your fire. If they find us, we're doomed.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's too hard to deal with all of them at once. We have to take them out one by one.

value.name: caption
value.value: If we all attack the same alien together, we will win.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have to work together, okay?

value.name: caption
value.value: They will find us sooner or later. So we have to do it.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士4

value.name: caption
value.value: I can escape alone, but I can't leave my friends behind.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm surrounded by the aliens. I'm done.

value.name: caption
value.value: A last gig? Count me in.

value.name: caption
value.value: The aliens have completely taken over this place. Stay alert.

value.name: caption
value.value: There's no other way than getting rid off those aliens. Let's go!

value.name: caption
value.value: There are some units remaining in the city. I want to know the situation.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Scout. Aliens have started moving. The number of aliens that occupy the city is decreasing.

value.name: caption
value.value: Attention to the units in the city. The bulk of the alien army has left the region. Now is your chance to escape. Defeat the surrounding enemies, and secure the escape route.

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't expect anyone to rescue us.

value.name: caption
value.value: We can only rely on ourselves.

value.name: caption
value.value: Attack their feet! That can slow them down!

value.name: caption
value.value: Even so, it will still buy us some time.

value.name: caption
value.value: Attack their weapon-holding hand! Then they won't be able to use weapons before a new hand generates!

value.name: caption
value.value: Headshots can kill aliens instantly, but it's too hard to shoot one in the head. Attack the body, try to knock them down!

value.name: caption
value.value: You survived! Looks like we two are bound by fate. Let's try making it through alive.

value.name: name
value.value: 民間女性アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: This is special newsflash. We've learned that the aliens that appeared in Europe look like humans. They walk on two feet, use weapons and tools with two hands, and can communicate in their language. Right now many groups are planning to negotiate with the aliens. If a negotiation could take place, we might be able to resolve the conflict peacefully.

value.name: caption
value.value: Is it really impossible to open talks with the aliens?

value.name: caption
value.value: All attempts have utterly failed. The entire negotiation team has been killed.

value.name: caption
value.value: Newbie, your bravery is impressive. Well done.

value.name: caption
value.value: Not only the aliens, but the monsters are here, too.

value.name: caption
value.value: If we are to attack the monsters, we have to get to a better position. Let's head to the ground.

value.name: caption
value.value: We are so much alike! Do we really need to fight each other?

value.name: caption
value.value: They're trying to kill us! Don't hesitate!

value.name: caption
value.value: The aliens and monsters are in it together!

value.name: caption
value.value: The monsters aren't attacking the aliens!

value.name: caption
value.value: Maybe the monsters don't attack those who are larger than them?

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like the aliens are commanding the monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: So, the monsters can understand orders given by the aliens?

value.name: caption
value.value: This means the aliens are using the monsters as their weapon.

value.name: caption
value.value: The monsters are taking orders from the aliens!

value.name: caption
value.value: So, they use monsters as their weapons. The cruelest and most brutal weapons imaginable.

value.name: caption
value.value: Goddamn aliens! Rampaging on Earth as they please.

value.name: caption
value.value: Are they trying to turn Earth into a ranch??

value.name: caption
value.value: There are 7 billion human fodders on Earth. The monsters will be well raised.

value.name: caption
value.value: Doing as they please on someone else's planet!

value.name: caption
value.value: No pets allowed here. Somebody should tell them.

value.name: caption
value.value: And no unleashed animals. Have they no manners?

value.name: caption
value.value: You just love your pets that much, huh!?

value.name: caption
value.value: Then we'll send your pets to hell!

value.name: caption
value.value: They look like us! I can't do it!

value.name: caption
value.value: They are carrying weapons! If you don't kill them, you'll be killed!

value.name: caption
value.value: There are more!? This isn't what I signed up for.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are more than we can manage by ourselves.

value.name: caption
value.value: Quit whining and start shooting! Let's go!

value.name: name
value.value: 国営放送アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: This is special newsflash. The aliens dispatched infantry units to Europe, but the EDF was sent in to engage the enemy, and secured a victory.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Ranger 2. We will attack when the last member arrives.

value.name: caption
value.value: Newbie. Ranger 2 went ahead and is engaged in combat now. Go join them now.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Ranger 2. Being attacked by monsters now!

value.name: caption
value.value: Let's move in and support the vanguard.

value.name: caption
value.value: So, you're the last member? Can't believe they sent a newbie to such a dangerous mission.

value.name: caption
value.value: Why sent us a newbie out of all people?

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't get terrified and run away.

value.name: caption
value.value: Move in. The vanguard should be somewhere.

value.name: caption
value.value: Could it be the monsters' nest?

value.name: caption
value.value: They are making the monsters build a nest!

value.name: caption
value.value: What the heck are the aliens doing?

value.name: caption
value.value: Are you saying that there will be more monsters?
