value.name: caption
value.value: It will be too late if they reproduce underground. We have to do something about it!

value.name: caption
value.value: Assault team, move in and exterminate the monsters. The situation inside the cave is unclear, so be cautious.

value.name: caption
value.value: This mission is very dangerous, but if we don't step in, they will certainly become a terrible threat in the future. We must eliminate all monsters underground now.

value.name: caption
value.value: Wing Divers have headed inside to scout. They should be somewhere nearby. Meet up with them as soon as you can.

value.name: caption
value.value: Wing Divers, meet up with the assault team.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長4

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長4

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長4

value.name: caption
value.value: I've been looking for you. I thought you ran away.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長4

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm not scared. That's for sure.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長4

value.name: caption
value.value: Want to keep moving? You are brave.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士5

value.name: caption
value.value: Want to move on? I don't really want to.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Fencer. I just sent the location to you. Looks like we covered more ground than anyone else.

value.name: caption
value.value: The follow-on forces are headed to your location. Move out after rendezvous.

value.name: caption
value.value: Are there other teams here besides us?

value.name: caption
value.value: Never expected you could make it this far. Impressive.

value.name: caption
value.value: A new extraterrestrial species has been confirmed. It is a larger species compared to species α and species β. It's approximately 70 meters long, and it's the largest alien creature we have ever seen so far.

value.name: caption
value.value: Because it is biologically much more different from species α and species β, it might need its own classification. So we will call it 'Erginus' from now on. Strategy talks are underway as we speak.

value.name: caption
value.value: There's a cave leading further inside.

value.name: caption
value.value: We aren't done yet!? What will happen next?

value.name: caption
value.value: Aliens are coming out from inside the cave!

value.name: caption
value.value: They are calling monsters for aid!

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters keep coming out from inside the cave!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長4

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長4

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters are coming out from the cave!

value.name: caption
value.value: There are just too many of them.

value.name: caption
value.value: There must be a monster nation further ahead!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's no use! Permission to retreat!

value.name: caption
value.value: Didn't expect so many enemies inside!

value.name: caption
value.value: Were all those monsters born inside the cave?

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn! It's too dangerous to move on. I hate to say this, but we should retreat.

value.name: caption
value.value: What on earth is up ahead?

value.name: caption
value.value: Exterminate the monsters in this area. Commence operation.

value.name: caption
value.value: We are professional monster exterminators. But don't let your guard down. You'll be dead if you get hit by the acid.

value.name: caption
value.value: The monsters are nothing to be afraid of!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is K Six. Operation failed. Target escaped. I repeat, operation failed. Target on the run.

value.name: caption
value.value: The attack on the mysterious monster Erginus has failed. Erginus is on the run. This area is on top of the escapte route.

value.name: caption
value.value: Erginus will indeed pass through this area.

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't tell me it WILL pass through. It is already here!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's too big! It's unlike any other monster we've seen before!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's deceptively quick for its size!

value.name: caption
value.value: No way I'll miss the target!

value.name: caption
value.value: Our bullets are like tiny mosquito bites!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's too big! We can't kill it!

value.name: caption
value.value: The tanks will arrive momentarily. Hang on.

value.name: caption
value.value: Citizens are in danger. You have to stall the enemy before the tanks arrive.

value.name: caption
value.value: How can a creature make an attack like that...

value.name: caption
value.value: The creature's power is beyond our understanding. What a terrifying opponent.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Bull Leader. Enemy confirmed.

value.name: caption
value.value: Support the infantry and protect the tanks.

value.name: caption
value.value: The tanks just arrived. Infantry, fall back behind the tanks.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Bull Leader. We suffer a great loss.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Dover Leader. We have arrived on the scene.

value.name: caption
value.value: Support the infantry and start individual attack on the enemy.

value.name: caption
value.value: Dover Leader. The enemy is tough. Be careful.

value.name: caption
value.value: New tanks have arrived. Infantry, use tanks as your covers.

value.name: caption
value.value: Bastards! It blasted the tank armor off like it was nothing!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Dover Leader, I'm hit! Save me--!

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't believe that our attacks didn't work. Its vital force is uncanny!

value.name: caption
value.value: How could this creature sustain direct attacks from cannons? Is it invincible?

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't cause damage to it with ground units. Retreat.

value.name: caption
value.value: Once we are back to the base, I'll buy you guys a good meal.

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't tell us we have to cook it ourselves.

value.name: caption
value.value: Please get us the best ingredients. No matter how bad we cook it, it will still be edible.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Powered Exoskeleton is making strange noises!

value.name: caption
value.value: That's because you have no idea how to handle it!

value.name: caption
value.value: Wait! I think I heard something!

value.name: caption
value.value: Look! There are monsters! The red ones!

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters are coming out from the sand!

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters were hiding out in the sand waiting for us!

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員3

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Cold 2, ready for battle!

value.name: caption
value.value: There is a swarm of enemies.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're too fast. It's impossible to run away.

value.name: caption
value.value: All we can do now is fight. Fire at will!

value.name: caption
value.value: Please reply. We are fighting the red monsters. Requesting support.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Scout. Red monsters sighted.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're coming! A large group of them!

value.name: caption
value.value: There are so many of them! Looks like a red carpet!

value.name: caption
value.value: We are at a disadvantage here! Descend to the shore!

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員3

value.name: caption
value.value: The Powered Exoskeletons will stay behind.

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員4

value.name: caption
value.value: The Powered Exoskeletons will hold off the enemy! Everyone, head to the shore!

value.name: caption
value.value: We will hold off the enemy. You all go down to the shore!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's the Fencer's duty to stay behind!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is a great vantage point! Shoot! Take out all monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: There are no covers at the shore! Fire at will!

value.name: caption
value.value: Their shells are too thick! We can't shoot them dead!

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't freak out! We can bring it down if we keep on shooting!

value.name: caption
value.value: Keep on firing and it'll evantually get hit! Fire at will!

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't give up! Fight to the end!

value.name: caption
value.value: Hang on! The support will come, I'm sure!

value.name: caption
value.value: Infantry units, hide behind the tanks. Leave the enemy to us.

value.name: caption
value.value: We're okay. We can manage it somehow.

value.name: caption
value.value: Ground units, sorry to keep you waiting. We are here to support you.

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't get overwhelmed by the impact.

value.name: caption
value.value: The air raid is starting! Stay away!

value.name: caption
value.value: Easier for you now, isn't it? We'll leave the rest to you.

value.name: name
value.value: 国営放送アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: The war with the Primers is far from over. Although EDF is able to stand against the enemies, the situation is becoming more overwhelming. We have the upper hand, but the situation has become stagnant. It is now a competition of patience, and the one who persists till the end will win. But there is no need to worry. We have prepared a trump card for this kind of situation, namely our three submarine carriers. The three carriers were immediately dispatched after the war begun, and they are waiting patiently under the sea. As long as we have Siren, Pandora and Epimetheus at our disposal, we can still put up a fight.

value.name: caption
value.value: The air raid made it in time. Although we suffered heavy casualties we saved several survivors.

value.name: caption
value.value: The air raid made it in time, but even if there are survivors, it's hard to deal with so many monsters...

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長5

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長5

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy did not see us. Get close and take them out at once!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長5

value.name: caption
value.value: Only we, the Spriggan, can complete this mission

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy did not see us. Get close and take them out at once!

value.name: caption
value.value: Show those monsters what the Spriggans are made of!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長5

value.name: caption
value.value: This mission is quite difficult for a newbie.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士6

value.name: caption
value.value: Can't believe they sent a newbie to support the Spriggan?

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士7

value.name: caption
value.value: It's not a mission for a newbie.

value.name: caption
value.value: They are calling monsters for aid! Exterminate the monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's an honor to fight alongside the Spriggan.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士8

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士9

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士10

value.name: caption
value.value: Oh no! They are calling monsters!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士11

value.name: caption
value.value: They seem to be calling monsters over!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長5

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters are coming? Let's exterminate them!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長5

value.name: caption
value.value: It's larger than a building! How did they do that?

value.name: caption
value.value: So they plan to live on Earth!

value.name: caption
value.value: They even built their own houses!

value.name: caption
value.value: Planes can't approach. The enemy's counter air system is perfect. We should attack from the ground.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy outpost is protected by anti-air artillery. We can only approach them from the ground.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have to take out those drones before we can attack the base!

value.name: caption
value.value: There are batteries around the base!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士12

value.name: caption
value.value: It's artillery fire from the base!

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't get close! If we stay here,  we will all die!

value.name: caption
value.value: Powered Exoskeletons, move out! Cover the infantry!

value.name: caption
value.value: Fencers, move in! We'll cover them!

value.name: caption
value.value: Move in with our shields! Block the artillery fire!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士13

value.name: caption
value.value: There are more drones than expected!

value.name: caption
value.value: If the drones attack us right now, we will get wiped out!

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't worry about the base! Take out the drones first!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士14

value.name: caption
value.value: Contact! Aliens are bringing in the monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Scout. We've confirmed aliens with monsters near the base.

value.name: caption
value.value: The base is protected by aliens and monsters. Attack the enemies around the base and break through their defense.

value.name: caption
value.value: Attacking the base is not working.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長6

value.name: caption
value.value: Our attack on the base was ineffective!

value.name: caption
value.value: The air strike didn't seem to work, either.

value.name: caption
value.value: Currently there are five alien bases around the world. Each of them was dropped from the sky.

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't believe they can deploy entire bases. Those aliens certainly came prepared.

value.name: caption
value.value: Which meas areas surrounding the base are supressed.

value.name: caption
value.value: We are here to protect the city, but I didn't expect this sight.

value.name: caption
value.value: I knew it wouldn't be a cakewalk.

value.name: caption
value.value: Our objective is to collect intel.

value.name: caption
value.value: I know. But we can't continue the mission anymore.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is G2. We are being attacked by the cannons!

value.name: caption
value.value: These are plasma cannons. Can't believe they have that kind of technology...

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士15

value.name: caption
value.value: The artillery fire is too strong!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士16

value.name: caption
value.value: We are being attacked by the base!

value.name: caption
value.value: Incoming fire! Get to cover before it's too late!

value.name: caption
value.value: Drones are dispatched from the base!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is G4. Confirmed that the giant cannons have been initiated.

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't continue like this. Retreat!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長6

value.name: caption
value.value: Oh no! If we let those drones chase us, the city will suffer heavy casualties!

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't let those drones spread out.  Shoot down the drones as you fall back!

value.name: caption
value.value: If we don't shoot down all of the drones, they will cause a lot of damage. Shoot down all drones.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are some drones remaining. Shoot them down.

value.name: caption
value.value: They'll be dominating the ground as long as the base exists. We've been outplayed.

value.name: caption
value.value: The drones are in alert mode. When they're hit, the drones around them will switch to combat mode.

value.name: caption
value.value: I have shot down 7 drones by myself! I am going to break my record today!

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't underestimate the drones. The fact that they're only machines makes them even more terrifying weapons.

value.name: caption
value.value: Make scrap metal out of them!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's got too much fire power!

value.name: caption
value.value: And they're fast, too! These things are tricky!

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't win! Pull us out!

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't deal with so many all at once! We must shoot them down one by one.

value.name: caption
value.value: We'll be killed if they follow us! We must fight to survive!

value.name: caption
value.value: Pretty good! It's the first time someone is better than me.

value.name: caption
value.value: I survived because of you. Can't thank you enough

value.name: caption
value.value: The results are great. I will send the data out to the world.

value.name: caption
value.value: An alien ship is outside! Please save us!

value.name: caption
value.value: I love you guys. Now run.

value.name: caption
value.value: Civilians can evacuate themselves! Focus on killing the aliens!

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't forget your mission! Wiping out the aliens is our priority!

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn! Is it an air maneuver operation?

value.name: caption
value.value: Citizens are still evacuating. Suppress the aliens in this area!

value.name: caption
value.value: 2 landing ships just entered the combat area.

value.name: caption
value.value: 3 landing ships just entered the combat area.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have an emergency! The alien army is landing!

value.name: caption
value.value: A large number of landing ships are heading toward the combat area.

value.name: caption
value.value: Our opponents are carrying fire arms!

value.name: caption
value.value: Not just carrying them! They've opened fire!

value.name: caption
value.value: We have overcome the barriers of culture, language and skin color to build the society we have today. Now it's time to overcome the barriers between planets. We have learned from our history that nothing is impossible.

value.name: caption
value.value: How do we resolve the conflicts with our neighbors? Do we use guns and bombs? No. That is not how it should be done. We engage in dialogue. That is the only way to resolve conflicts. This time we can certainly resolve our issues through dialogues as well.

value.name: caption
value.value: Some civilians are trying to negotiate with the aliens.

value.name: caption
value.value: Although some people expect dialogues, that's not what we're seeing on the scene.

value.name: caption
value.value: All negotiations have failed. It's not that we can't express ourselves, it's that they never wanted to talk in the first place.

value.name: caption
value.value: So it's only us thinking that we're both humanoids.

value.name: caption
value.value: They seems to see us as pests. Still we have to keep trying to negotiate.

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn! We aren't strong enough to put up a fight!?

value.name: caption
value.value: We won't make it this time!

value.name: caption
value.value: We are surrounded by the enemy. Send in support!

value.name: caption
value.value: It will take time for the Rescue Teams to arrive. Hold your ground.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Scout. A great number of enemies confirmed.

value.name: caption
value.value: This fight...will go down in history...

value.name: caption
value.value: You just witnessed and survived from hell, newbie. Come back for some rest.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy artillery unit is straight ahead!

value.name: caption
value.value: Teams that closed in on the artillery, attack now.

value.name: caption
value.value: Take out the enemy artillery unit.

value.name: caption
value.value: Defeat the artillery unit at all cost! As long as they exist, we can't win the ground warfare.

value.name: caption
value.value: Other teams are late, but there is no time to wait. Approach the artillery unit and take out as many as possible.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy weapons may be powerful, but they are designed for long-range support. We have a chance if we can get real close. Move in!

value.name: caption
value.value: So they are the alien artillery unit.

value.name: caption
value.value: Scout to HQ. Enemy artillery unit is closing in.

value.name: caption
value.value: Artillery unit incoming. Approach and attack.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Scout. Enemy artillery unit confirmed.

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemy landing ships have entered the area. They plan to drop aliens.

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemy landing ships coming up from behind!

value.name: caption
value.value: They cut off our retreat route!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Alpha. Aliens ahead. We are engaging the enemy. Huh!? The enemy is bombing us!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Delta! We are under the enemy's artillery fire!

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't stop attacking! Avoid the artillery fire!

value.name: caption
value.value: We suffered heavy casualties! Everybody died in the artillery fire!

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't approach because of the artillery fire!

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like someone is earlier than us.

value.name: caption
value.value: If we don't hurry, they will take all the credits.

value.name: caption
value.value: Artillery unit has been eliminated. We can win this!

value.name: caption
value.value: A large number of monsters confirmed. Stay alert.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長7

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士17

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters are coming out from the pylons!

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters are appearing from the pylons!

value.name: caption
value.value: Pylon guards confirmed!  Aliens are protecting the pylons.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士18

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士19

value.name: caption
value.value: Aliens seem to be guarding the pylons!

value.name: caption
value.value: There are aliens guarding the pylons!

value.name: caption
value.value: There should be several pylons. Find and destroy them.

value.name: caption
value.value: If we don't attack the pylons, this won't be an end to it!

value.name: caption
value.value: Those pylons will be called 'teleportation anchors'. Their weak spot is the glowing device on the top. If we only attack the top part, we can destroy them with infantry firearm.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are too many monsters! Destroy the pylons, quick!

value.name: caption
value.value: We're the best insect extermination team!

value.name: caption
value.value: Show them what the Blue Jackets are made of!

value.name: caption
value.value: We have killed countless monsters with this tactic! These things will be our prey, too!

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't get close to the enemy!

value.name: caption
value.value: Those tiny monsters have no chance against the Blue Jackets!

value.name: caption
value.value: Just finish the monsters before they approach! There is no need to fear!

value.name: caption
value.value: Snipers are the most fearsome enemies on the battlefield. Get it?

value.name: caption
value.value: There's an alien leading the monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: So the alien is the leader.

value.name: caption
value.value: You'll be in trouble if you get too close! Attack their feet to slow them down!

value.name: caption
value.value: I've to say, there are so many of them!

value.name: caption
value.value: I feel like I'm Napoleon Bonaparte!

value.name: caption
value.value: Like his victory in the Battle of Austerlitz!

value.name: caption
value.value: There are too many! We can't kill them all!

value.name: caption
value.value: Calm down! Take them down one by one!

value.name: caption
value.value: We are done for if this gets out of hand! Stop the monsters before they close in!

value.name: caption
value.value: There are too many! We can't stop them by ourselves!

value.name: caption
value.value: More are coming! From the sides!

value.name: caption
value.value: They are coming from the side!

value.name: caption
value.value: They are coming from both sides!

value.name: caption
value.value: They are attacking from the sides!

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't hold out any more!

value.name: caption
value.value: We are surrounded!! There's no way out!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is nothing like the Battle of Austerlitz, more like Waterloo!

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm out of ammo! I'm doomed!

value.name: caption
value.value: I don't want to be killed by a monster!

value.name: caption
value.value: Stay away from me! Back off!

value.name: caption
value.value: Are you a sniper, too? If not, go down there.

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn! The rain is blocking my vision.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm a shooting champion. I'm better than ten men combined. I'll protect you.

value.name: caption
value.value: Are you a sniper, too? We're the key to winning, so do your best.

value.name: caption
value.value: Fencers and Powered Exoskeletons are our shields now. We are in charge of sniping the enemies.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Fencer. They won't breach THIS wall.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Fencers and tanks will stop the enemy from going onward.

value.name: caption
value.value: Evacuation is not complete yet. There are defenseless civilians behind. We have to shield them off from the enemy!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Scout. Aliens are approaching.

value.name: caption
value.value: They are coming this way, too!

value.name: caption
value.value: We will provide cover! Sniper team, we are counting on you.

value.name: caption
value.value: Shoot them once they get close!

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy wants to breakthrough, but we won't allow that to happen. They shall not pass!

value.name: caption
value.value: Fierce battles are taking places in other areas as well. We have to hold this position.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Scout. Enemy landing ships confirmed. There are a lot of them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like they plan to get through here no matter what!

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like the enemy is focuing their attack and trying to breakthrough this area, so hold your ground!

value.name: caption
value.value: If they break through this area, the defense line will break down. You must hold them off at all cost.

value.name: caption
value.value: We are being attacked by the artillery unit!

value.name: caption
value.value: Look over there! The enemy artillery unit!

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemy artillery unit on the roof tops! They are attacking this way!

value.name: caption
value.value: Someone take out the artillery unit!

value.name: caption
value.value: We still can't let the enemy break through here.

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't hold them back anymore!

value.name: caption
value.value: At this rate, they are going to break through!

value.name: caption
value.value: We have requested air support, but only a few of them can get here right away.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's okay. I want to provide as much support as possible.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Blood Hawk. We are low on ammo and fuel. We can only attack once.

value.name: caption
value.value: Jesus Christ! It's remarkable that ground units can hold for this long.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm returning for supplies. Don't die on me, ground units.

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn! The line of defense is useless!

value.name: caption
value.value: What is the line of defense doing?

value.name: caption
value.value: Operation was a success. We have stopped the enemy and protected the citizens. Well done. The victory is ours!

value.name: caption
value.value: If this was a sci-fi movie, the aliens would be afraid of water.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's still possible. Once it rains, they will all drop dead.

value.name: caption
value.value: Those alien bastards look like they are afraid of water, but they aren't.

value.name: caption
value.value: So these bastards are turning Earth into a monster ranch?

value.name: caption
value.value: What is the fun of raising monsters?

value.name: caption
value.value: What the hell are they trying to do?

value.name: caption
value.value: Use the sandstorm as cover to approach enemy base. The enemies will have a hard time detecting you, but at the same time, your visions will be hampered, so be careful.

value.name: caption
value.value: Take out the monsters on sight.

value.name: caption
value.value: The sandstorm blocks off our field of view. Don't let your guard down.

value.name: caption
value.value: Now we can complete our mission without taking gunfire from the base.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm starting to think that the sandstorm is awesome.

value.name: caption
value.value: The demolition team will proceed at your side. Keep going and take out the enemy.

value.name: caption
value.value: Fencers are deployed to the right of the demolition team. And you guys will protect their left.

value.name: caption
value.value: That alien is controlling those monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: There is something in the sky!

value.name: caption
value.value: I've never seen such a violent sandstorm.

value.name: caption
value.value: Do the aliens have control over the weather?!

value.name: caption
value.value: Teleportation ships sighted in front of the base!

value.name: caption
value.value: The demolition team cannot approach under this condition. Take down the teleportation ships.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is the demolition team. Please take down the teleportation ships quickly.

value.name: caption
value.value: If we don't destroy the teleportation ship, we won't be able to approach the base.

value.name: caption
value.value: Demolition takes time. Take down the nearby enemies first.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have to get close to the base to set up the bombs. Take down the enemies nearby, hurry!

value.name: caption
value.value: The sandstorm is about to subside!

value.name: caption
value.value: Oh no, if we lose the sandstorm, they will spray us with bullets.

value.name: caption
value.value: If the sandstorm is gone, we will have no cover!

value.name: caption
value.value: So the aliens can control the monsters?

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like the aliens can control the monsters to a certain extent. We just found out that they can summon monsters from underground, and command them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Can't believe they can do this!

value.name: caption
value.value: If the operation succeeds, we will gain a tactical advantage.

value.name: caption
value.value: I know. The strike team will be in position soon. If the demolition fails, we will destroy the base with heavy tanks.

value.name: caption
value.value: That base is surrounded by a golden armor. Even if we use CN explosives or the main cannons of heavy tanks, we can't guarantee that we can destroy the base. But the base must have a weakness. Please find that out.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Titan. We are in position.

value.name: caption
value.value: Leave the last blow to us. We will blow it into pieces.

value.name: caption
value.value: Well done. Demolition team, take it from here.

value.name: caption
value.value: We won't need the heavy tanks. We will blow up this thing!

value.name: caption
value.value: Why is it shaking like this?

value.name: caption
value.value: Are those legs? The base is walking!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's not the time for demolition!

value.name: caption
value.value: We haven't finished setting up the bombs!

value.name: caption
value.value: Get away from the base! Hurry!

value.name: caption
value.value: Powered Exoskeletons, buy as much time as you can before the demolition team falls back.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy base is coming this way!

value.name: caption
value.value: It has legs and it's chasing us!

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員5

value.name: caption
value.value: The Powered Exoskeleton was crushed like a bug!

value.name: caption
value.value: Back off! Or we will get crushed too!

value.name: caption
value.value: The sniper team is behind us. Join up with them and fall back to where the heavy tanks are.

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn! So this is the true form of the base!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's a giant tank extending over hundreds of meters!

value.name: caption
value.value: Come here, quick! To the back of the heavy tank!

value.name: caption
value.value: Infantry, move behind the heavy tanks.

value.name: caption
value.value: Get in formation. Protect the infantry and start the bombardment.

value.name: caption
value.value: Heavy tanks, aim at the enemy base.

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemies incoming. Infantry units, support heavy tanks.

value.name: caption
value.value: Drones are coming out from the base!

value.name: caption
value.value: Aliens are coming out from the base!

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemies are coming out from the base!

value.name: caption
value.value: The cannon of the base is attacking us!

value.name: caption
value.value: We are under heavy fire! Our destruction is just a matter of time!

value.name: caption
value.value: The plasma cannon is aiming at us!

value.name: caption
value.value: Watch out for enemy laser cannon!

value.name: caption
value.value: The requiem cannon did not cause damage to the enemy!

value.name: caption
value.value: How is this possible? It can blow up a building with one shot!

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy base is unharmed. Subsequent attacks are meaningless.

value.name: caption
value.value: We are in critical situation. Our troops are faced with being completely wiped out.

value.name: caption
value.value: Abort attack on enemy base. All units, focus on the enemies rather than the base.

value.name: caption
value.value: All units, focus on attacking the enemies rather than the base.

value.name: caption
value.value: Take down the enemies rather than the base!

value.name: caption
value.value: Leave the base alone. Destroy the aliens and drones.

value.name: caption
value.value: At this rate, we will be wiped out. Infantry units, take down the surrounding enemies.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have arrived at the destination.

value.name: caption
value.value: Great. Investigate the insides of the cave. Charge in.

value.name: caption
value.value: It'll call for backup if you're too slow!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長8

value.name: caption
value.value: It's an unknown world ahead. Proceed cautiously.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士20

value.name: caption
value.value: What exactly will be ahead of us?

value.name: caption
value.value: There's something deep inside the cave!

value.name: caption
value.value: Did the monsters dig this tunnel?

value.name: caption
value.value: Are they trying to building their nest underground?

value.name: caption
value.value: If we don't destroy the nest, we will be in big trouble.

value.name: caption
value.value: If the monsters are reproducing here, it will be the worst situation for mankind. Make sure to reach the deepest part to uncover the truth.

value.name: caption
value.value: I know. But we will suffer heavy casualties too,

value.name: caption
value.value: It's aliens! Why are they here!?

value.name: caption
value.value: So they live in the monster nests?

value.name: caption
value.value: They are certainly protecting the monsters! They plan to breed monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: Illegal immigration and illicit work! We must evict them!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士21

value.name: caption
value.value: I didn't expect to see aliens here.

value.name: caption
value.value: The aliens seem to like it here.

value.name: caption
value.value: Do they want to hibernate? But they are extraterrestrial beings!

value.name: caption
value.value: Maybe they are actually subterranean beings.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長8

value.name: caption
value.value: I heard something. There seems to be something up ahead.

value.name: caption
value.value: Where does this cave lead to?

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士22

value.name: caption
value.value: We have gone so deep, but still can't see the end.

value.name: caption
value.value: Photo analysis completed. This is a natural underground cave. We believe that the monsters entered the cave and expanded it to make the cave their nest.

value.name: caption
value.value: So, half of the cave was formed naturally.

value.name: caption
value.value: Maybe the monsters can only build their nest in certain places.

value.name: caption
value.value: Then, if we destroy this place, we can remove the current threat.

value.name: caption
value.value: They can only nest in natural caves, and need help from the aliens... That means they don't have a strong ability to reproduce.

value.name: caption
value.value: If they can only nest in natural caves... that means they don't have a strong ability to reproduce.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is good news for mankind. Looks like there is hope in exterminating the monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: Let's pray that this operation will succeed.

value.name: caption
value.value: Sergeant, join up with the vanguard.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's you. This mission is going to be dangerous. I'll have your back.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's amazing that you made it this far.

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like you got the short end of the stick again.

value.name: caption
value.value: What a nightmare. I can't believe we are going to fight in a place like this.

value.name: caption
value.value: We'll catch up with them soon.

value.name: caption
value.value: The reinforcements have arrived. Go join them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Are you all right? I'm here to help.

value.name: caption
value.value: Burn them to ashes with this.

value.name: caption
value.value: Stop! No need to move forward.

value.name: caption
value.value: Wait here. The reinforcements will catch up with you soon.

value.name: caption
value.value: We will catch them up soon.

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like we made it in time.

value.name: caption
value.value: No casualties at all on our way here.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長9（チームＣ）

value.name: caption
value.value: Good to hear that. You can leave the rest to us.

value.name: caption
value.value: I have a bad feeling about this. Wonder what we are up against this time.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長9（チームＣ）

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士23

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't believe there's an army underground!

value.name: caption
value.value: Oh no! We are all gonna die!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's now or never! Fire at will!

value.name: caption
value.value: I don't want to die here!

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't let the monsters live. We must exterminate them all.

value.name: caption
value.value: Please send in the data of the cave. We will analyze it from here.

value.name: caption
value.value: Is this the end of the cave?

value.name: caption
value.value: There seems to be a road ahead.

value.name: caption
value.value: There seems to be a road ahead.

value.name: caption
value.value: There seems to be a road ahead.

value.name: caption
value.value: Great. Replenish ammo and then continue the mission.

value.name: caption
value.value: I've memorized the route. Follow me!

value.name: caption
value.value: Let's clear the way with flame jets! Cover me!

value.name: caption
value.value: You're screwed if you fall down.

value.name: caption
value.value: The monster army is right down below. Watch your steps.

value.name: caption
value.value: Our mission is to secure this cave for the reinforcements. We need to wipe out the monsters while moving forward.

value.name: caption
value.value: One slip and you're done for, so watch out.

value.name: caption
value.value: It seems the nest is going deeper.. Let's make sure it's safe around here.

value.name: caption
value.value: It'll be the end of you if you're on your own.

value.name: caption
value.value: Be careful not to slip when you fight the monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are more monsters than expected.

value.name: caption
value.value: We should have brought the main force with us.

value.name: caption
value.value: That'd be useless since most of them are injured. We'll take care of these ourselves.

value.name: caption
value.value: We've lost a lot of good men along the way, but we will complete the mission no matter the cost.

value.name: caption
value.value: To be honest, I'm really scared. Good that you're here.

value.name: caption
value.value: Is this the end of the cave?

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長10

value.name: caption
value.value: There's danger ahead. I can feel it.

value.name: caption
value.value: Let's go. On your toes, everyone.

value.name: caption
value.value: Water creates breeding conditions for any life form. Check out the area.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士24

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士25

value.name: caption
value.value: The aliens have made it this deep?!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士26

value.name: caption
value.value: It's as big as a building!

value.name: caption
value.value: There is more than one giant monster!

value.name: caption
value.value: We think those giant monsters are running this nest. Exterminate them all.

value.name: caption
value.value: The cave seems to be going deeper.

value.name: caption
value.value: What? We haven't reached the end yet?

value.name: caption
value.value: There might be more giant monsters. We have to kill them all.

value.name: caption
value.value: Nothing good can come out of this.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is where the monsters lay eggs!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長10

value.name: caption
value.value: Shoot the eggs!! Destroy all of them!

value.name: caption
value.value: So the monsters are breeding on Earth.

value.name: caption
value.value: Seems like the aliens are protecting their breeding ground.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's not too late. Get rid of all the monsters and eggs!

value.name: caption
value.value: Destroy the nest and stop these monsters from breeding.

value.name: caption
value.value: These giant monsters will be called "Mother Monsters" from now on. We think they laid the eggs.

value.name: caption
value.value: They'll continue to breed if we leave any one of them alive. Make sure to eliminate them all.

value.name: caption
value.value: We can deal with the eggs later. Extinguishing those Mother Monsters is the top priority.

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters are coming out from the eggs!

value.name: caption
value.value: Good job. We successfully stopped the monsters from reproducing. Although much sacrifice was made, it was worth it.

value.name: caption
value.value: This victory means a lot. We'll transfer the data all over the world.

value.name: caption
value.value: The nearby area should also have been relieved from the threat of the monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: No sign of them giving up.

value.name: caption
value.value: We stopped them from multiplying, but nothing has changed.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy seems to focus on dropping monsters in this area!

value.name: caption
value.value: They are trying to suppress this area! Things are going to get rough!

value.name: caption
value.value: All we have is shotguns. The enemy ships are out of our range.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長11

value.name: caption
value.value: Use close-range weapons. We'll take care of the Teleportation Ships.

value.name: caption
value.value: Shoot the enemy ships down. I'll cover you.

value.name: caption
value.value: Aliens are being dropped from the Teleportation Ships!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Scout. The Teleportation Ships are dispatching aliens.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have confirmed a new type of monsters that has the ability to fly.

value.name: caption
value.value: The air force has suffered heavy casualties.

value.name: caption
value.value: If they can fly, they can expand their range drastically. We must wipe them out asap to prevent damage from spreading.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is bad! They're coming one after another!

value.name: caption
value.value: You OK? Leave them to us!

value.name: caption
value.value: The citizens are in danger. Help us.

value.name: caption
value.value: Those bastards brought in a new type of monster!

value.name: caption
value.value: Darts! Watch out for the darts!

value.name: caption
value.value: Are they shooting darts at us!?

value.name: caption
value.value: Are they trying to sting us to death!?

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't get stung by it! There's no way you can survive.

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters that can fly with this speed are extremely dangerous. If they get away they'll cause lots of damage to other areas. You have to exterminate them all.

value.name: caption
value.value: Many soldiers were killed when these monsters were found in South America. We must be cautious.

value.name: caption
value.value: These monsters will be called "Flying Aggressors" from now on. Exterminate them before it gets out of hand.

value.name: caption
value.value: The sniper team is in position. Rendezvous with them.

value.name: caption
value.value: There're other Fencers on site. Rendezvous with them.

value.name: caption
value.value: These enemies are very dangerous. Don't let your guard down.

value.name: caption
value.value: Our equipment is perfect for dealing with agile opponents, so leave them to us.

value.name: caption
value.value: We'll take care of the flying-type. You can count on us.

value.name: caption
value.value: We aren't the best in dealing with fast opponents, but we have to do it.

value.name: caption
value.value: One of our soldiers single-handedly destroyed a vast number of flying-types. The amount is…fascinating.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have confirmed a group of flying-type. A giant organism likely to be Queen has also been detected.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have confirmed a subspecies of the flying-type among the group. These dreadful monsters possess immense combat strength. Be extra careful.

value.name: caption
value.value: Getting into the shooting range of EMC. Moving in.

value.name: caption
value.value: 歩兵部隊はＥＭＣに随行せよ。

value.name: caption
value.value: 攻撃はひかえろ。目標地点まで前進し、待機せよ。

value.name: caption
value.value: Cease fire. Move to target point and stand by.

value.name: caption
value.value: EMC is short-ranged so get close to the target now before it's too late.

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't attack before we're close enough.

value.name: caption
value.value: 空爆でエルギヌスにとどめをさす。ＥＭＣは万一に備えて待機せよ。

value.name: caption
value.value: Finish Erginus with airstrikes. EMC stand by just in case.

value.name: caption
value.value: The previous airstrikes already immobilized Erginus. We'll kill it during the next round of attack.

value.name: caption
value.value: Each EMC costs one hundred million dollars to build, and they are useless?

value.name: caption
value.value: 空爆によってエルギヌスは動けない。

value.name: caption
value.value: 地上戦力でエルギヌスにとどめをさす。

value.name: caption
value.value: The previous airstrikes already immobilized Erginus.

value.name: caption
value.value: まもなく空爆を再開する。

value.name: caption
value.value: Survived? We didn't even make a scratch! It wasn't immobilized either. It was just taking a godddam nap!!

value.name: caption
value.value: Adjust the azimuth! Lock-on Target! Increase power output!

value.name: caption
value.value: なんだと。詳細に報告せよ。

value.name: caption
value.value: It's a new enemy! That's a mysterious monster!

value.name: caption
value.value: 新たな怪生物が接近している。ＥＭＣ、フォーメーションを整えろ。

value.name: caption
value.value: The new mysterious monster keeps drawing near. EMC, regroup.

value.name: caption
value.value: なぜ、２体の怪生物が同じエリアに現れる……？　やつらは引き寄せあっているというのか……。

value.name: caption
value.value: Why would two mysterious monsters show up at the same time and place…? Do they attract each other…?

value.name: caption
value.value: Aim at the second mysterious monster.

value.name: caption
value.value: That mysterious monster is spitting lava-like substances!

value.name: caption
value.value: That lava-like substance exploded the moment it was exposed to air!

value.name: caption
value.value: That creature is a living powder keg.

value.name: caption
value.value: ＥＭＣ、フルパワーで照射せよ。

value.name: caption
value.value: The system won't hold if we keep boosting the energy!

value.name: caption
value.value: なんという生物だ。エルギヌス以上の生命力を持っているとは。

value.name: caption
value.value: やつを倒すためには作戦が必要だ。残念だが、今回は撤退する。

value.name: caption
value.value: How can that be... Its vital force is stronger than Erginus's.

value.name: caption
value.value: We need new strategies to defeat it. I'm sorry, but let's retreat for now.

value.name: caption
value.value: We managed to approach the enemy.

value.name: caption
value.value: Their number is shocking, and they didn't even pay attention to us.

value.name: caption
value.value: Good. Attack those Teleportation Ships. Take down as many as possible.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's dangerous if you aren't close enough! Just get right under that thing!

value.name: caption
value.value: They must have gathered here for strategic reasons. If our operation succeeds, we might be able to thwart their plan.

value.name: caption
value.value: Great work. The enemy didn't know what hit'em. Let's get to the next target.

value.name: caption
value.value: Our opponents are confused. Keep on going.

value.name: caption
value.value: According to the reports from the Air Force, enemy's mobile base seems to be moving towards this area.

value.name: caption
value.value: The mobile base is coming towards us!?

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy mobile base is coming. Watch out for mortar strike.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's too difficult to destroy the mobile base. Take down the Teleportation Ships first.

value.name: caption
value.value: Eliminate all enemies except the mobile base.

value.name: caption
value.value: Do not attack the mobile base.

value.name: name
value.value: 国営放送アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: What we are witnessing now is the alien army. A large-scale invasion seems to be underway.

value.name: caption
value.value: Wing Divers, join the strike team.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長12

value.name: caption
value.value: If we can wipe out all enemy ships, that should impact the aliens.

value.name: caption
value.value: Such a small strike team... should be a surprise to the aliens.

value.name: caption
value.value: As long as that mobile base is active, the aliens will have total control over the ground. We must destroy it.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is a record-breaking victory. I'd never expect us to defeat the enemy ships with such a few people.

value.name: caption
value.value: With our fire power, I don't care if they throw everything they got at us!

value.name: caption
value.value: Infantry units without shields stay behind  the Titans.

value.name: caption
value.value: Infantry, use the heavy tanks as cover.

value.name: caption
value.value: Titans are impregnable. Infantry, you can just stay behind us.

value.name: caption
value.value: Titans are mobile fortresses that can defend us from the strongest enemies!

value.name: caption
value.value: Let them get a taste of the Requiem Cannon!

value.name: caption
value.value: If they break through, the city will go down in flames. We will not let that happen. We must hold the enemies back.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's suicide to fight in such an open space.

value.name: caption
value.value: There's nowhere to hide. We'll get riddled with bullets.

value.name: caption
value.value: Hang in there till the new weapon arrives.

value.name: caption
value.value: We can turn the tide once the railguns arrive. Hold on!

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn! Why aren't the railgun here yet?

value.name: caption
value.value: Only a flat and open plain can maximize the railgun’s full capacity. They're doomed the moment they were lured here.

value.name: caption
value.value: Infantry unit, hide behind the Titans. They're unbreakable fortresses.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Scout. There're countless monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: Aliens flanked to the left and right!

value.name: caption
value.value: They're coming from the left and right!

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn those aliens, always trying to play tricks!

value.name: caption
value.value: Drones detected on the radar. They're approaching the combat area.

value.name: caption
value.value: Goddamn aliens. Time to bring out the trump card.

value.name: caption
value.value: Grim Reaper, show them what you've got.

value.name: caption
value.value: Grim Reaper has been sent to the combat area. Should arrive momentarily.

value.name: caption
value.value: What!? Aren't they the best of the best?!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Grim Reaper. Targets confirmed.

value.name: caption
value.value: Elite Fencer Unit has arrived. Infantry unit, join force with them at once.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Grim Reaper!? Are they really coming?!!

value.name: caption
value.value: The name says it all. In the last battle, they destroyed three Powered Exoskeletons with the infantry only.

value.name: caption
value.value: They defeated Powered Exoskeletons with just an infantry!? Get out of here!

value.name: caption
value.value: But we'll ask for your favor in return someday.

value.name: caption
value.value: Epsilon Self-propelled Railguns have reached the target point.

value.name: caption
value.value: Now move quick! Head for the front and fire!

value.name: caption
value.value: It doesn't matter if we break formation. Let's form a line and show them what we've got.

value.name: caption
value.value: It penetrated the enemies with a single shot!

value.name: caption
value.value: They even developed this kind of weapon.

value.name: caption
value.value: If the aliens hadn't come, would these weapons be used on human beings?

value.name: caption
value.value: Radar has detected large scale enemy movement.

value.name: caption
value.value: And the scale is several times larger than we've ever dealt with.

value.name: caption
value.value: I see, the enemies we've faced until now are only the advance party.

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like it won't be an easy win. We'd better get prepared.

value.name: caption
value.value: The alien army is getting close. We have no time to rest. Keep on fighting.

value.name: caption
value.value: The newbie's staying, so I'm staying.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm sorry to drag you into this mess.

value.name: caption
value.value: That's a force to be reckoned with.

value.name: caption
value.value: So, this is what we are dealing with?

value.name: caption
value.value: There's no strategy plan so just kill all enemies on sight.

value.name: caption
value.value: Buying time my ass! We are winning this!

value.name: caption
value.value: Impressive! It would've never crossed their minds that the few of us can make them pay like this.

value.name: caption
value.value: No way I'm calling you "newbie" again!

value.name: caption
value.value: You're no goddamn newbie! You're our ace.

value.name: caption
value.value: Sergeant, bad news. There're countless monsters approaching. They're probably summoned by the enemy Ships.

value.name: caption
value.value: Sergeant, leave at once. There're countless monsters heading your way.

value.name: caption
value.value: We came on foot and there're no getaway vehicles nearby.

value.name: caption
value.value: Sergeant, bad news. There're countless monsters approaching. This is probably the enemy's meeting point.

value.name: caption
value.value: All enemies are coming this way…

value.name: caption
value.value: At least we had our run.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's already a miracle to be alive.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'll take all the enemies I can with me.

value.name: caption
value.value: I plan to do that too.

value.name: caption
value.value: Sergeant. I finally got through. The Intelligence Division will support you.

value.name: caption
value.value: What can you do to help when you're somewhere safe?

value.name: caption
value.value: We already sent your coordinates to the Grim Reaper. They should arrive momentarily.

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like I owe you my gratitude.

value.name: caption
value.value: Discovered units in battle. We'll go for rescue at once.

value.name: caption
value.value: Take a good look. The battle is lopsided. We might get wiped out too.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is the Grim Reaper. We're coming to help. Hang in there.

value.name: caption
value.value: The monster army is heading towards this area.

value.name: caption
value.value: It looks like this is the end.

value.name: caption
value.value: I can hardly see. This is bad.

value.name: caption
value.value: Now we'll all be soggy wet corpses. This's just great.

value.name: caption
value.value: Keep it together and remember your training no matter what!

value.name: caption
value.value: The Grim Reapers have arrived. Go join them.

value.name: caption
value.value: We will show no mercy to our prey.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'll take care of the little brats! You go for the big ones!

value.name: caption
value.value: We're prepared to die. Just use us as your cover!

value.name: caption
value.value: You can pay me back in hell after you get your job done.

value.name: caption
value.value: Sergeant, I'm glad you're OK. All units have retreated. Thank you very much.

value.name: caption
value.value: The newbie did all the heavy lifting.

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't call the civilian newbie anymore.

value.name: caption
value.value: We're very interested in those who made a vital contribution to the victory. They will be our role models from now on.

value.name: caption
value.value: I will decide the code name for you.

value.name: caption
value.value: Storm. This will be your name.

value.name: caption
value.value: But that name belongs to the legendary hero.

value.name: caption
value.value: If that name evokes hope, then that's what we desperately need.

value.name: caption
value.value: I will destroy the base even if I have to sacrifice myself. Cool.

value.name: caption
value.value: Mind the artillery strike! Take cover behind the heavy tanks, Infantry!

value.name: caption
value.value: We're about to reach the firing range of the base

value.name: caption
value.value: We will foil their plan once they lose this stronghold on the ground. We must succeed no matter what.

value.name: caption
value.value: We're under heavy fire! Will we make it through?

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員6

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員7

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員6

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員6

value.name: caption
value.value: The aliens are coming this way!

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員6

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't think you'll harm a Titan like that!

value.name: caption
value.value: Hang in there! Fight back with all we've got!

value.name: caption
value.value: Their number is not decreasing after getting attacked.

value.name: caption
value.value: Caliban Support Vehicle, pick up the injured.

value.name: caption
value.value: There're still cannons on the sides and back. Destroy them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Destroy the cannons on the sides.

value.name: caption
value.value: Destroy the cannons on the back.

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員6

value.name: caption
value.value: Powered Exoskeletons, ready for close-range attacks.

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員6

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't be afraid of the artillery strike. Just focus on destroying the cannons.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's ok to take a few hits as long as we can take out the cannons.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Swallow 1. Ground forces are in danger. We'll launch an airstrike towards the base.

value.name: caption
value.value: There're still some remaining cannons. You'll get shot down.

value.name: caption
value.value: Ground Force, an airstrike will commence momentarily.

value.name: caption
value.value: We didn't get all of them?

value.name: caption
value.value: Ground Force, destroy the remaining cannons at once.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Swallow 2. What took you so long? We're moving in.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Swallow 2. We're engaging the enemy.

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't let it escape. Launch an airstrike to destroy the base.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Swallow 3. Striking the base.

value.name: caption
value.value: Just as I thought… Our attacks are useless against the golden armor.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's risky, but we have no choice.

value.name: caption
value.value: Ground Force, commence attack. Get under the base and find out its weak spot.

value.name: caption
value.value: There must be some areas that are left unprotected.

value.name: caption
value.value: You want to blow up that base, too? Count me in.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's been our goal to destroy the base and now we're only an inch away from success.

value.name: caption
value.value: As soon as the base is gone, the aliens won't be able to maintain control over the ground. We are witnessing history in the making.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's the first time we successfully destroyed a base. The data will be sent to the EDF headquarter.

value.name: caption
value.value: Your remarkable deeds will not be forgotten.

value.name: caption
value.value: If this keeps up, we'll become the indigenous peoples!

value.name: caption
value.value: An "alien" rights problem. I didn't see THAT coming.

value.name: caption
value.value: The alien infantry will be called "Colonists" from now on.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are some inappropriate contents in your operation report. Reports will have to come to me first from now on.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy is gearing up for a large-scale airborne operation, dropping off aliens worldwide. They might launch some larger attacks in the future. Now we're at the crossroad. This war might be coming to a conclusion soon.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy has sent out their main forces already.

value.name: caption
value.value: The tides of war is ever changing. Aliens around the world have launched large-scale invasion operations. We managed to make it through, but still, many regions fell into enemy hands. And the remaining force is reaching their limits.

value.name: caption
value.value: A war of attrition against the aliens. We cannot go back. We can only put in more men and fight to the end…

value.name: caption
value.value: An enormous amount of aliens are approaching. We've never seen this many enemies in this area. We're coming up with a defense plan right now.

value.name: caption
value.value: Over 5000 aliens have been dropped down.

value.name: caption
value.value: It appears to be the main force of the Earth Airborne Operation.

value.name: caption
value.value: Bastards. Are they trying to finish us off?

value.name: caption
value.value: The aliens are moving towards the northern part of the continent. Their target appears to be the large northern city, Area P1.

value.name: caption
value.value: 5000 aliens are closing in on Beijing. We'll round up our forces to beat them in the suburbs of Beijing.

value.name: caption
value.value: 5000 aliens are closing in on Area P1. We'll round up our forces to beat them in the suburbs of the city.

value.name: caption
value.value: Time for the showdown with the aliens.

value.name: caption
value.value: Operation name: Crossroad. This will be the battle to determine the fate of humanity.

value.name: caption
value.value: 120 Powered Exoskeletons of the latest model just arrived in Beijing.

value.name: caption
value.value: 120 Powered Exoskeletons of the latest model just arrived in Area P1.

value.name: caption
value.value: Around 5000 aliens and countless drones, monsters, with the Mothership setting up barriers over the sky.

value.name: caption
value.value: Let's just say, there's no second chance if we lose.

value.name: caption
value.value: The human civilization is collapsing. It's very likely we will never rebuild our world if we lose more forces.

value.name: caption
value.value: Even if we lose… we must defeat at least 70% of the enemies, or we're doomed without a future.

value.name: caption
value.value: Operation in Beijing is about to begin.

value.name: caption
value.value: Operation in Area P1 is about to begin.

value.name: caption
value.value: We can only pray for victory.

value.name: caption
value.value: Comm. from Beijing. Operation "Crossroad," succeeded. Enemy forces, disintegrated. Our damage, minor.

value.name: caption
value.value: Comm. from Area P1. Operation "Crossroad," succeeded. Enemy forces, disintegrated. Our damage, minor.

value.name: caption
value.value: Comm. from Beijing. Victory is ours.

value.name: caption
value.value: Comm. from Area P1. Victory is ours.

value.name: caption
value.value: I repeat. 70% of aliens were eliminated. We suffered minor casualties.

value.name: caption
value.value: Fabulous!! Now they know what we've got!!

value.name: caption
value.value: Heard the report from Area P1?

value.name: caption
value.value: I heard they've defeated thousands of aliens.

value.name: caption
value.value: There seemed to be new weapons involved. They used it to weaken the aliens before the fight.

value.name: caption
value.value: I heard it's poison gas or something like that.

value.name: caption
value.value: Doesn't sound fair, but I like it!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's species β! They are spitting threads!

value.name: caption
value.value: So they have reached Europe too?

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Scout. Large group of monsters discovered.

value.name: caption
value.value: There seems to be other monsters! Let's go!

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters over there too! Hurry up!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is a private message. You have achieved brilliant combat results. Was it pure luck or do you really possess such skills? Either way, you are worthy of attention.

value.name: caption
value.value: Look! The Monsters are coming out from the ground!

value.name: caption
value.value: Did they sneak into the ground?!

value.name: caption
value.value: If they can move underground, they should still be around.

value.name: caption
value.value: Are these the same ones that invaded Europe?

value.name: caption
value.value: Let's rendezvous with the troops in the rear first.

value.name: caption
value.value: Oh it's you. Give me a hand, will ya?

value.name: caption
value.value: Hey dude! Glad to see you!

value.name: caption
value.value: Ah, there's someone I can count on.

value.name: caption
value.value: This earthquake is caused by the monsters down there!?

value.name: caption
value.value: There must be a bulk of monsters moving down there.

value.name: caption
value.value: Lots of monsters coming out from the holes!

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters coming out from the ground!

value.name: caption
value.value: New type monsters confirmed! It's species β that are covered with armor!

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't penetrate them with bullets!

value.name: caption
value.value: Their bodies are harder than steel!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's like a wire! You'll be chopped into pieces just by touching it!

value.name: caption
value.value: They're right ahead! We have no choice but to deal with them!

value.name: caption
value.value: Units near the Anchors, attack the targets right away.

value.name: caption
value.value: Our reinforcements won't make it. Destroy the Anchors with current forces.

value.name: caption
value.value: Ask the soldiers to spread so they won't get hit by the fallen Anchors! There's nothing else we can do!

value.name: caption
value.value: There's no use hiding in the buildings if the anchors crash down. Estimate the dropping location and dodge the attack.

value.name: caption
value.value: They want us to dodge the anchors!

value.name: caption
value.value: They come crashing down! Watch out!

value.name: caption
value.value: The Teleportation Anchors are dropping from the sky!

value.name: caption
value.value: Again! And this time there's more!

value.name: caption
value.value: How come it's coming down this way!!

value.name: caption
value.value: Be thankful that it's not crashing onto your head!

value.name: caption
value.value: Objects crashing from the sky confirmed!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's Anchors. A lot of them!

value.name: caption
value.value: Anchros are dropping from the sky!! Careful!

value.name: caption
value.value: Those anchors will put everyone at risk! Destroy them.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is just too much we can handle.

value.name: caption
value.value: If we don't do something, this city is done for! Get moving!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is why we came all the way to Europe!

value.name: caption
value.value: What the heck!? Bigger Anchors are falling down!

value.name: caption
value.value: Hey look! That's a huge Anchor!

value.name: caption
value.value: An enormous amount of monsters are coming out from the Giant Teleportation Anchor.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Scout. Different types of monsters are coming out from those giant teleport anchors.

value.name: caption
value.value: The bigger the anchor, the more monsters can be teleported? Destroy them!

value.name: caption
value.value: These giant teleportation anchors will be called "Big Anchors" from now on.

value.name: caption
value.value: Destroy the Big Anchors at once.

value.name: caption
value.value: Good job. We stopped the alien attack once again.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Intelligence Division is very interested in you. We will start to watch and record your actions from now on. I will send one of my men to you, who will surely become a great help.

value.name: caption
value.value: How's the secret weapon coming along?

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm referring to that secret weapon which killed lots of aliens in Beijing.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm referring to that secret weapon which killed lots of aliens in Area P1.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's only rumor among soldiers. There's no such thing as a secret weapon.

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like it's top secret huh.

value.name: caption
value.value: We found the aliens' weak points after examining their bodies.

value.name: caption
value.value: They appear to show extreme reactions towards certain pollutants.

value.name: caption
value.value: We assume that feature in Beijing has played a key role.

value.name: caption
value.value: We assume that feature in Area P1 has played a key role.

value.name: caption
value.value: Does it mean that the aliens have never faced air pollution before?

value.name: caption
value.value: As a matter of fact, the aliens have many weaknesses   Among those, sulfur dioxide and certain nitrogen oxides are most apparent. Once they are exposed to this environment, they'll die from suffocation.

value.name: caption
value.value: In other words it's the environment that killed them?

value.name: caption
value.value: So have the aliens built their civilization free of air pollution?

value.name: caption
value.value: It's unnatural for creatures that have developed such an advanced civilization to have no resistance to pollutions. That means…

value.name: caption
value.value: They aren't the master of the civilization.

value.name: caption
value.value: Correct. These aliens are intelligent, but I don't think they can surpass human beings.

value.name: caption
value.value: Are they some poor indigenous brought by the creators of the civilization from who-knows-what planet?

value.name: caption
value.value: We already know the devices on the aliens are communicators which are also their life-supporting equipment on Earth, but after some further investigation, we found out another essential function: those machines will affect their brains and body tissues.

value.name: caption
value.value: So the creators of the civilization made the aliens into cyborgs and controls them, similar to the monsters?

value.name: caption
value.value: The aliens could also be clone soldiers.

value.name: caption
value.value: Disposable assets. No one cares if they'll die from air pollution.

value.name: caption
value.value: If we lose the war, that could be our future too.

value.name: caption
value.value: Recall the troops sent to Europe.

value.name: caption
value.value: We've confirmed a swarm of flying-types, but we haven't received reports about them dropping Teleportation Ships yet. They must have been bred by the earlier monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: Crap. We must come up with a counter measure ASAP....

value.name: caption
value.value: Flying-type monsters are approaching. Prepare to fight.

value.name: caption
value.value: Finish the monsters with Surface-to-Air Missiles.

value.name: caption
value.value: Powered Exoskeletons, take care of the enemies near the Surface-to-Air Missiles.

value.name: caption
value.value: The sky is covered with monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: I should have spent more time at the shooting range!

value.name: caption
value.value: Surface-to-Air Missiles and Powered Exoskeletons will cover you. Infantry unit, do not back down.

value.name: caption
value.value: Anti-aircraft missiles can't handle monsters at close range. Infantry unit, defeat all enemies close to the Surface-to-Air Missiles.

value.name: caption
value.value: Infantry unit, protect the Surface-to-Air Missiles.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Scout. Flying-type monsters are drawing close.

value.name: caption
value.value: They might continue to breed on Earth. Destroy them all.

value.name: caption
value.value: We're dead! The red ones must be stronger!

value.name: caption
value.value: We need data on the red monsters. Fire at the red ones.

value.name: caption
value.value: The red monsters appear to be a mutated form of the flying-type. Their appearance is almost identical.

value.name: caption
value.value: I suppose that's the Queen Bee. The flying-type cannot multiply without it.

value.name: caption
value.value: So that is the main source of our problem.

value.name: caption
value.value: The giant flying type will be called "Queen" from now on. Attack and eliminate the Queen.

value.name: caption
value.value: That giant monster is queen to the flying-type. Destroy it at once.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'll assist you from now on. It will be my pleasure.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have confirmed a pack of the flying-types. Be alert.

value.name: caption
value.value: There's another pack of the flying-type. Watch out.

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemies are decreasing in number. We're about to succeed.

value.name: caption
value.value: There comes a large group of the flying-type. A lot of them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Only a few enemies left. The strategy is really working this time.

value.name: caption
value.value: We've detected a giant organism among them!

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemy robots landed in Russia. 200 in total.

value.name: caption
value.value: Moscow has fallen. It suffered great casualties.

value.name: caption
value.value: The garrison was annihilated within such a short time!?

value.name: caption
value.value: Many enemy robots landed in Russia. They're now engaged in heavy combat.

value.name: caption
value.value: Bad news. A Mothership is drawing close.

value.name: caption
value.value: Bad news. Mothership No.8 is drawing close.

value.name: caption
value.value: The troops have arrived. End of surveillance. Let's go meet up.

value.name: caption
value.value: No need to spy on them?

value.name: caption
value.value: Now we have both the Powered Exoskeletons and Railguns, I like our odds.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Mothership has established land supremacy.

value.name: caption
value.value: They even sent out the Mothership.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is our best chance of shooting down the Mothership.

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn Mothership! Do they plan to occupy this place and make it a colony?

value.name: caption
value.value: There's an elevated railway right ahead. Spread out over there and search for enemies.

value.name: caption
value.value: Use the overpass to confront the enemies.

value.name: caption
value.value: We must secure the high ground.

value.name: caption
value.value: Infantry, move. Don't let the enemy approach the overpass.

value.name: caption
value.value: Infantry unit, leave the enemies to us. You just carry on.

value.name: caption
value.value: If we let them get close, the Railguns will be vulnerable. This is the best way.

value.name: caption
value.value: We've got Railguns and Powered Exoskeletons to cover our backs. Those bastards can't lay a finger on us!

value.name: caption
value.value: Get the enemies into the Railguns' range!

value.name: caption
value.value: We support each other. Don't act alone.

value.name: caption
value.value: There're numerous monsters and aliens under the Mothership.

value.name: caption
value.value: Is the Mothership planning to turn this place into an alien colony?

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Scout. The Mothership is dropping off something.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's robots! The robots are coming down!

value.name: caption
value.value: These are bipedal robots! And it looks like they are carrying some kind of weapon!

value.name: caption
value.value: I've seen aliens deploying giant walkers to destroy earth on animes, but I never thought I would see this in real life.

value.name: caption
value.value: First aliens and now a robot army!?

value.name: caption
value.value: This city is about to be taken over by the robots!

value.name: caption
value.value: Check the inside! I've never seen this type of alien!

value.name: caption
value.value: They're different from the aliens we've seen in the past! Not humanoids!

value.name: caption
value.value: They sure don't look human to me!

value.name: caption
value.value: Aliens that don't look like humans, hm..

value.name: caption
value.value: And they have advanced equipment! They are difficult to deal with.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're elite units that have received combat training!

value.name: caption
value.value: Those aliens, they take buildings as shields!

value.name: caption
value.value: They are deceptively fast for their size!

value.name: caption
value.value: Fall back! Or we'll all die!

value.name: caption
value.value: From behind! They're attacking from the rear!

value.name: caption
