value.value: We suspect the aliens are not wearing armors but spacesuits.

value.name: caption
value.value: The outer layer is covered with a protective armor that is bulletproof, but its most important function is to prevent them from getting harmed by air pollution.

value.name: caption
value.value: So they can move freely in the polluted air, I see.

value.name: caption
value.value: These are decoys in the front!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's over. Call off the operation. All units retreat.

value.name: caption
value.value: Let's hide! Get into the building!

value.name: caption
value.value: We will send out the Rescue Teams. Stay alive!

value.name: caption
value.value: This city is occupied by the aliens. We're all hiding in a building. We've escaped the worst, but god knows for how long.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're coming. Hush, we're doomed if they find us.

value.name: caption
value.value: Air crafts and choppers can't get close due to attacks from the mothership. Ground units will come for support so don't give up. You must hang in there.

value.name: caption

value.value: The long-legged and short-legged Deroys have showed up together.

value.name: caption
value.value: We presume those legs with different length were designed to best fit various terrains and targets.

value.name: caption
value.value: Improving the general utility so their invasion can be more effective. They have mastered the art of invasion.

value.name: caption
value.value: The long-legged and the short-legged will be called "Long Type" and "Short Type" from now on.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Short Type Deroy successfully destroyed.

value.name: caption
value.value: So many people were… It was all Deroys' fault.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's the Queens! They start moving!

value.name: caption
value.value: There are also lots of flying-types.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Queens are making a move. It appears that all Queens are flying to gather in one location.

value.name: caption
value.value: We must stop them from nesting. Destroy them.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is not going to be easy, but it's also a great opportunity to get all Queens in one swoop. Eliminate them all.

value.name: caption
value.value: Launch an airstrike to eliminate the enemy. Air Raiders, identify target point.

value.name: caption
value.value: Transport aircrafts have arrived on the scene. We'll leave Air Raiders to indicate the drop point.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長19

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't lose the air battle no matter what!

value.name: caption
value.value: Aliens you said? Were the Queens called by the aliens?

value.name: caption
value.value: We presume the Aliens have summoned the Queens and together they will build a giant nest.

value.name: caption
value.value: Are they professional dairy farmers?! I'm impressed that aliens know how to improve the reproductive rate.

value.name: caption
value.value: That's a terrifying opponent. Never let your guards down.

value.name: caption
value.value: Now that the Queens have been wiped out, their nests are left unguarded. We'll soon devise a strategy to destroy the nests.

value.name: caption
value.value: Can we not fight in this weather?!

value.name: caption
value.value: There's no need for AFV to show up.

value.name: caption
value.value: Let's start with the nearby enemies!

value.name: caption
value.value: AFV will join the battle today. That'll be easier for us.

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't worry, the AFV will come to our support.

value.name: caption
value.value: The range of shotguns is short, but it's the perfect weapon for knocking back monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: Have a taste of my shotgun!

value.name: caption
value.value: You seem to have fun. Count us in.

value.name: caption
value.value: Watch me blow those enemies away.

value.name: caption
value.value: AFV, move in. Infantry, follow up.

value.name: caption
value.value: AFV, apporach the enemies. Infantry, cover from the rear.

value.name: caption
value.value: AFV, rush in and distract enemies. Infantry unit, cover from behind.

value.name: caption
value.value: Infantry unit, AFVs approach the enemy.

value.name: caption
value.value: Approach the enemy to protect the infantry.

value.name: caption
value.value: Everything went well. Time to wipe out the rest of the enemies.

value.name: caption
value.value: AFV, create a line of defeanse and cover the infantry.

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn! All of them are difficult to handle!

value.name: caption
value.value: Those ball-shaped monsters are natural enemies of AFV.

value.name: caption
value.value: Those ball-shaped monsters are drawing close! Infantry unit, eliminate them when you're still armed.

value.name: caption
value.value: Infantry unit, wipe out Aggressors species γ and defend AFV.

value.name: caption
value.value: Quick! Do something to fight against the flying-type!

value.name: caption
value.value: The AFVs can't do it themselves. We need Powered Exoskeletons as cover.

value.name: caption
value.value: AFV failed to cope with the flying-type. Infantry unit, take over the job.

value.name: caption
value.value: Powered Exoskeletons will take care of the flying-types. You must hang in there.

value.name: caption
value.value: Powered Exoskeletons are arriving momentarily. Leave the flying-types and the species γ to Powered Exoskeletons.

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員24

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員25

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Scout. Archelus is coming out from underground.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Scout. Archelus is moving towards the combat area.

value.name: caption
value.value: Heyyyy, what the heck! We don't have time for this!

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員25

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員24

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Nix 1. So that's Archelus? Leave it to us.

value.name: caption
value.value: An immortal monster really exists. The universe is full of surprises.

value.name: caption
value.value: Let's show them what the Blazer's got.

value.name: caption
value.value: If we can mass produce it, it may change the tides of war.

value.name: caption
value.value: Fully charging it would deplete the power of an entire city. That's the problem.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Blazer wasn't effective against Archelus!?

value.name: caption
value.value: I don't think that's the case.

value.name: caption
value.value: Blazer has the same power level as EMC. The issue lies with the monster.

value.name: caption
value.value: Blazer's power is about 12% of EMC. The issue lies with the monster.

value.name: caption
value.value: We intended to kill Archelus, but surprisingly Blazer didn't work.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have a plan to defeat Archelus.

value.name: caption
value.value: Archelus has an uncanny regeneration ability. That's why our artillery fire can't harm it. Therefore, we should attack Archelus using things with  equivalent weight to that monster and thus crush it the moment they collide.

value.name: caption
value.value: Get a huge crane and smash it.

value.name: caption
value.value: But how do we get such a huge crane to hit it?

value.name: caption
value.value: There should be mobile cranes in Base 228.

value.name: caption
value.value: I see! But that base is now under enemy's control.

value.name: caption
value.value: That's why our first objective is to recover that base.

value.name: caption
value.value: Are we going back to that base…

value.name: caption
value.value: I risked my life to escape from that base. Really don't feel like going back.

value.name: caption
value.value: That base is taken by the enemies. It's very dangerous for sure.

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't worry. Leave the heavy lifting to us.

value.name: caption
value.value: Come on, we Spriggans don't need cover.

value.name: caption
value.value: Show them what Blazer can do!

value.name: caption
value.value: I want a weapon like that too!

value.name: caption
value.value: I'll take this up to the brass.

value.name: caption
value.value: You won't get away with it if you break it.

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemy has sent out an army!

value.name: caption
value.value: Those heavily-armed bastards are hard to handle!

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemies' spacesuits are very tough! Concentrate our attacks on a single spot!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's useless to destroy the spacesuits! We have to hit the aliens inside!

value.name: caption
value.value: Stay out of the way, Spriggans!

value.name: caption
value.value: Cut it out and start working together!

value.name: caption
value.value: They might have called for reinforcement. We'd better get going.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Scout. There're monsters in the sky.

value.name: caption
value.value: Shit! It appears they have taken the entire area.

value.name: caption
value.value: That's the true power of Spriggans.

value.name: caption
value.value: You ladies are really a piece of work.

value.name: caption
value.value: Well done, head for Base 228 asap.

value.name: caption
value.value: The base is occupied by the enemies.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have confirmed several Teleportation Anchors apparently inactive at the moment.

value.name: caption
value.value: Operation stage 1 now begins. First of all, deal with those enemies on the ground.

value.name: caption
value.value: We'll destroy the Teleportation Anchors before they start sending in monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters are coming out from Teleportation Anchors!

value.name: caption
value.value: A bunch of aliens are coming right at us!

value.name: caption
value.value: How dare you come to my house! I'll show you who's the boss!

value.name: caption
value.value: Why would the aliens invade such a remote base!?

value.name: caption
value.value: They want to keep this base!

value.name: caption
value.value: They don't want to see the base taken away!?

value.name: caption
value.value: Air Force has gained control of the air. They will come for support.

value.name: caption
value.value: Air Force arrives. Use Hooligans to destroy the Teleportation Ships

value.name: caption
value.value: Have we finally developed a weapon that can break the ships' armor?

value.name: caption
value.value: But we can't mass produce it now. We'll only use it in major tasks.

value.name: caption
value.value: Air Force's attack is over. The remaining teleportation ships will be handled by the ground forces.

value.name: caption
value.value: I've heard a rumour about a hero.

value.name: caption
value.value: You Grim Reapers aren't as good as I was told.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's really hard to aim at the enemies when there're a bunch of bastards bouncing around like bunnies.

value.name: caption
value.value: Stop fighting, we're in this together.

value.name: caption
value.value: We'll change your guerrilla code name to "Storm" from now on.

value.name: caption
value.value: Spriggans, you're Storm 4. Grim Reapers, you're Storm 3. Sergeant, you're Storm 2. And you, Storm 1. This is the code name from now on. Understood?

value.name: caption
value.value: We've wiped out all enemy ground forces.

value.name: caption
value.value: Very well, now move to underground.

value.name: caption
value.value: This passage is only for vehicles. Be careful of the slope cause you might fall.

value.name: caption
value.value: Normal vehicles won't be able to climb slope as steep like this. It's like a cliff.

value.name: caption
value.value: There is also an elevator built for vehicles. This here is an emergency exit.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's no joke if you slip cause you'll die.

value.name: caption
value.value: We don't have to worry about that at all.

value.name: caption
value.value: The gigantic Unloader should be in the underground storage. Let's find it.

value.name: caption
value.value: There should be some emergency power for us to open this blast door.

value.name: caption
value.value: We're going to open the blast door.

value.name: caption
value.value: One missing. Where did he go?

value.name: caption
value.value: We're going to open the blast door. Ready?

value.name: caption
value.value: We're going to unlock the blast door.

value.name: caption
value.value: The other side must be crawling with monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: They've made it this deep inside!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is not the monster's breeding ground, is it?

value.name: caption
value.value: I know you love the underground, but sorry this is our base!

value.name: caption
value.value: This way. Our objective is down here.

value.name: caption
value.value: Unlock the blast door to the other side.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'll take the lead. This is my house.

value.name: caption
value.value: Are you ready? Let's move on.

value.name: caption
value.value: We're approaching the hangar. Let's go.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Gigantic Unloader is a mobile crane.

value.name: caption
value.value: This must be very important if we are going out of our way to get it.

value.name: caption
value.value: Did the aliens attack the base because of it?

value.name: caption
value.value: No. There's a problem with the crane, that's why it was locked away in the warehouse.

value.name: caption
value.value: It has been passed around like a hot potato. They say it's a piece of junk.

value.name: caption
value.value: Now we have to risk our lives to recover it? Why do we get all the stupid missions?

value.name: caption
value.value: The Gigantic Unloader is dead ahead.

value.name: caption
value.value: We need the large crane in order to defeat Archelus. If that's the case, our sacrifices will not be in vain.

value.name: caption
value.value: Guess we won't die for nothing.

value.name: caption
value.value: Nothing we can do. Let's just head back...Uh...Hey!

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't let the enemy destroy it during combat!

value.name: caption
value.value: Too many. We don't stand a chance.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is it for us. Now enjoy our last ride!

value.name: caption
value.value: Are the aliens trying to reclaim this place?

value.name: caption
value.value: Shut down Anti-collision process. Deactivate all safety protocols . Complete. Initiate launch program.

value.name: caption
value.value: We will help control this thing.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Barga is made out of E1 alloy. Enemy attack won't pose a threat.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's unarmed because it's a crane.

value.name: caption
value.value: Stomp the enemy. Attack them with your feet.

value.name: caption
value.value: You can stomp both left and right.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy is too small to land a direct hit. Lean your upper body forward.

value.name: caption
value.value: Lean your upper body forward, then take a swing.

value.name: caption
value.value: A punch with that much weight behind it can crush the enemy with a single blow.

value.name: caption
value.value: Just a scratch. Nothing to worry about.

value.name: caption
value.value: The monsters are approaching the base.

value.name: caption
value.value: Barga is weak against small and fast enemies. Go support it.

value.name: caption
value.value: Barga's main system has normalized. Ready for combat.

value.name: caption
value.value: You've made it. Aerial troops have arrived. They will exterminate the remaining enemies from above.

value.name: caption
value.value: The transport aircraft is on its way. It will transport Barga by air.

value.name: caption
value.value: Archelus is getting closer by the second!

value.name: caption
value.value: The transport aircraft will be here momentarily.

value.name: caption
value.value: There's a problem. The pilot is missing.

value.name: caption
value.value: He has controlled the Barga before. He'll be alright.

value.name: caption
value.value: But he never had any training!

value.name: caption
value.value: We are out of options. We are counting on you.

value.name: caption
value.value: Use the Barga against Archelus. Now swing those arms and attack Archelus.

value.name: caption
value.value: Beat the living hell out of it!

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like Barga wasn't built for nothing.

value.name: caption
value.value: We can just enjoy the show.

value.name: caption
value.value: They are getting too close! Fall back!

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters have entered the combat area.

value.name: caption
value.value: We will take care of the monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: You handle Archelus, we will take care of the rest.

value.name: caption
value.value: The result shows that Barga is an indispensable asset. We will start repairing the other 10 scrapped Bargas, and use them as weapons against Archelus.

value.name: caption
value.value: There's more than one Big Anchor!

value.name: caption
value.value: There's too many. We can't do it alone!

value.name: caption
value.value: We have to. Everyone else is dead!

value.name: caption
value.value: The air force has arrived. Air raiders! Destroy the Big Anchors with an air raid.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Big Anchor is a terrifying weapon. We need the help of the air force to destroy it! Air raiders, get us the coordinates for the air raid.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have to protect the citizens. Attack the winged alien.

value.name: caption
value.value: Ah, a winged alien. That's a first.

value.name: caption
value.value: I've seen it several times. I even dream about it.

value.name: caption
value.value: I was almost eaten by one of them.

value.name: caption
value.value: They aren't the brightest bunch. Simple minded beasts.

value.name: caption
value.value: From now on the winged aliens will be called Tadpoles.

value.name: caption
value.value: The winged aliens are the alien larvae we encountered from before, which will be metamorphosed into aliens.

value.name: caption
value.value: Those larvae have to survive a harsh environment and fierce predators after birth, only the fittest will survive and grow up.

value.name: caption
value.value: To put it simply, now is the process to see which larvae can make it in this world.

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like the aliens are really here to stay.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have to defeat them. If they grow up, they will become a huge threat to humanity.

value.name: caption
value.value: Winged aliens are entering combat area.

value.name: caption
value.value: There's too many! We can't deal with them alone!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's them or us! Fight for our survival!

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't hold them off any longer!

value.name: caption
value.value: Fencer have arrived on the scene.

value.name: caption
value.value: Good job everyone, we are here to help.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's always like this when you're here.

value.name: caption
value.value: The entire urban area is infested by Aranean nest.

value.name: caption
value.value: There're civilians here. Exterminate the Araneas.

value.name: caption
value.value: We've found Teleportation Anchors under the web!

value.name: caption
value.value: Aranea has built a nest on the Teleportation Anchors.

value.name: caption
value.value: Araneas coming out from the Anchors are using webs to defend it.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are still many survivors in this area. Your priority is to exterminate the Araneas.

value.name: caption
value.value: Copy that, but we lack the fire power, this may not end well.

value.name: caption
value.value: Aliens are deploying Anchors in inhabited areas. They must be watching us!

value.name: caption
value.value: Fall back! Get off the bridge!

value.name: caption
value.value: The bridge won't hold if the monster gets on it!

value.name: caption
value.value: The bridge won't hold! Fall back!

value.name: caption
value.value: The monsters are falling into the vale!

value.name: caption
value.value: The vale is not deep enough! They are climbing up!

value.name: caption
value.value: Spotting a group of Species γ near the beach.

value.name: caption
value.value: Species γ are closing in on us!

value.name: caption
value.value: Get rid of the Flying Aggressors.

value.name: caption
value.value: Start attack phase 1. Use Powered Exoskeletons equipped with Surface-to-Air Missiles to destroy the flying-type in the proximity.

value.name: caption
value.value: Use the Surface-to-Air Missiles mounted on Powered Exoskeletons to wipe out the flying-type.

value.name: caption
value.value: They won't be a threat as long as the queen isn't here. Now kill the flying-type.

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員26

value.name: caption
value.value: This is a specialized anti-air unit! Watch me shoot down those flying-type.

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員27

value.name: caption
value.value: Our movement speed is handicapped by heavy anti-air missiles. We need the Infantry's support.

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員26

value.name: caption
value.value: Say hello to my little friend!

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員26

value.name: caption
value.value: I'll shoot you down if you came close.

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員27

value.name: caption
value.value: Let the Powered Exoskeletons handle the flying-type. The rest concentrate your fire on the nest.

value.name: caption
value.value: Start phase 2. Use heavy artillery to weaken the nest.

value.name: caption
value.value: Ground troop, take cover behind the tanks.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is scout. Attack was effective. The nest is starting to tilt.

value.name: caption
value.value: The nest has been damaged! It's starting to tilt!

value.name: caption
value.value: The nest seems to be damaged.

value.name: caption
value.value: The nest is almost completely destroyed.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is scout. Queens in sight! I repeat! Queens!

value.name: caption
value.value: Queens are approaching our troops from behind.

value.name: caption
value.value: Q...Queens are here. Several of them!

value.name: caption
value.value: Does that mean the flying types are multiplying?

value.name: caption
value.value: The Queen is here! Attack it!

value.name: caption
value.value: Behind us! It's coming from behind!

value.name: caption
value.value: The queen looks mad as hell!

value.name: caption
value.value: WHAT?! A Queen? It's a queen!!!

value.name: caption
value.value: The queen is bringing an army of Flying Types with her.

value.name: caption
value.value: Why would it return just now? Did it sense the nest was in danger?!

value.name: caption
value.value: The queen is approaching, destroy it.

value.name: caption
value.value: I don't think we can handle this

value.name: caption
value.value: The battle is not over. Destroy the queen.

value.name: caption
value.value: Flying types deploying from the nest!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is scout. Flying types have appeared from the nest.

value.name: caption
value.value: Flying types keep emerging from the nest. Put an end to this. Destroy the nest.

value.name: caption
value.value: The attack was a success. We've hindered the Flying Types from multiplying. Good job.

value.name: caption
value.value: Destroy enemy robots and recover the urban area.

value.name: caption
value.value: Secure our homeland for humankind! Defeat the enemies!

value.name: caption
value.value: How dare they destroy our city!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is my hometown! Get the hell out!

value.name: caption
value.value: There are almost no survivors in the city.

value.name: caption
value.value: Have the aliens taken over this city?

value.name: caption
value.value: This is a difficult mission, but it has to be done.

value.name: caption
value.value: Flying objects approaching. Get ready for combat.

value.name: caption
value.value: I was selected for my talent as a sniper. I'm destined for this duty.

value.name: caption
value.value: Flying objects are passing through this area.

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't let them pass. Shoot'em all down.

value.name: caption
value.value: More flying objects headed our way.

value.name: caption
value.value: An uncountable amount of flying objects are approaching.

value.name: caption
value.value: People are caught in the webs. Destroy the webs and rescue those people.

value.name: caption
value.value: Let me down! Let me down now!

value.name: caption
value.value: Take those aliens head on. They have a huge army. May the infantry prevail against the enemy.

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員28

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員29

value.name: caption
value.value: On the double! Secure that area!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長20

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't let the fencers have all the fun!

value.name: caption
value.value: Duty once again. When do we get some vacation?

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm the only one who can use the Blazer. I'm needed in the front line.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー兵士38

value.name: caption
value.value: We will take care the ones that get too close.

value.name: caption
value.value: We'll launch an air raid to take out the sniper. Hold on.

value.name: caption
value.value: Requesting artillery fire on enemy sniper!

value.name: caption
value.value: The air force will be here any second.

value.name: caption
value.value: The air raid is starting. All ground troops, fall back!

value.name: caption
value.value: The air force will launch another air raid.

value.name: caption
value.value: The artillery will attack any second.

value.name: caption
value.value: Commencing artillery strike. All ground units stay clear of target area.

value.name: caption
value.value: The aliens can regenerate themselves. They are invincible!

value.name: caption
value.value: Ranger 15 has been wiped out! We can't hold any longer!

value.name: caption
value.value: Ranger 12 suffered heavy casualties. They have taken refuge in a building.

value.name: caption
value.value: The aliens are leading the monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: A large group of monster has appeared.

value.name: caption
value.value: We've our backs against the wall. Let's fight! Stop them!

value.name: caption
value.value: Air force still standing by. Please provide airstrike coordinates.

value.name: caption
value.value: Watch your steps! You'll die if you fall!

value.name: caption
value.value: What sort of machinery is that?!

value.name: caption
value.value: We've discovered a machinery assumed to be deployed by the aliens.

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters are coming out from the machinery!

value.name: caption
value.value: That machinery is a miniature teleportation anchor. It teleports monsters to our world.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy is teleporting monsters underground to multiply. Put an end to this.

value.name: caption
value.value: Explore the underground and destroy each and every teleportation device.

value.name: caption
value.value: We're here! Come meet up with us if you are alive!

value.name: caption
value.value: Up here! Climb all the way up!

value.name: caption
value.value: The device is up there! Climb up!

value.name: caption
value.value: We found them! There're so many of them!

value.name: caption
value.value: These are teleportation devices! Destroy them all!

value.name: caption
value.value: We've got something! A large unit!

value.name: caption
value.value: Destroy each and every teleportation device.

value.name: caption
value.value: Destroy the teleportation devices and exterminate the monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: They are trying to multiply on the surface.

value.name: caption
value.value: The monsters have adapted to the earth's environment.

value.name: caption
value.value: Exterminate the mother monster and its eggs!

value.name: caption
value.value: Destroy the eggs. Every single one of them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like these eggs are water resistant.

value.name: caption
value.value: That's why they can multiply so easily.

value.name: caption
value.value: Nearby monsters are all heading this way!

value.name: caption
value.value: Is the mother monster calling them?

value.name: caption
value.value: Those monsters have invade the combat areas.

value.name: caption
value.value: The mother monster is calling the monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: The eggs are cracking. They are coming out!

value.name: caption
value.value: The eggs have hatched at the same time! Get out of there now!

value.name: caption
value.value: Fight with everything you have! Kill them monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: Move forward! Let's see what that glowing thing is.

value.name: caption
value.value: That teleportation device is summoning the γ Species!

value.name: caption
value.value: As long as that device is intact, more monsters will keep coming. Deal with it.

value.name: caption
value.value: That teleportation device is too dangerous. It has to be destroyed.

value.name: caption
value.value: They managed to put this device underground without us noticing...so they can teleport monsters to earth at will...the situation is getting out of hand...

value.name: caption
value.value: The mothership can be left alone. Eliminate everything else.

value.name: caption
value.value: Imperial Drones incoming! This doesn't look good.

value.name: caption
value.value: The landing ship is deploying aliens!

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't hold them off much longer!

value.name: caption
value.value: The reinforcement is on its way. Hold your ground!

value.name: caption
value.value: Gigantic Unloader Barga. Storm the enemy lines.

value.name: caption
value.value: Gigantic Unloader Barga. Attack the mothership.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長21

value.name: caption
value.value: We would have been here sooner, if we hadn't had to transport this big fella.

value.name: caption
value.value: Yeah, but we need Barga to destroy the mothership.

value.name: caption
value.value: Infantry, stay away from Barga, or you'll be crushed.

value.name: caption
value.value: I knew you would make it.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Barga. Unable to pursuit mothership.

value.name: caption
value.value: I know. Eliminate the rest of the enemies.

value.name: caption
value.value: Contact has been broken with the vanguard. We are here to rescue them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Many teleportation anchors fell down into this area, and they're teleporting the monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: Can't believe there are teleportation anchors underground.

value.name: caption
value.value: They'll keep teleporting monsters to the underground if we don't find them...

value.name: caption
value.value: If that's the case, we are doomed. We have to get to the bottom of this.

value.name: caption
value.value: Multiple teleportation anchors are scattered across this area. They will continue to teleport monsters if we don't destroy them.

value.name: caption
value.value: I wonder what happened to the vanguard.

value.name: caption
value.value: There must be survivors. We need to find them.

value.name: caption
value.value: A king! We've spotted a king!

value.name: caption
value.value: We need to get the hell out of here!!!

value.name: caption
value.value: A rescue team has been dispatched. Hold it together.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm not seeing things, am I? The reinforcement is really here?

value.name: caption
value.value: Everyone else was killed. I survived cause I was hiding.

value.name: caption
value.value: I saw a gigantic monster. It was a king.

value.name: caption
value.value: Destroy the web and rescue the survivors!

value.name: caption
value.value: The entire urban area is covered in webs!

value.name: caption
value.value: They are turning the city into their nest.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are still survivors in this area. Exterminate those creatures right away.

value.name: caption
value.value: Fencers have engaged the enemy. Provide immediate support.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Fencer. We've engaged Aranea. Requesting backup.

value.name: caption
value.value: This cannot be. We have to do something.

value.name: caption
value.value: No casualties. We are going to destroy those teleportation anchors.

value.name: caption
value.value: We've arrived at the estimated drop zone.

value.name: caption
value.value: Be careful. They will come down any second.

value.name: caption
value.value: The calculations were 100% correct. We are right in the middle of their drop zone.

value.name: caption
value.value: Too many! What should we do?!

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like a big anchor is being dropped from the sky.

value.name: caption
value.value: A Big Anchor dropped down. It will teleport more monsters any second!

value.name: caption
value.value: Rendezvous with the other troops. Concentrate your fire, and take out those anchors one by one.

value.name: caption
value.value: This isn't the first time the Primers are here.

value.name: caption
value.value: This report dates back to 17 years ago. The wreckage of a spaceship was discovered in the mountains of India. By estimation, it crashed down to earth some thousands of years ago.

value.name: caption
value.value: Thousands of years? They've been here on earth so long ago?

value.name: caption
value.value: Yes, they have. Indian mythology tells of a golden ship dropping from the sky. People referred to the golden ship as "Vimana" and drew paintings of it. And it looks almost identical to alien teleportation ships.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Primers have been influencing humanity for so long, maybe we are creatures created by Primers, just like those monsters we are fighting.

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn it. Does it mean we as a species are doomed?

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn it. Does it mean we as a species are doomed?

value.name: caption
value.value: Those who are aware of the Primer's existence have assembled the best of the best of each nation to found a global military organization. The brightest minds on earth have been put together to develop the most powerful weaponry we've ever seen. Numerous outposts have also been set up around the world, each deployed with a huge arsenal.

value.name: caption
value.value: Maybe that's why we angered the Primers. We should've never found out about their existence.

value.name: caption
value.value: All units hold position. The Barga team has arrived.

value.name: caption
value.value: Barga team form a barrier. All other units support Barga and attack inbound hostiles.

value.name: caption
value.value: Noble, inform all Barga units. Detachment initialized. Brace for impact.

value.name: caption
value.value: Barga 7's foot has taken some minor damage.

value.name: caption
value.value: All units! Approach the enemy.  Prepare for close quarter combat.

value.name: caption
value.value: Barga 1 to all units. Barga is unarmed. Melee only. Fire away and don't let us slow you down.

value.name: caption
value.value: It can be used for combat but it was originally designed as a crane. The only upside is it's very sturdy. So just fire way.

value.name: caption
value.value: Bargas to battle! And there're 8 of them!

value.name: caption
value.value: Barga 8 here, I'll give it my best.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Barga 7, something wrong with my right foot...what I mean is Barga's right foot.

value.name: caption
value.value: Barga 3! I was hit, but I can still keep it up!

value.name: caption
value.value: Barga 4 here, took some nasty blows.

value.name: caption
value.value: Barga 5, my armor has taken a hit.

value.name: caption
value.value: Barga 7 here. Why does a yellow light keep blinking?

value.name: caption
value.value: Barga 1 here. I'm severely damaged. Output decreasing.

value.name: caption
value.value: Barga 2 here. I've suffered multiple damages.

value.name: caption
value.value: Barga 4, severely damaged. Prepare to escape.

value.name: caption
value.value: Barga 5, heavily damaged. Can't hold on any longer.

value.name: caption
value.value: Barga 6 here. Armor has been breached. Output decreasing fast.

value.name: caption
value.value: Barga 7 here. Red light is blinking. Doesn't look good!

value.name: caption
value.value: Barga 8, my unit is making strange noises! Help me!!!

value.name: caption
value.value: Barga is only good against Erginus, but helpless against the rest. Infantry, cover Barga and take out the smaller monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: Flying objects confirmed. It's flying-type monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: Flying-type monsters are natural enemies of the Barga. Infantry, take them out!

value.name: caption
value.value: Colossal monsters approaching combat areas!? It's a horde of Erginus!!

value.name: caption
value.value: If we let those creatures enter the city, it will be wiped out in no time.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is scout. Aliens coming from the right.

value.name: caption
value.value: Start attacking Aliens coming from both sides.

value.name: caption
value.value: Barga team, Archelus incoming! Engage now!

value.name: caption
value.value: Archelus is a tough nut to crack. All units cover Barga team.

value.name: caption
value.value: A single one of them can destroy the entire city! We are no match for it!

value.name: caption
value.value: The combat strength of the Barga team is decreasing.

value.name: caption
value.value: Noble to Barga B. Detachment procedure in place.

value.name: caption
value.value: Select your targets. Fire at will.

value.name: caption
value.value: Can't believe the A team got defeated this bad by those monsters. Proceed carefully.

value.name: caption
value.value: Barga team has taken heavy casualties. The situation is worse than we expected.

value.name: caption
value.value: Another Barga unit will be dropped on the battlefield.

value.name: caption
value.value: I don't care. Just hurry up.

value.name: caption
value.value: Storm 1. Barga ready to deploy. Board now.

value.name: caption
value.value: I don't see any civilians either.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's dead silent. What is going on?

value.name: caption
value.value: The monsters! They are eating the buildings!

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters eating the buildings? We are in deep trouble this time!

value.name: caption
value.value: They are like a mutated form of Aggressive Alien Species α.

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't believe how fast they are.

value.name: caption
value.value: The monsters are eating the buildings!

value.name: caption
value.value: They ate the inside of the building and are starting to multiply!

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters! They are eating the buildings!

value.name: caption
value.value: Those mutants seem to feed on concrete and plastic in order to breed.

value.name: caption
value.value: What?! You mean they multiply by eating flats and houses?

value.name: caption
value.value: That's correct. If we don't do something, every single building will be gone.

value.name: caption
value.value: The entire city is their food source.

value.name: caption
value.value: Attack those monsters. Let none of them escape.

value.name: caption
value.value: Watch out! That building is coming down!

value.name: caption
value.value: If we don't eradicate them all, we will lose the whole city!

value.name: caption
value.value: Wing Divers deployed as backup. Rendezvous on-site.

value.name: caption
value.value: The fact that they are sending those monsters can only mean one thing...they've reached the final stage of their invasion.

value.name: caption
value.value: Their plan of wiping out the entire human race is proceeding as planned. Now they want to eradicate all artificial creations associated with us?

value.name: caption
value.value: They are leaving no traces behind. They will destroy the human civilization and create a world without us.

value.name: caption
value.value: According to their plan, the environment won't be harmed, it's just us humans who will be eradicated.

value.name: caption
value.value: The anchors are being protected by shield bearers! Normal attacks won't be of any use!

value.name: caption
value.value: Charge forward! It's now or never!

value.name: caption
value.value: Fear not! We have the Grim Reaper team as our backup!

value.name: caption
value.value: Negative! Too many. We can't proceed!

value.name: caption
value.value: We have to find another way.

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn it! Can't believe they got the better of us!

value.name: caption
value.value: Go for the mountain top! Let's go!

value.name: caption
value.value: Let's head to the top of that mountain!

value.name: caption
value.value: Our goal is to get to the mountain top!

value.name: caption
value.value: OK, let the Wing Divers take the lead.

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長22

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長23

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長24

value.name: caption
value.value: The Wing Divers have been dispatched. Meet up with them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Great, have you destroyed the shield bearers.?

value.name: caption
value.value: Good job! The shield bearers have been taken down.

value.name: caption
value.value: Let's eradicate the alien that is leading the monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy is on the other side! Let's go!

value.name: caption
value.value: They've occupied the mountain! Don't let your guards down!

value.name: caption
value.value: They've taken over this area! We need to recover it!

value.name: caption
value.value: Support the vanguard from the rear.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Winged Aliens are invading the mountain!

value.name: caption
value.value: Look at the sky! It's winged aliens!

value.name: caption
value.value: Look up! They are coming from above!

value.name: caption
value.value: Aliens on the land and in the sky. Are we still on earth?

value.name: caption
value.value: The Aliens have taken over the sky! What happened to our airforce?!

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn it! This is our planet!

value.name: caption
value.value: We are engaging Species γ. Our rifles are no use against them. They are stronger than we thought!

value.name: caption
value.value: They are too powerful! These are not regular Species γ!

value.name: caption
value.value: Look! These are not regular Species γ!

value.name: caption
value.value: Every attack is useless against them!

value.name: caption
value.value: Rifles are no use! Use explosives!

value.name: caption
value.value: They are too fast to use explosives!

value.name: caption
value.value: I will try to slow them down! AYAAAA!

value.name: caption
value.value: We believe it's a subspecies of Aggressive Alien Species γ with higher combat strength.

value.name: caption
value.value: More monsters confirmed. A subspecies of Aggressive Alien Species γ.

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters incoming. Seems like a subspecies of Aggressive Alien Species γ.

value.name: caption
value.value: We've spotted a new breed of Aggressive Alien Species γ.

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't get my head around it.

value.name: caption
value.value: I just don't understand their strategy.

value.name: caption
value.value: The reason why we're still around, is because the aliens don't have a weapon of mass destruction like a nuclear bomb. But with their advanced civilization, they should be able to wipe us out just like that.

value.name: caption
value.value: It seems like the aliens don't want to pollute earth.

value.name: caption
value.value: Unfound microorganisms exists in the monster's body fluids. When a monsters dies, the fluids start to spread those microorganisms across the land, which in turn have the ability to dissolve pollutants in the soil and our air.

value.name: caption
value.value: You mean it cleanses our environment?

value.name: caption
value.value: This is just a theory, but we think those monsters are there to breed the microorganisms.

value.name: caption
value.value: So their purpose is to attack and multiply on earth, just to spread the microorganisms across our planet.

value.name: caption
value.value: The aliens want to build a new earth.

value.name: caption
value.value: The monsters is hosting microorganisms in their body fluids. When the monsters die, the fluids start to spread those microorganisms across the land, which in turn have the ability to solidify carbon. In other words, it can absorb carbon dioxide.

value.name: caption
value.value: You mean it can cancel out the greenhouse effect?!

value.name: caption
value.value: It seems like the aliens have an issue with global warming.

value.name: caption
value.value: How are the other areas looking?

value.name: caption
value.value: The war is getting out of hand, but we are still hanging on. The performance of the 3 Submarine Carriers have exceeded everyone's expectation.

value.name: caption
value.value: They are from outer space after all. It's unlikely they brought submarines with them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Now they need to take time to set up base, since the submarine carriers are causing them trouble. We need to take advantage of this opportunity.

value.name: caption
value.value: I understand. Leave it to us. We will try to weaken their forces.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Submarine Carrier Pandora was sunk. It was hit by multiple cannon shots fired from Mothership Number 8.

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn it. Have we lost our ace?

value.name: caption
value.value: The Submarine Carrier Siren was attacked by Mothership Number 6. We've lost all contact.

value.name: caption
value.value: Is Epimetheus the only one left?

value.name: caption
value.value: This is No 15. Sentinel 2, please respond.

value.name: caption
value.value: Sentinel 2 please respond! Report base status?! Hello?!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is No 15. Sentinel 2, please respond. Please!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is F3. Sentinel 2 has been neutralized. Return to F3.

value.name: caption
value.value: No 15 here. Do you have confirmation?

value.name: caption
value.value: What the hell! This is a joke! Jerks!

value.name: caption
value.value: You are the sole survivor. It's good to hear you're fine.

value.name: caption
value.value: Fine? What the hell is fine about it? My friends were in there!!

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm sorry. I will return to F3.

value.name: caption
value.value: I hope you can make it back safe.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Brooklyn, New York. Joel from the Resistance speaking. We've lost every fighting men and women in this area. There are currently 200 people hiding in secure locations, mostly elderly and children. We are slowly running out of water and food, but this is not a call for rescue. We are committed to fight till the end. We are only common civilians, but we have started our military training. We just want to let you know that we will hold our ground. Brooklyn, New York. Over.

value.name: caption
value.value: 10 motherships are advancing. They are targeting the cities and military bases that have remained unscathed.

value.name: caption
value.value: Are they trying to rid of us once and for all?

value.name: caption
value.value: The whole world is joining forces to attack the motherships.

value.name: caption
value.value: We haven't found a way to destroy the motherships yet. But even if we don't stand a chance, we will keep on the good fight. Nothing will change that.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is the Chief Commander of the EDF. I'm running our military operations in a very secure hideout, but it seems the enemy has found us nonetheless. Rest assured, a new commander will be taking over the mission. The fight will not cease. Let's get those aliens off our planet. I'm counting on you. Over.

value.name: caption
value.value: Mothership No 2 has attacked the EDF Headquarter. The HQ...is destroyed.

value.name: caption
value.value: Mothership 10 that landed in South America has destroyed Shelter A. We've lost over half of our supplies.

value.name: caption
value.value: Shelter D has also been destroyed. We are running low on supplies. It's going to be an uphill battle.

value.name: caption
value.value: So what? Why do we even need all those supplies? Haven't you noticed we are running short of personnel?

value.name: caption
value.value: Almost every major city has been destroyed by the motherships.

value.name: caption
value.value: So what if they destroy a city! They are deserted anyways!

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters  are being dropped by the aliens  in the mountain regions! They are trying to hunt down those who fled into the mountains!

value.name: caption
value.value: According to Indian mythology, egg-shaped ships descended from the skies, and out from within came God.

value.name: caption
value.value: The God that arrived on earth in an egg-like ship might be an alien. For all I know, he might be a king or a queen. If we can defeat him...

value.name: caption
value.value: You should keep your opinions to yourself.

value.name: caption
value.value: The same motif has occurred everywhere around the world. An outer space egg came from the sky. And the God who exited the egg created the human civilization.

value.name: caption
value.value: We are soldiers. We fight in the real world. Not in an imaginary one. Don't forget there are still men and women out there who reply on us.

value.name: caption
value.value: I know! But I want to believe! I want to believe in something...The war is doomed. But if we can destroy the egg-shaped ships...humanity will stand a chance.

value.name: caption
value.value: I understand. Right now, we all could use some...hope.

value.name: caption
value.value: If we could just find the egg-shaped ship...

value.name: caption
value.value: The egg-shaped ship is a shared motif in all mythologies. I don't think that's a coincidence. The egg-shaped spaceship that carried god must exist.

value.name: caption
value.value: Mythology or not, there's a chance that the enemy has a central command ship. If we destroy it, we might take down their entire fleet. If such a command ship actually exists, that is.

value.name: caption
value.value: Can't find the egg-shaped ship. Can't find it...

value.name: caption
value.value: Even if we found it, there would be nothing we can do about it. We can't even destroy a mothership, let alone their command ship...

value.name: caption
value.value: The Intelligence Division is in total chaos right now.  Some have been trying to find the egg-shaped ship, despite the fact that there isn't evidence of its existence.

value.name: caption
value.value: Despair gets the best of us.

value.name: caption
value.value: We just need to find the egg-shaped ship...but where is it? WHERE IS IT??!!!

value.name: caption
value.value: Strategic Intelligence Division, can you hear me? I just want to say thank you for all the help and support.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm just doing my job. After all, I'm a strategic support AI that manages all incoming intelligence.

value.name: caption
value.value: We will never give up hope, even to the end. That's our duty.

value.name: caption
value.value: I understand. Fight till the end. That's the least we can do for those who have given their lives.

value.name: caption
value.value: We are surrounded by Teleportation Ships!

value.name: caption
value.value: We are surrounded by the enemy! We need backup!

value.name: caption
value.value: Do you read me! Why is there no response?

value.name: caption
value.value: Strategic Command HQ was attacked by the enemy. I will support you.

value.name: caption
value.value: All backup has been eliminated. Even the base...

value.name: caption
value.value: This area is already lost, but enemy attack shows no sign of slowing down. When we are killed, they will go after the remaining humans. We can't let that happen!

value.name: caption
value.value: They want to eradicate us! But guess  what? We're not going to retreat!

value.name: name
value.value: ウイングダイバー隊長25

value.name: caption
value.value: We cannot win this fight. Let's take out as many of those bastards as we can!

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't believe you shot down a Teleportation Ship.

value.name: caption
value.value: A Teleportation Ship was shot down. Unbelievable.

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemy has been eliminated. Thank you.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is scout. Aliens have brought gigantic monsters with them. This might be a whole legion.

value.name: caption
value.value: Stop! You've got no chance. Just run.

value.name: caption
value.value: The base has been destroyed. There are monsters in the city. There's no where to run to.

value.name: caption
value.value: If we let those monsters roam freely, all survivors will be killed. We have to stop this disaster from happening!

value.name: caption
value.value: Where to? This city has been destroyed. It's just a matter of time before they get to our base.

value.name: caption
value.value: If we don't do something about them, there won't be a place to return to.

value.name: caption
value.value: From now on, we are rangers.

value.name: caption
value.value: We've made up our mind. We will join the fight.

value.name: caption
value.value: Avenge our comrades in the base.

value.name: caption
value.value: Those aliens are controlling the monsters. Attack the aliens.

value.name: caption
value.value: The aliens are up to something!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Strategic Command HQ. Are there any survivors out there?

value.name: caption
value.value: We will be running our operation from underground. It is not the time for despair yet. We will keep on the fight.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Storm 4! We're engaging the monsters!

value.name: caption
value.value: Rescue team is on its way. Hang in there!

value.name: caption
value.value: On the double, get Storm 4 out of there.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Storm 4. Call back the rescue team. We don't need it.

value.name: caption
value.value: We are surrounded by monsters. We don't need rescue anymore. Save the resources.

value.name: caption
value.value: I repeat. Call back the rescue team.

value.name: caption
value.value: Right side! They are coming from the right!

value.name: caption
value.value: Everyone including the rescue team will be wiped out.

value.name: caption
value.value: Our mission is to rescue Storm 4.

value.name: caption
value.value: We are deep inside enemy lines. Be prepared.

value.name: caption
value.value: Sorry for getting you all into this.

value.name: caption
value.value: The monsters are coming from above!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Storm 3. We are here to rescue the damsels in distress.

value.name: caption
value.value: Hey, Storm 1. Have you got a death wish too?

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Storm 2. Heading out to rescue Storm 4.

value.name: caption
value.value: Storm 1. I knew you would come.

value.name: caption
value.value: We discovered a new mothership. It's approaching this area.

value.name: caption
value.value: We've confirmed 10 motherships. This is the eleventh. Monthership 11.

value.name: caption
value.value: Can't believe they are deploying new forces at this stage.

value.name: caption
value.value: Assemble a strike team right now.

value.name: caption
value.value: Strike my ass! Our forces are scattered across the battlefield. God knows how many of them are still alive...

value.name: caption
value.value: Be aware that this will be our last battle. Get prepared.

value.name: caption
value.value: All available units assume attack coordinates. Take down the Mothership.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's on us to take down the Mothership? Nice.

value.name: caption
value.value: Do we have what it takes though?

value.name: caption
value.value: Look at them! We have no chance at all!

value.name: caption
value.value: If we run we get the same outcome. We either get hit in the face or in the back, that's the only difference.

value.name: caption
value.value: I don't suppose we will get any backup.

value.name: caption
value.value: Only a lunatic would come out here.

value.name: caption
value.value: Find the combat ready troops and back them up.

value.name: caption
value.value: There's too many! We need more than ground units...

value.name: caption
value.value: Multiple drones coming out of No. 11.

value.name: caption
value.value: No. 11 is stationary at a high altitude.

value.name: caption
value.value: It isn't running away. Maybe it wants to witness our demise.

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員30（ゴーン１）

value.name: caption
value.value: Gone 1, how many of you are operational?

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員30（ゴーン１）

value.name: caption
value.value: Just 2. We are ready to engage.

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員31（ゴーン２）

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't believe the fight is still going on.

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員30（ゴーン１）

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Gone 1. Supporting infantry units.

value.name: caption
value.value: Infantry unit, Powered Exoskeletons here for support.

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員30（ゴーン１）

value.name: caption
value.value: We should be thanking you. Glad you could make it.

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員31（ゴーン２）

value.name: caption
value.value: You've shown everyone what we humans are made of.

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員30（ゴーン１）

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Gone 1, initiating battle system.

value.name: name
value.value: コンバットフレーム搭乗員31（ゴーン２）

value.name: caption
value.value: This is Gone 2, re-initiating. I'll take down their missiles.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is the end. Don't die before me!

value.name: caption
value.value: They are everywhere I look. This is hilarious.

value.name: caption
value.value: Let all bygones be bygones. See you in hell.

value.name: caption
value.value: The storm unit is under attack. We...we have to do something about it!

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm sorry. There's no one left to save them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters are approaching the area! They are converging on our location!

value.name: caption
value.value: No. 11 is gathering all nearby forces. It wants to destroy this area.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's the absurd! All nearby aliens are swarming this way!

value.name: caption
value.value: No, that's not it. They are trying to protect No. 11! We have to get to the bottom of this!

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn it! No 11 is dropping a teleportation anchor from the sky.

value.name: caption
value.value: It will create a huge blast when it hits the ground!

value.name: caption
value.value: The mothership wants us dead at all cost.

value.name: caption
value.value: These are super sized teleportation anchors that came out of No. 11.

value.name: caption
value.value: With that size, they must require a huge amount of energy to operate.

value.name: caption
value.value: That device could teleport their entire army to Earth.

value.name: caption
value.value: If that monster is from another planet, than this device is the door that connects our earth with that planet.

value.name: caption
value.value: Earth will be doomed if we can't destroy it.

value.name: caption
value.value: All fighting units, attach the gigantic teleportation anchor.

value.name: caption
value.value: Too many enemies...this...this is not going well...

value.name: caption
value.value: The gigantic anchor has been destroyed.

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemy forces are converging on our location.

value.name: caption
value.value: They keep gathering around No. 11. Why is that...?

value.name: caption
value.value: They are gathering around to protect No. 11, rather than being summoned by it. There must be a reason for this.

value.name: caption
value.value: The aliens are trying to wipe out all trace of our existence here on earth. They don't negotiate and they don't accept our surrender. They will keep attacking until the last man on earth is dead. There is no way out. Our only option is to fight back. And show them what we are made of.

value.name: caption
value.value: The mothership is protected by drones and teleportation ships.

value.name: caption
value.value: They are wearing the golden armor, I don't think they will pay us any attention, but we will let them know that underestimating us is a deadly mistake.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have railguns. They will go down for sure.

value.name: caption
value.value: There's no way back. You have to destroy the mothership. It's now or never. Understood?

value.name: caption
value.value: Infantry units unit, protect the railgun!

value.name: caption
value.value: Neutralize the drones and the monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: Can't believe we are all that's left. Some funny business.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is our final stand. I'm just glad I will go out in a blaze of glory.

value.name: caption
value.value: Attack on the Motherships has failed. 5 more cities have been destroyed. All bases have been destroyed.

value.name: caption
value.value: But there is still hope. Forces in North America are still trying to take down Mothership 3.

value.name: caption
value.value: We fight for our land, family and friends. Unfortunately...we are losing everything we hold dear. We all have been wounded and we're losing our courage to fight. What are we suffering for? I just need to place my hand on my chest and feel that hot and vibrant beat to know the answer. Everyone else is dead, and we are alive! We, the living, have to fight. We will fight in the name of our planet, and stick it to them!

value.name: caption
value.value: Last teleportation ship has been destroyed.

value.name: caption
value.value: The operation to take down Mothership 3 which landed in North America has failed. But concentrated fire on their giant cannons seemed to have done some damage.

value.name: caption
value.value: The giant cannons aren't protected by the golden armor.

value.name: caption
value.value: Aim at the mothership's giant cannon. Destroy them.

value.name: caption
value.value: The giant cannon has been activated!

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like the giant cannon has been damaged.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is working. Concentrate your fire on the cannon.

value.name: caption
value.value: Direct hit on the giant cannon confirmed.

value.name: caption
value.value: No 2 is starting to move as well. Wait a ...All motherships are moving! They've set course for...our area.

value.name: caption
value.value: North America hasn't reported anything like this. This is the first time all motherships are heading to the same location.

value.name: caption
value.value: If all 11 motherships gang up on us, we will be vaporized in no time.

value.name: caption
value.value: The giant cannon is no longer operational.

value.name: caption
value.value: YES! This is wonderful news! This is the first time we've damaged a mothership!

value.name: caption
value.value: What the hell is going on?!

value.name: caption
value.value: What?! This wasn't mentioned in any of the reports. What the hell is happening?

value.name: caption
value.value: Cannons! Those flying things have cannons!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is ground unit. We are under heavy artillery fire!

value.name: caption
value.value: The other motherships want to protect it, because it's their command ship.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is No. 21. We're about getting wiped out.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's not looking good for us either.

value.name: caption
value.value: The command ship has much greater fire power than a mothership.

value.name: caption
value.value: THE EGG! IT'S THE EGG! We found it! That's the egg-shaped space ship!

value.name: caption
value.value: The ship that existed in the age of gods. The one that carries God! I've finally found it!

value.name: caption
value.value: This ship could very well be the enemy's flagship. Destroy it.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy ship is preparing its cannons!

value.name: caption
value.value: We cannot let it get away! Destroy it!

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy ship has a lot of firepower, but this is humanity's last chance. Destroy the command ship.

value.name: caption
value.value: If we destroy the command ship, it will turn the tide. Hurry! Destroy it before they gather up.

value.name: caption
value.value: If we let it escape now, we won't get another chance. We have to destroy it right now.

value.name: caption
value.value: Aim at the cannons. Destroy them first and wait for the right moment.

value.name: caption
value.value: Once we destroy that ship, all the sacrifices will be...We...we have to destroy it!

value.name: caption
value.value: We're under heavy fire! I repeat! We're under heavy fire!

value.name: caption
value.value: The cannons have locked on to us!

value.name: caption
value.value: ...Please hold your thoughts. Our men are getting massacred.

value.name: caption
value.value: But...We have to find a way! We have to!

value.name: caption
value.value: If it escapes, all our sacrifices will be for nothing! We have to destroy it here and now!

value.name: caption
value.value: The command ship has overwhelming fire power, and 10 motherships are coming to its aid. We've...tried our best.

value.name: caption
value.value: They are charging a Plasma Cannon!

value.name: caption
value.value: The command ship is protected by a shield.

value.name: caption
value.value: Please everybody! We have to destroy it now...

value.name: caption
value.value: The command ship is being protected by some sort of force field.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is useless! Get cover! UAAHH!!

value.name: caption
value.value: Calm down. Analyze the images and find a weak spot.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm pulling every resource from the intelligence division to analyze the images.

value.name: caption
value.value: Nearby troops have been assembled. Deployment will soon follow.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is futile. The enemy is too powerful.

value.name: caption
value.value: Someone is taking out the cannons!

value.name: caption
value.value: Someone is still fighting! Someone is still fighting!

value.name: caption
value.value: After saving my butt so many times, I can finally return the favor.

value.name: caption
value.value: Would be great if we could take down that ship with us.

value.name: caption
value.value: What a horrible life we had.

value.name: caption
value.value: You are lucky to be alive.

value.name: caption
value.value: For them, you are the real Grim reaper.

value.name: caption
value.value: Now destroy those guys and we can call it even.

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn it! We won't stand a chance if we don't destroy that shield.

value.name: caption
value.value: This cannon emits high energy. This could be the shield generator.

value.name: caption
value.value: Find the spot that isn't protected by the golden armor.

value.name: caption
value.value: The central bottom of the command ship doesn't have any armor.

value.name: caption
value.value: Aim at the center of the command ship!

value.name: caption
value.value: Attack the central bottom of the command ship! Aim at bottom center!

value.name: caption
value.value: Confirmed hit on the command ship.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is great news! We hit it!

value.name: caption
value.value: This might actually work! Keep firing!

value.name: caption
value.value: The command ship has been moderately damaged.

value.name: caption
value.value: The command ship has been severely damaged.

value.name: caption
value.value: The command ship has been destroyed.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is wonderful! We did it! I can't believe we did it...

value.name: caption
value.value: We will let the whole world know about this victory. Today, we sunk the enemy command ship.

value.name: caption
value.value: Wait a second. What's that in the air...it looks...human...

value.name: caption
value.value: It's the pilot of the command ship! Take it under arrest.

value.name: caption
value.value: It doesn't seem to be surrendering.

value.name: caption
value.value: What the hell?! What is that guy doing?

value.name: caption
value.value: Its arms are starting to radiate!

value.name: caption
value.value: In the mythologies, God descended from the egg-shaped ship.

value.name: caption
value.value: God? That's a Primer god for all I know. We don't need it.

value.name: caption
value.value: If it's in the command ship, it must be someone important. Maybe it's their ruler, like a king or emperor. Or it could be their military commander. Either way, this is going to be devastating to the Primers.

value.name: caption
value.value: Manipulating light. Flying in the sky. As was told in the legends.

value.name: caption
value.value: What kind of weapon is that?

value.name: caption
value.value: Every alien that we've encountered was armed, except for this giant.

value.name: caption
value.value: It isn't carrying a weapon. What is going on?

value.name: caption
value.value: For an organism, the enemy has evolved to a frightening stage.

value.name: caption
value.value: Is it ruling over the Primers, because it's evolved to the highest degree?

value.name: caption
value.value: Is it ruling over the aliens, because it's evolved to the highest degree?

value.name: caption
value.value: A primer that can control organisms. They are being ruled by an entity that has evolved to the highest degree.

value.name: caption
value.value: An alien that can control organisms. They are being ruled by an entity that has evolved to the highest degree.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have to find a solution! This...this is our final opportunity!

value.name: caption
value.value: I will look for help. Is...is anyone alive?! Is anyone hearing this?! Anyone?!

value.name: caption
value.value: Aliens are appearing out of thin air?! How is that possible?!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's immortal...omnipotent...now I know why it was named God in the past.

value.name: caption
value.value: There is a halo behind that guy.

value.name: caption
value.value: It sure has a lot of tricks up its sleeve.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's over. We can't defeat this monster.

value.name: caption
value.value: That alien is the incarnation of death. It will kill us all...

value.name: caption
value.value: This is the wrath of God. Watch it manipulate the elements...

value.name: caption
value.value: It's like magic. There must be a logical explanation behind this...but what...

value.name: caption
value.value: We won't stand a chance if we don't figure out the secret to its weapon.

value.name: caption
value.value: Our scans show no traces of metal. Its power...

value.name: caption
value.value: Telekinesis is the only reasonable explanation.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's hard to believe, but this being is capable of creating energy at will.

value.name: caption
value.value: To be precise, it has the ability to transform thoughts into physical attacks.

value.name: caption
value.value: We recognize thought as electric signals generated by our brain. The so called “super powers” are only a fantasy of ours, or should I say, a delusion…But if an intelligent life form evolves for thousands or even tens of thousands of years, maybe it can eventually reach that stage.

value.name: caption
value.value: That would be the peak of evolution for an organism; a life form which has reached its maximum potential. What does it take to evolve to such a degree…The process itself is beyond our imagination.

value.name: caption
value.value: Are we talking about a god-like entity?

value.name: caption
value.value: The Primers have preserved their culture and civilization for a very long time. However, they relied not on technology advancement, but by evolving their own species.

value.name: caption
value.value: Does that mean, the difference between us and the Primers, lies not only in terms of technology?

value.name: caption
value.value: Does that mean, the difference between us and the aliens, lies not only in terms of technology?

value.name: caption
value.value: How...how can we defeat something like that!

value.name: caption
value.value: So many have sacrificed...but what for...

value.name: caption
value.value: If it can distort space, it should be fairly easy for it to escape. Why is it still here? Why doesn't it just leave?

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm afraid...it wants to kill whoever destroyed the command ship.

value.name: caption
value.value: It may have acknowledged Storm 1 as a special human specimen. All we can do is make a final push.

value.name: caption
value.value: The giant is becoming more and more powerful.

value.name: caption
value.value: It can transform mind into physical energy...In theory, it has unlimited power.

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't believe this, are you saying that thing has unlimited power?

value.name: caption
value.value: No. Only god possess of such power. And that thing isn't god. It's an evil invader.

value.name: caption
value.value: 10 motherships are still on the move.

value.name: caption
value.value: The motherships are indeed heading to this area.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's only a matter of time till they get the best of us.

value.name: caption
value.value: Are you serious?! You sure you want to do this?

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy commander is right before our eyes. No matter how many sacrifices we make in the future, we will never get this opportunity again.

value.name: caption
value.value: What do you mean by that?

value.name: caption
value.value: Humanity's last stand. We've deployed everyone into the fight to stop the motherships.

value.name: caption
value.value: But, we've already sent in everyone we've got...

value.name: caption
value.value: Not all. We've given underground resistances the green light to attack.

value.name: caption
value.value: What? You are sending out civilians???

value.name: caption
value.value: From now on, every human is an EDF soldier.

value.name: caption
value.value: You want unequipped civilians to fight? Have you gone mad??

value.name: caption
value.value: It will buy us precious time.

value.name: caption
value.value: Everyone will die! You want to sacrifice the last remaining survivors for a bloody miracle? What's the point of saving our planet if there's no one left?

value.name: caption
value.value: This operation won't be in vain! No...no matter how great the cost, we...we must...

value.name: caption
value.value: A super being that can create infinite energy. It's a creature superior to everything else.

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn it! What's the point of destroying the command ship, if we cannot defeat that thing.

value.name: caption
value.value: If we let it get away, all our sacrifices will be for nothing! Please! We have to find a way!

value.name: caption
value.value: We've got nothing left. Time to die.

value.name: caption
value.value: Number of deployable units...zero. It's over.

value.name: caption
value.value: What in god's name...We have a survivor!!

value.name: caption
value.value: Not even Storm 1 can do anything about that monster.

value.name: caption
value.value: Yet, we should put our faith in Storm 1...And pray.

value.name: caption
value.value: Storm 1. Humanity's fate lies on your shoulders.

value.name: caption
value.value: When a powerful alien entity attacks, the lesser organism will be extinguished. Maybe that's the rule of the universe.

value.name: caption
value.value: We have been living on Earth isolated from the universe, knowing nothing about the powerful beings out there. What we are facing right now, is the inevitable and infinite cycle of life.

value.name: caption
value.value: Yet still, we will fight for our survival and win.

value.name: caption
value.value: These are heavily armed aliens. They must be his personal bodyguards.

value.name: caption
value.value: There's nothing we can throw at these aliens. Is this the end?

value.name: caption
value.value: I knew no one could have survived this...

value.name: caption
value.value: Oh ya think so huh, well I can still put up a fight.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's all or nothing. Looks like our last shot.

value.name: caption
value.value: All of you, hang in there no matter what!

value.name: caption
value.value: Storm 1, we are counting on you.

value.name: caption
value.value: They are all wounded, but we've tried our best to gather everyone who can still fight.

value.name: caption
value.value: You will finish the job, while we act as bait.

value.name: caption
value.value: Storm 1, we'll be counting on you!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's working! God is starting to slow down!

value.name: caption
value.value: Let's put this tragedy to an end!

value.name: caption
value.value: Spriggan unit deployed. They should arrive momentarily.

value.name: caption
value.value: Is it the Elite Wing Diver unit?

value.name: caption
value.value: With their assistance, I'm certain we will get through this crisis.

value.name: caption
value.value: Spriggan unit here. We're moving in.

value.name: caption
value.value: Spriggan here, we are engaging hostiles.

value.name: caption
value.value: Spriggan unit here. We've captured the enemy.

value.name: caption
value.value: They are elite Wing Divers. They are not to be messed with.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Spriggan unit? They aren't cute and cuddly, they are witches!

value.name: caption
value.value: The Spriggan unit has arrived! Better not get on their wrong side!

value.name: caption
value.value: If you don't get here ASAP, we will all bite the dust!

value.name: caption
value.value: Correction. Everyone alive get back to base.

value.name: caption
value.value: I will teach you greenhorns how to fight! Watch and learn!

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't bite off more than you can chew! You will die!

value.name: caption
value.value: Recruits! I'll get you all out of here! Don't give up!

value.name: caption
value.value: The Caliban will pick you up. Hang in there.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Calibans are on their way. Try to remain calm.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Calibans are too slow. Get a chopper.

value.name: caption
value.value: I once saw a tower collapse in front of me less than a kilometer away.

value.name: caption
value.value: Me too. After that I dream of being crushed by a tower all the time.

value.name: caption
value.value: I can still remember your stupid face back then.

value.name: caption
