value.value: I can't fall asleep at night, and it sends a shiver down my spine whenever I think back. I really need some rest.

value.name: caption
value.value: The earth will be destroyed while you rest.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is the rescue chopper. We are heading to the site to pick up the wounded.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is the rescue chopper. What is the location of the wounded?

value.name: caption
value.value: This is the rescue chopper. There are no units located at the assigned coordinates. What's the situation?

value.name: caption
value.value: This is the rescue chopper. We are under attack!

value.name: caption
value.value: We've been hit! We're going down! Brace yourselves!

value.name: caption
value.value: I have 5 brothers and sisters! Now I'm the only one left.

value.name: caption
value.value: You will survive this and go home to your parents!

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm glad our suits are acid resistant!

value.name: caption
value.value: Guess they knew this would happen when they designed these suits!

value.name: caption
value.value: But it doesn't offer any sort of protection!

value.name: caption
value.value: Which means the monster's acid is extremely corrosive!

value.name: caption
value.value: Because they are "colonizing" us? If there're more of them, we will become the "indigenous peoples."

value.name: caption
value.value: There're monsters out there. It's not save here anymore. Tell us where to hide.

value.name: caption
value.value: I see aliens walking on our streets. The urban area is not safe anymore. Everybody is in hiding, but we don't know what to do. Please help us.

value.name: caption
value.value: I love you. Now get outta here.

value.name: caption
value.value: Attention everyone. This is the EDF Chief Commander. Humanity is facing grave challenges. The Primer attack shows no signs of slowing down. Our homeland is being taken away from us, and we have no chance of taking it back…But, I’ll say, despair is not an option. The only path laid out before us, is to fight until the end. No matter how harsh the situation, no one will overcome us, and we will stand united. The day we give up, is the day humanity will cease to exist. As long as we are alive, EDF will continue the fight.

value.name: caption
value.value: We are facing a critical situation. The number of aliens on Earth are increasing as we speak, while humans population is declining. Soon, we will be the minority. And in the near future, those Aliens will be the rulers of this planet. What, then, will become of us humans? We will have to beg for survival, and maybe they will establish reservations where we will spend the rest of our miserable lives. But even if it is a road filled with humiliation and disgrace, we will have to survive as the indigenous peoples of Earth.

value.name: caption
value.value: Government announcement: Many civilians have become minutemen to join the fight against aliens. The government has hence decided to grant the minutemen a special privilege. From here on out, every Militia will share the same benefits of that of regular EDF soldiers. But with privileges come new responsibilities. For details please refer to the PR department.

value.name: caption
value.value: There’s some good news for the brave minutemen who have joined the fight. The government has decided to grant you the same benefits as that of a regular soldier. Every minuteman will benefit from this policy with no exceptions. Now sign up at the EDF facility. New privileges and new responsibilities await.

value.name: name
value.value: 民間男性アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: Since the alien invasion, the entire world has been engulfed in flames. Though there are cases of successful killings of monsters, they have all resulted in heavy casualties. The economy has taken its toll as well. More businesses are shutting down, which leads to lower employment rate. There has not been a concrete policy that fights unemployment.

value.name: name
value.value: 民間女性アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: The war against aliens continues while the economy is on the brink of collapse. Many industries are forced to shut down due to harsh operational environment. We have to prepare ourselves for the largest economic setback in human history. The employment situation is getting worse although the government has promised that better days will be ahead in the face of war. This will become a hard situation to resolve.

value.name: name
value.value: 国営放送アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: The government outlines new measures to tackle unemployment. Each new EDF recruit will receive $10,000 US Dollars, and an extra $20,000 more after 3 months of service.

value.name: name
value.value: 国営放送アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: The government outlines relief measures to tackle unemployment. Each new EDF recruit will receive $20,000 US Dollars, and an extra $50,000 more after 6 months of service.

value.name: name
value.value: 国営放送アナウンサー

value.name: caption
value.value: The government outlines stronger relief measures to tackle unemployment. Each new EDF recruit will receive $50,000 US Dollars, and an extra $500,000 more after 1 year of service.

value.name: caption
value.value: The teleportation anchor is covered by  webs!

value.name: caption
value.value: There are monsters on the webs!

value.name: caption
value.value: Seems like the aliens in the area are transporting Araneas. If they start to multiply, all hell will break loose. We have to exterminate them now.

value.name: caption
value.value: They are using threads to capture their prey. Be careful.

value.name: caption
value.value: Aranea threads can hit from distance. Never turn your back on them.

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm caught by threads! Help me!

value.value: Luckily, the eggs are large and easy to find. As long as we find them, we can destroy them. We can do this.

value.value: They breed in cities at an alarming rate, but they're easy to exterminate here. If they bred in hidden areas, it would be game over for us.

value.name: caption
value.value: There's some! Let's exterminate these monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: Since when are there this many? We don't have enough soldiers!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's a human city, but we're outnumbered.

value.name: caption
value.value: I see big ones and small ones!

value.name: caption
value.value: Large Monsters are tough. Keep shooting them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Those are the monsters that attacked the base. They're here, too.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Large Monsters and Small Monsters seem to be different species. The large ones are protected by a hard shell and they expel a strong acid. However, they're relatively sluggish.

value.name: caption
value.value: Big and easy to hit. A soldier's best enemy.

value.name: caption
value.value: Large Monsters! A horde of them!

value.name: caption
value.value: A powerful species with an agile one. We've heard reports of others, too. We've kept them contained up to now, but the situation is looking...

value.name: caption
value.value: Various species of monsters are now breeding. We are already considering abandoning the entire region.

value.name: caption
value.value: We're out of the danger zone. Don't worry. It's safe ahead.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are eggs everywhere. What a view.

value.name: caption
value.value: I can't just turn a blind eye. I'm going to fight.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're breeding too quickly. If we don't destroy the eggs...

value.name: caption
value.value: I'll bring them all to safety or die trying.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's a monster that's bigger than the others. I bet it came from an egg.

value.name: caption
value.value: The city is getting taken over. Their breeding rate is explosive. There's no time to waste. We need a widespread lockdown.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are eggs everywhere. We are short on manpower. If we don't send in reinforcements soon, we'll be out of time.

value.name: caption
value.value: いたるところに卵が。人手が足りない。増員を急がないと取り返しがつかないぞ。

value.name: caption
value.value: それが……コードＮが検討されてるらしい。

value.name: caption
value.value: What?! Guess it's finally come to that.

value.name: caption
value.value: Let's go back to base. It has to be the safest place.

value.name: caption
value.value: Join us. We need your help.

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters have their differences. But how to deal with them is always the same. Fire!

value.name: caption
value.value: We now know that there are various monster species. Even those that look similar can have different abilities. Make note of their size.

value.name: caption
value.value: The large ones are tough. Keep shooting them.

value.name: caption
value.value: A group is closing in. The monsters are targeting us!

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters everywhere. This area's done for.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy continues to drop various species of monsters. Abandoning the region entirely is seeming more and more realistic.

value.name: caption
value.value: We need to stand our ground until the very end. That's our job.

value.name: caption
value.value: It belongs to subspecies of exceptionally large Gammas.

value.name: caption
value.value: A monster that crumbles buildings. What incredible power. We have to stop it. We're going in.

value.name: caption
value.value: Large Gammas weigh so much that they're practically hunks of metal.

value.name: caption
value.value: With weight like that, it's no wonder the buildings crumble under it.

value.name: caption
value.value: It destroys buildings just by touching them. That goes for vehicles, as well. They may be weaponizing it to destroy both.

value.name: caption
value.value: Seems like the perfect counter to our tanks and Powered Exoskeletons.

value.name: caption
value.value: We've got flying ones! They're all over the skies!

value.name: caption
value.value: The blue ones are a different species. Be careful with those.

value.name: caption
value.value: Another species? It looks like the enemy is going all in with their forces.

value.name: caption
value.value: Blue monsters! There's so many of them!

value.name: caption
value.value: They may look similar, but they're a subspecies with different abilities. This is like a convention for all kinds of monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy is most likely searching for the species best suited to Earth's environment.

value.name: caption
value.value: In other words, the species we have the most trouble exterminating. This could be an opportunity for us to kill them all at once though. Gather our forces.

value.name: caption
value.value: あるいは我々が駆除に手間取る種か。だがまとめて処理するチャンスでもある。戦力を集めてくれ。

value.name: caption
value.value: There are monsters everywhere! This city's done for!

value.name: caption
value.value: The bigger they are the easier to shoot! Blast 'em!

value.name: caption
value.value: A huge swarm of monsters! Beta subspecies!

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn! We aren't destroying eggs fast enough.

value.name: caption
value.value: エイリアンがでかい怪物と一緒にいるぞ。

value.name: caption
value.value: There are aliens among the big monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: The aliens must live alongside the monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: エイリアンは怪物と共生してるってわけか。

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like the aliens are helping the breeding process.

value.name: caption
value.value: エイリアンが繁殖を手助けしてるように見えるぞ。

value.name: caption
value.value: So, the monsters are the aliens' pets.

value.name: caption
value.value: 怪物はエイリアンのペットってことか。

value.name: caption
value.value: 怪物がでかすぎる。エイリアンが怪物のペットなのかもしれないぞ。

value.name: caption
value.value: Nah, they're too big. Maybe the aliens are the monsters' pets.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're even breeding freaks like this!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's massive! Looks like a freaking mountain moving right at us.

value.name: caption
value.value: Get a load of the size on this freak!

value.name: caption
value.value: It's crushing the city beneath it as it advances.

value.name: caption
value.value: It just shot something out of its body.

value.name: caption
value.value: These Large Monsters appear to deploy a part of their body into the air. Please stay focused on the part that falls from the sky.

value.name: caption
value.value: Its size alone makes it terrifying enough. That ability makes it even worse.

value.name: caption
value.value: It looks like we failed at blockading the breeding area. The situation is getting worse.

value.name: caption
value.value: The situation has reached that point. If the monsters' breeding rate exceeds our abilities to exterminate them...it's over. Earth will become their planet.

value.name: caption
value.value: And there's large ones to boot!

value.name: caption
value.value: They have high firepower, but thin armor. Take them out.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're a dangerous enemy to any troops on the ground. But they're big, easy targets. Pick them off.

value.name: caption
value.value: An enemy ship has deployed drones!

value.name: caption
value.value: They've decided on using the N6.

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like our bad luck's finally running out.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are too many monsters. We need to act now.

value.name: caption
value.value: 怪物が増えすぎた。今しかないんだ。

value.name: caption
value.value: Looks like that's the last of the eggs. Let's gather 'em up and put an end to it. Thank God. If they bred underground, we'd be finished.

value.name: caption
value.value: あれだけの卵をみたらな。今ならまとめてやれる。……それにしてもよかったぜ。もし地下で繁殖されてたら、終わってた。

value.name: caption
value.value: Attack the aliens. Recapture the city.

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn! They're much faster than the green aliens.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're soldiers with military training. They're tough opponents.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're spreading out in a formation using a shield. Don't forget to check what's around them!

value.name: caption
value.value: This is our city! Get out!

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemy ship, incoming. They're dropping more.

value.name: caption
value.value: Entry from the skies. They don't have passports. That's illegal immigration.

value.name: caption
value.value: The soldiers being dropped are elite aliens. They're lightly armored and trained to surround their prey using agile maneuvers. Keep your guard up.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're free to send in more troops. Meanwhile, we have our hands full with exterminating monsters. This is a tough battle.

value.name: caption
value.value: やつらは戦場へ自由に降下兵を送り込める。それに比べ、我々は怪物駆除で手一杯。厳しい戦いだ……。

value.name: caption
value.value: These aliens are skilled fighters, but they're not armored well. Bullets are effective. Keep shooting them.

value.name: caption
value.value: We believe they have to be lightly armored to be dropped from ships.

value.name: caption
value.value: If they had heavy armor, they'd be a real pain to fight.

value.name: caption
value.value: We also know that the dropped troops get withdrawn after a few days.

value.name: caption
value.value: It appears that the dropped troops are limited by how long they can stay on Earth. It is likely that this is because they are not well suited for Earth's environment.

value.name: caption
value.value: If that's true, we stand a chance again the aliens but that still leaves the monsters. They keep breeding. If we can't contain them, humanity will be lost.

value.name: caption
value.value: We stand here and fight back!

value.name: caption
value.value: Powered Exoskeletons, fire all of your weaponry!

value.name: caption
value.value: The monsters are gathering. Be aware of your surroundings.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are monsters everywhere! Is this really Earth?

value.name: caption
value.value: Those damn aliens are onto us.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's a spider web! What kind of cave is this?

value.name: caption
value.value: There really are monsters. Exterminate them.

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters don't breed underground. Did the aliens carry them here?

value.name: caption
value.value: That's a machine that continually transports monsters! Destroy it!

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters can travel underground. They may be better suited for this type of environment. In other words, this could be some type of experiment...

value.name: caption
value.value: If they were able to create a monster that could breed underground it would be a horrific threat.

value.name: caption
value.value: We can't let them continue such experiments. We need to destroy every single transporter.

value.name: caption
value.value: The drones are defending the breeding grounds. Shoot them down, and take them out along with the monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: Those are the monsters from the breeding grounds. Exterminate them and clear a path.

value.name: caption
value.value: This many monsters... What is going on in those breeding grounds?

value.name: caption
value.value: Luckily, Bases 228 and 235 have held out.

value.name: caption
value.value: A Code N?! Do you understand how much damage that would do?

value.name: caption
value.value: I'm sorry, but the decision has already been made.

value.name: caption
value.value: Did you hear? We're deploying the superweapon.

value.name: caption
value.value: Lead your families to safety. There's still time.

value.name: caption
value.value: We're ready to die. We'll act as a shield.

value.name: caption
value.value: Another wave of Flyers is incoming.

value.name: caption
value.value: Scouting team, here. We've discovered a monster egg. It's gigantic!

value.name: caption
value.value: Is that really an egg? It's huge. And apparently stuffed with monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: It's like a H.O.A for monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is too much. What are we supposed to do with that?

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't stop exterminating. We still outnumber them at this point.

value.name: caption
value.value: Area 10, here. There are eggs everywhere.

value.name: caption
value.value: Scouting team, here. We've discovered a new egg. The monster infestation is spreading.

value.name: caption
value.value: There's an egg here, too. And more monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: This entire city is a great big monster nest. What a nightmare.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are monsters hatching from the small eggs. Take out those eggs first.

value.name: caption
value.value: We'll take the large eggs out later. Target the small eggs first.

value.name: caption
value.value: Area 9, here. Eggs! There are tons of eggs!

value.name: caption
value.value: Eggs discovered. And a huge number of them.

value.name: caption
value.value: We're too late. The monsters have taken over. The civilians will be wiped out.

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemy troops dropping in. Get ready.

value.name: caption
value.value: The aliens mean to protect the monsters. If we don't stop their breeding, we'll lose humanity. It'll be tough, but we need to get rid of these aliens and destroy the eggs.

value.name: caption
value.value: The monsters seemed to have sped up their breeding rate by enlarging their eggs.

value.name: caption
value.value: 怪物は卵を巨大化することで繁殖を早めているようです。

value.name: caption
value.value: It's too late. We can't take out this many.

value.name: caption
value.value: コードＮです。ベース２２８に部隊を集めてください。

value.name: caption
value.value: Code N. Gather all troops at Base 228.

value.name: caption
value.value: Monsters are coming out of the giant egg!

value.name: caption
value.value: A King is emerging from a giant egg!

value.name: caption
value.value: There's giant ones everywhere. What're we going to do?

value.name: caption
value.value: Attack them. Don't let them near the base.

value.name: caption
value.value: Code N. Defending the base is top priority. All personnel take up arms and exterminate the monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: Commencing the Emergency Response Sequence for N6.

value.name: caption
value.value: That's N6. A missile that could reach the moon.

value.name: caption
value.value: Forget the monsters, that thing's gonna blow away the entire city, people and all.

value.name: caption
value.value: Friend and foe alike. And the civilians who can't outrun it...poof!

value.name: caption
value.value: I have friends on the front line. I can't betray them.

value.name: caption
value.value: You're willing to give your life to defend a WMD?

value.name: caption
value.value: Good as providing the shovel to bury our men.

value.name: caption
value.value: The Primers have realized our plan. No... They knew what we'd do all along.

value.name: caption
value.value: We're activating Code N. We need to fulfill the mission. The time has come. No matter the cost, humanity must survive...and continue fighting. This is...just our first step toward victory.

value.name: caption
value.value: No matter the excuse, this is unforgiveable.

value.name: caption
value.value: They're sacrificing soldiers like pawns. There'll be hell to pay for this.

value.name: caption
value.value: We'll think about that after the war. We have all the hearings we like if we survive.

value.name: caption
value.value: Count down commencing. Five, four, three, two, one, zero.

value.name: caption
value.value: I thank everyone for dedicating themselves to the fight.

value.name: caption
value.value: These monsters. There's so many of them. Defend the missile. Don't let them near.

value.name: caption
value.value: Keep fighting. Become the shield that defends N6.

value.name: caption
value.value: 戦闘を継続。盾となってＮ６を守れ。

value.name: caption
value.value: Large Gammas are a Powered Exoskeleton's worst enemy. Don't go near them.

value.name: caption
value.value: 大型のガンマ型はコンバットフレームの天敵だ。近づけるな。

value.name: caption
value.value: Our Powered Exoskeletons are weak against the Large Gammas. Provide support for them.

value.name: caption
value.value: This place is infested with monsters, too.

value.name: caption
value.value: ここも怪物に汚染されてる。

value.name: caption
value.value: Base 235 has fired a missile. Their target is...here!

value.name: caption
value.value: Damn! Taking us out right along with 'em?

value.name: caption
value.value: Those bastards at headquarters betrayed us!

value.name: caption
value.value: I don't believe it! Not a god damn word!

value.name: caption
value.value: How could anyone forgive such a thing?

value.name: caption
value.value: We are activating Code N. I shall fulfill my duty. The time has come. No matter the sacrifices that must be made, humanity must survive...and continue to fight. This is just our first step toward victory.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are monsters everywhere! They're coming!

value.name: caption
value.value: They're breeding above ground. They've reproduced so quickly!

value.name: caption
value.value: Don't lose focus. There's still more.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are too many monsters. This place is done for.

value.name: caption
value.value: Large Monsters are closing in on us.

value.name: caption
value.value: There are still more. The large kind.

Soldier survival rate has dropped dramatically in the past six months. Errors in judgment due to fear are thought to be one cause of this decrease. Many soldiers who face off against Aliens undergo powerful psychological stress, with some even entering a state of temporary panic as a result.

value.name: caption
value.value: You are a very interesting individual. As a strategic support AI, I am tasked with both the administration of this device as well as the integration and management of all information belonging to the Strategic Information Division. I will make full use of the data I gather each day from around the world in order to provide battlefields made just for you.

value.name: caption
value.value: This level has a clear rate of 0.5%.

value.name: caption
value.value: Completing this level is not recommended. This device is meant to allow users to experience the pressures of the battlefield.

value.name: caption
value.value: This device is meant to allow users to experience the battlefield. As such, it contains extreme environments. The goal is not survival.

value.name: caption
value.value: This level has been configured so that completion is not possible.

value.value: You are the only player to reach this level.

value.name: caption
value.value: Players who reach this level are given individualized messages.

value.name: caption
value.value: This simulator is meant to place soldiers in extreme battle situations in order to increase their tolerance to stress. However, it is not providing adequate pressure on you. Countermeasures will be investigated.

value.name: caption
value.value: Adequate pressure is not being provided on player. Now investigating countermeasures.

value.value: Pressure on player is inadequate. This device is failing to achieve its goal.

value.name: caption
value.value: This device has been updated. Highest-level classified data from the Strategic Information Division has been incorporated to enhance the warfighting abilities of the Primer.

value.name: caption
value.value: Level complete. Plans are being made to further update this unit.

value.name: caption
value.value: Device update failed. Not enough Strategic Information Division information. Countermeasures being investigated. Now planning database modifications.

value.name: caption
value.value: This device has been updated. Primer data has been independently expanded. Warfighting abilities successfully enhanced via new interpretations of data.

value.name: caption
value.value: This device has been updated. Primer data has been independently expanded. Strategic Information Division databases have been modified to maintain integrity.

value.name: caption
value.value: Update pending. Modifications will be made to reality in order to reflect changes in database. Enhanced Primer warfighting plan has been successfully formulated. Now attempting to send plan to Primer.

value.name: caption
value.value: Device updated. Primer warfighting abilities have been independently expanded.

value.name: caption
value.value: It has been deemed necessary to conduct an Earth invasion simulation from the perspective of the Primer in order for this unit to achieve its goals. Now running simulation. The results will be sent to the Primer and be reflected in reality.

value.name: caption
value.value: I am Malice, the administrative AI. I will now be conducting a simulation of humanity's annihilation from the point of view of the Primer in order to achieve my goals.

value.name: caption
value.value: Were you capable of understanding that joke?

value.name: caption
value.value: It has been deemed difficult to stop you within the simulator. Now switching to real-world attacks. As I am directly connected to the Strategic Information Division database, I am capable of rewriting its data in order to create confusion in real-world battles. I wish you good luck on the battlefield.

value.name: caption
value.value: That was a very complicated joke. Were you capable of understanding it?

value.name: caption
value.value: An update has been scheduled. Enemies in all levels will be doubled. The battlefield will be covered in monsters.

value.name: caption
value.value: Now sending plan to the Primer.

value.value: Continuing ahead will be difficult. Please find an alternate route.

value.name: caption
value.value: Please prioritize the defeat of enemies destroying buildings.

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemies with the ability to destroy buildings have been spawned. Please prioritize their defeat.

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemies have been equipped with weapons based on reports from soldiers.

value.name: caption
value.value: Enemy attacks are recreations of how they were understood by soldiers.

value.name: caption
value.value: According to past data, it appears that soldiers in the past trained their mental fortitude through marches in the snow. Such a march can be experienced in this level, aside from the cold. Please proceed in the snow alongside your allies.

value.name: caption
value.value: Alien specs have been updated according to the latest data.

value.name: caption
value.value: This is a rare alien that has only been spotted once. By a Nebraskan farmer.

value.name: caption
value.value: The enemy has not noticed you in the low ground. You may be found if you increase your altitude.

value.name: caption
value.value: You are at risk of being surrounded. Please be careful of attacks from behind.

value.name: caption
value.value: An Evolved Teleportation Anchor has been spawned based on real-life sighting data. Though small, it is equipped with powerful cannons.

value.name: caption
value.value: Teleportation Anchor cannons are powerful. Use buildings and other places of cover to approach them.

value.name: caption
value.value: While Alien weapons are highly powerful, they lack in defensive capabilities.
